title.en: Farage hints that Reform’s £72m donations may not be legal under new elections bill - UK politics live
title.zh: 理查德·蒂斯指责工党在改革党收到7200万英镑捐款后“试图追溯性地改变规则”——英国政治直播

summary.en: Labour MPs and unions are pushing the government to legislate for stricter caps on political party donations. Reform UK's deputy leader, Richard Tice, has not disclosed when two crypto billionaires who collectively donated £72 million to the party returned to the UK.
summary.zh: 工党议员和工会正敦促政府立法对政治党派捐款实行更严格的上限。改革党副领袖理查德·蒂斯尚未透露向该党捐赠了7200万英镑的两名加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国。

body.en: In an interview about the donations, he said they are compliant with the law ‘today’ Andy Burnham has cancelled engagements today and tomorrow following the death of his father Roy, who was suffering from Alzheimer’s, the Press Association reports. Burnham has spoken about his father’s illness which meant that he did not know his son had become prime minister. [We] will continue bringing forward further reforms to strengthen confidence in our democracy. Following on from the previous minister for democracy’s letter to you of 10 July 2026, we wanted to reiterate the government’s concerns, shared by many members of the public and parliamentarians, about the rise in the volume and concentration of money in UK politics. We have to limit the way financial power can end up dominating political power, to get to a politics that works for all people in all places. We believe spending limits on parties and candidates are too high, and ought to be reduced. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据 Peter Walker 报道，工党议员和工会正在向政府施压，要求其立法对政党捐款实行更严格的上限。英国改革党副领袖理查德·泰斯 (Richard Tice) 拒绝透露向该党捐赠总计 7200 万英镑的两位加密货币亿万富翁何时返回英国。早上好。今天下午，议员们将就人民代表法案的二读进行辩论。如果你听到上议院议事厅周围传来一声巨响，那是马匹逃跑后马厩门关上的声音。知情人士表示，限制捐款并不是伯纳姆的首要任务，也不值得与工党最大支持者发生争执。我们完全相信，[Delo 和 Harborne] 的捐款不仅符合现有规则，而且也符合目前正在议会审议的规则，尽管有追溯的因素……除非[工党]在上议院审议时真正尝试再次更改规则，在这种情况下，它必须返回下议院。我的意思是，目前这种独裁政权正在毁掉这个国家，一切皆有可能。你知道，我们是政变的受害者。这些捐款是按照规则和规定进行的，现在你看到了那些毁掉这个国家的社会主义者的虚伪，他们试图回顾性地改变规则，这不是公平的方式，这不是英国的方式，我想大多数人会说“这是否意味着工党对改革的进展感到恐惧，他们试图创造一个不公平的竞争环境？”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The significant donation of £72 million to Reform UK has sparked debate about the rules governing political funding. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless words: "And what does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God." The pursuit of justice in campaign finance, ensuring fairness and...
reflection.zh: 改革党收到高达7200万英镑的巨额捐款，引发了关于政治资金管理规则的辩论。这一情况令人想起先知弥迦永恒的话语：“雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。”在竞选资金方面追求公正，确保公平和透明，是合乎道德的治理的重要方面。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Bolsonaro 2.0: Brazil braces for the return of the far right
title.zh: 博索纳罗2.0：巴西为右翼回归做准备

summary.en: With President Lula embroiled in scandal, Flávio Bolsonaro is energizing his base in the key state of Minas Gerais, beginning his campaign at the site where his father was stabbed. Flávio Bolsonaro, the eldest son of Brazil's incarcerated former president, arrived in Juiz de Fora, a city crucial to the nation's...
summary.zh: 在卢拉总统深陷丑闻之际，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗正在关键的米纳斯吉拉斯州煽动其支持者，并从其父亲遇刺的地点开始竞选活动。巴西被监禁的前总统之子弗拉维奥·博索纳罗抵达了对巴西民主未来至关重要的城市茹伊斯迪福拉，并宣称巴西需要一位领导人，而他就是那位领导人。

body.en: With Lula mired in scandal, Flávio Bolsonaro is firing up his base in the bellwether state of Minas Gerais – starting at the scene of his father’s stabbing A giant banner of Brazil’s incarcerated former president Jair Bolsonaro fluttered in the morning breeze as his eldest son, Flávio, touched down at an airfield on the fringe of a city that will soon help decide the future of one of the biggest democracies on earth. “Brazil is rudderless. Brazil has no president and Brazil needs a president – and that president is Flávio Bolsonaro,” the far-right senator declared as he waded into the flock of supporters who had gathered to welcome him to Juiz de Fora, one of the largest cities in the battleground state of Minas Gerais. Continue reading...
body.zh: 卢拉深陷丑闻之际，弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗(Flávio Bolsonaro)正在米纳斯吉拉斯州的领头羊州启动自己的基地——从他父亲被刺伤的现场开始。当他的长子弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗(Flávio Bolsonaro)在这座城市边缘的一个机场降落时，一面巴西被监禁的前总统雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗(Jair Bolsonaro)的巨幅旗帜在晨风中飘扬，这座城市很快将有助于决定地球上最大民主国家之一的未来。 “巴西群龙无首。巴西没有总统，巴西需要一位总统，而这位总统就是弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗。”这位极右翼参议员走进聚集在战场州米纳斯吉拉斯州最大城市之一茹伊斯德福拉欢迎他的支持者时宣称。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Brazil navigates a period of political uncertainty, with scandal surrounding its current leadership, the emergence of figures like Flávio Bolsonaro signals a deep yearning for decisive governance. The verse from Proverbs reminds us that the character of rulers profoundly impacts a nation's well-being, urging a discernment between those who uphold justice...
reflection.zh: 在巴西政治不确定时期，随着现任领导人深陷丑闻，弗拉维奥·博索纳罗等人物的出现，标志着人们对果断治理的深切渴望。《箴言》中的经文提醒我们，统治者的品格深刻影响着国家的福祉，并敦促我们辨别那些维护正义者与那些误导他人者。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Trump claims he is only ‘guardrail’ needed to control AI as top Republicans join him in dismissing calls for more checks – live
title.zh: 特朗普声称他才是控制人工智能所需的唯一“护栏”，而共和党高层也加入他一起驳斥要求加强监管的呼声——直播

summary.en: Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. "The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!" Trump wrote on...
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）声称，针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”正在发生，以此回应日益增长的对加强人工智能发展监管的要求。“人工智能唯一需要的控制或‘护栏’是一个强大而聪明的（高智商！）总统，而美国拥有这样的总统，而且绰绰有余！”特朗普在Truth...

body.en: President condemns what he claims is a ‘sick conspiracy’ amid global tech selloff following CEOs calls for slowing pace of development Sign up for the Breaking News US email Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump wrote on Truth Social, insisting that the administration has stopped leaders of AI companies from “doing bad, or potentially bad” things. However, he didn’t point to any concrete examples for how he has curbed possible abuse or malfeasance in the industry. There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China … We are leading China, and all others, and will continue to do so. Conspiracy Theorists, Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers, BEWARE! Continue reading...
body.zh: 在首席执行官呼吁放慢发展速度后，总统谴责了他所称的全球科技股抛售中的“病态阴谋”。唐纳德·特朗普声称存在针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”，以回应日益增长的对人工智能发展进行更严格检查的呼声。 “人工智能需要的唯一控制或‘护栏’是一位坚强而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！”特朗普在 Truth Social 上撰文，坚称政府已阻止人工智能公司领导人“做坏事或可能坏事”。然而，他没有举出任何具体例子来说明他如何遏制该行业可能存在的滥用或渎职行为。一场针对人工智能和数据中心的阴谋正在上演，唯一对此感到高兴的是中国……我们正在领导中国和所有其他国家，并将继续这样做。阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者，请当心！继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an era of rapidly advancing technology like artificial intelligence, discerning truth from falsehood and recognizing potential dangers is crucial. Proverbs 14:15 wisely advises, "The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps." This calls for careful consideration and critical thinking, rather than dismissing legitimate concerns...
reflection.zh: 在一个人工智能等技术飞速发展的时代，辨别真伪、认识潜在危险至关重要。《箴言》14:15明智地告诫：“愚蒙人凡话都信，智慧人却谨慎自己的脚步。”这呼吁我们进行审慎的思考和批判性分析，而不是将合理的担忧斥为阴谋。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Russian strike on passenger train will not deter Ukraine’s backers, Nato chief says
title.zh: 北约秘书长：俄袭击火车不会吓退乌克兰支持者

summary.en: Nato Secretary General Mark Rutte stated that a Russian drone attack on a passenger train near Ukraine's border would not deter Kyiv's western backers, calling the strike a sign of Vladimir Putin's desperation and vowing to increase support for Ukraine.
summary.zh: 北约秘书长马克·吕特表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰边境附近一列客运火车的无人机袭击不会吓退基辅的西方支持者，称此次袭击是弗拉基米尔·普京绝望的表现，并誓言增加对乌克兰的支持。

body.en: Mark Rutte says attack that narrowly missed Boris Johnson and David Petraeus shows Vladimir Putin’s desperation Europe live – latest updates The head of Nato has said a Russian drone attack on a train close to Ukraine’s border with Poland would not deter Kyiv’s western backers. Mark Rutte said the strike on a passenger train showed how desperate Vladimir Putin had become. “He thinks that he can stops us from supporting Ukraine and that he can undermine our unity. He is wrong. Our answer is to increase support,” the Nato general secretary said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 马克·鲁特表示，险些错过了鲍里斯·约翰逊和大卫·彼得雷乌斯的袭击，这表明弗拉基米尔·普京对欧洲的绝望——最新动态 北约领导人表示，俄罗斯无人机对乌克兰与波兰边境附近一列火车的袭击不会阻止基辅的西方支持者。马克·吕特表示，客运列车罢工表明弗拉基米尔·普京已经变得多么绝望。 “他认为他可以阻止我们支持乌克兰，并且可以破坏我们的团结。他错了。我们的答案是增加支持，”北约秘书长说。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news reports a Russian drone attack on a passenger train, an act of violence that could easily provoke a retaliatory response. However, Nato chief Mark Rutte declared that this act of desperation would not deter Ukraine's allies, but rather strengthen their resolve to increase support. This echoes the ancient wisdom of overcoming evil with good,...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了俄罗斯对一列客运火车发动无人机袭击，这是一种极易引发报复行为的暴力行径。然而，北约秘书长马克·吕特宣称，这一绝望之举不会吓退乌克兰的盟友，反而会坚定他们增加支持的决心。这呼应了以善胜恶的古老智慧，拒绝被卷入不断升级的暴力循环。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Ukraine and Russia have agreed not to hit energy targets, Trump claims – Europe live
title.zh: 特朗普声称乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意不袭击能源目标——欧洲实时报道

summary.en: Former US President Donald Trump claimed on his Truth Social platform that Ukraine and Russia have agreed not to target each other's energy infrastructure. He stated that Ukraine has agreed to cease strikes on Russian energy targets, and Russia will reciprocate. Trump attributed the rise in global diesel prices...
summary.zh: 美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普在他的Truth Social平台上声称，乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意不袭击对方的能源基础设施。他表示，乌克兰已同意停止袭击俄罗斯的能源目标，俄罗斯也将作出回应。特朗普将全球柴油价格上涨主要归因于俄乌战争，而非伊朗，并敦促乌克兰停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂，理由是这导致了全球短缺。

body.en:
Donald Trump has said Ukraine and Russia have agreed not to hit one another’s energy targets.

In a post on his own Truth Social platform, the US president claimed that the world’s diesel price rise is “mostly caused by the Russia-Ukraine war, not Iran”.

Ukraine has agreed not to hit Russian Energy targets. Russia has agreed to do, likewise! The World’s Diesel price rise is mostly caused by the Russia/Ukraine War, not Iran.

Trump on Sunday called on Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt strikes on Russian oil refineries and other infrastructure used to produce and distribute diesel, saying the attacks are causing a global shortage.

He spoke after diesel prices in the US hit a record on Friday, soaring past $6 a gallon on average.

Ukraine has for months been targeting Russia’s oil and gas industry with long-range strikes, prompting fuel rationing across the country and causing Moscow to ban diesel exports in July, removing supplies from the already tight global market.
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意互不侵犯对方的能源目标。 美国总统在自己的“真相社交”平台上发帖称，世界柴油价格上涨“主要是由俄罗斯和乌克兰战争造成的，而不是伊朗”。 乌克兰已同意不攻击俄罗斯能源目标。俄罗斯也同意这样做！世界柴油价格上涨主要是由俄罗斯/乌克兰战争引起的，而不是伊朗。 特朗普周日呼吁乌克兰总统泽伦斯基停止对俄罗斯炼油厂和其他用于生产和分配柴油的基础设施的袭击，称这些袭击正在导致全球柴油短缺。 他在周五美国柴油价格创下历史新高、平均飙升至每加仑 6 美元以上之后发表了讲话。 几个月来，乌克兰一直在针对俄罗斯石油和天然气行业进行远程打击，促使全国范围内实施燃料配给，并导致莫斯科于 7 月禁止柴油出口，从而消除了本已紧张的全球市场的供应。

reflection.en: In the midst of ongoing conflict, any reported agreement to de-escalate, even if claimed by a former leader, points toward the possibility of peace. Matthew 5:9 blesses those who actively pursue peace, reminding us that even small steps toward ceasing hostilities can be profoundly significant. May all parties involved find pathways to lasting reconciliation...
reflection.zh: 在持续的冲突中，任何关于缓和局势的协议，即使是由一位前领导人提出的，都指向和平的可能性。《马太福音》5章9节称赞那些积极追求和平的人，提醒我们即使是停止敌对行动的微小步骤也可能意义深远。愿所有相关方都能找到通往持久和解的道路，并结束战争造成的苦难。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
title.zh: 非洲首富启动非洲最大规模股票发行

summary.en: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote has launched the largest share sale in Africa, offering a stake in his oil refinery to the public. The move aims to allow ordinary Nigerians to share in the success of the refinery, which began production in 2024 and supplies over 70% of Nigeria's energy consumption.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚亿万富翁阿里科·丹戈特（Aliko Dangote）已启动非洲规模最大的股票发行，向公众出售其炼油厂的股份。此举旨在让普通尼日利亚人分享该炼油厂的成功，该炼油厂于2024年开始生产，供应着尼日利亚超过70%的能源消耗。

body.en:
Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote has launched Africa's largest ever share sale, offering a stake in his oil refinery to the general public in a deal that could raise as much as $2.1bn (£1.6bn).

The initial public offering (IPO) is for roughly 3% of the Dangote refinery, with the billionaire saying he wanted to give ordinary Nigerians the chance to share in the plant's success.

The refinery, which started production in 2024, is one of the largest in the world and took more than a decade to complete.

It now supplies more than 70% of Nigeria's energy consumption, and many Nigerians have expressed excitement at the prospect of owning a part of it.

Among them is Isah Salisu, who told the BBC he withdrew 50,000 naira (£28; $37) from his savings to invest.

"My hope is that my small money will one day grow big. I don't want to miss out as many I know are also investing," he said.

The IPO lasts for a month and the minimum purchase is 10 shares, costing about $4.

Economy and business expert Dr Abdulrazak Ibrahim Fagge told the BBC that Monday's event was historic.

But he warned investors that the price of the shares could fall, meaning people could lose some of their money.

"What prospective buyers, especially first-time buyers, should know is that they shouldn't invest all their money or money they would need in a couple of months," he said.

"They should invest something they could do without for the next three, four, five years."

He also warned people to be wary of scammers, saying there are people who would want to take advantage of those without good knowledge of the process.

"I will advise people to only deal with the institutions that have been listed," he said.

Nigeria is Africa's biggest oil producer but until the refinery was opened, most of the country's fuel had to be imported because of a lack of refining capacity in the country.

Born in Kano, Dangote, 67, has a net worth of around $28bn, according to Forbes magazine.

He made his fortune in cement and sugar in Nigeria before expanding to 16 other African countries.

The Lagos refinery was first announced in 2013 with an initial estimated cost of around $19bn, but construction did not begin until 2017. It was further delayed by the Covid-19 pandemic.

The site, in the Lekki Free Zone near Lagos, required massive land reclamation, with 65 million cubic metres of sand moved.

The refinery has a processing capacity of 650,000 barrels per day, making it the seventh-largest in the world.
body.zh: 尼日利亚亿万富翁阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 启动了非洲有史以来最大规模的股票出售，向公众出售其炼油厂的股份，这笔交易可能筹集高达 21 亿美元（16 亿英镑）的资金。 此次首次公开募股 (IPO) 涉及丹格特炼油厂约 3% 的股份，这位亿万富翁表示，他希望让普通尼日利亚人有机会分享该工厂的成功。 该炼油厂于 2024 年开始生产，是世界上最大的炼油厂之一，历时十多年才建成。 现在它供应尼日利亚70%以上的能源消耗，许多尼日利亚人对拥有其中一部分的前景表示兴奋。 其中包括伊萨·萨利苏 (Isah Salisu)，他告诉 BBC，他从储蓄中提取了 50,000 奈拉（28 英镑；37 美元）用于投资。 “我希望我的小钱有一天会变大。我不想错过很多我认识的人也在投资，”他说。 IPO持续一个月，最低申购数量为10股，成本约为4美元。 经济和商业专家阿卜杜勒拉扎克·易卜拉欣·法格博士告诉英国广播公司，周一的活动具有历史意义。 但他警告投资者，股价可能会下跌，这意味着人们可能会损失一些钱。 他说：“潜在买家，尤其是首次购房者，应该知道的是，他们不应该将所有资金或几个月内所需的资金投入其中。” “他们应该投资一些他们在未来三、四年、五年内不需要的东西。” 他还警告人们要警惕诈骗者，并表示有些人会想利用那些不了解整个过程的人。 “我建议人们只与已列出的机构打交道，”他说。 尼日利亚是非洲最大的石油生产国，但在炼油厂开业之前，由于该国缺乏炼油能力，该国大部分燃料都必须进口。 据《福布斯》杂志报道，67 岁的丹格特出生于卡诺，拥有约 280 亿美元的净资产。 他在尼日利亚靠水泥和糖业发家致富，随后扩展到其他 16 个非洲国家。 拉各斯炼油厂于 2013 年首次宣布，最初估计成本约为 190 亿美元，但直到 2017 年才开始建设。由于 Covid-19 大流行，建设进一步推迟。 该地点位于拉各斯附近的莱基自由区，需要进行大规模土地开垦，搬运了 6500 万立方米的沙子。 该炼油厂的加工能力为每天 65 万桶，位居世界第七。

reflection.en: Aliko Dangote's initiative to offer shares in his oil refinery to ordinary Nigerians reflects a desire to broaden the base of economic participation. This venture, a decade in the making, represents a significant undertaking where success is entrusted to future market reception and operational excellence. It echoes the wisdom of committing one's endeavors...
reflection.zh: 阿里科·丹戈特（Aliko Dangote）将石油炼油厂的股份提供给普通尼日利亚人的举措，体现了扩大经济参与基础的愿望。这项历时十年才完成的事业，代表着一项重大工程，其成功寄托于未来的市场接受度和卓越运营。这呼应了将人的努力托付于更高力量、寻求工作指导和祝福的智慧。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Ukraine, Russia set for new round of US-mediated talks
title.zh: 乌克兰、俄罗斯准备进行新一轮美国斡旋会谈

summary.en: New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.
summary.zh: 据基辅和莫斯科称，乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国之间的新三边会谈可能于10月开始。尽管很少有人期望取得突破，但乌克兰正寻求部分降级局势，以帮助其度过冬天。

body.en:
New trilateral talks between Ukraine, Russia and the US could begin in October, according to Kyiv and Moscow. Few expect a breakthrough, but Ukraine is seeking a partial de-escalation to help it get through the winter.

Ukraine and Russia have signaled their readiness to resume trilateral talks under US mediation.

"We're preparing. For October," said Kyrylo Budanov, head of the Ukrainian president's office.

Similar signals came from Moscow: "We do not rule out such a possibility. We are talking about the foreseeable future," Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said.

US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner aimed to revive trilateral talks to end Russia's war in Ukraine , visiting Moscow and Kyiv in the first week of September.

The last round of trilateral talks took place in January and February 2026 in Abu Dhabi and Geneva , without producing a breakthrough, as the issue of territory control in eastern Ukraine remained unresolved.

Vladimir Putin still demands more territory than Russia currently controls, Kushner confirmed on September 12, speaking online at the YES security conference in Kyiv.

"President Putin [has] laid out his line of what he wants to achieve. If Ukraine wanted to withdraw to that line, then obviously we have the rest of the deal set up and put together. Ukraine right now does not want to do that," the US envoy said.

The Ukrainian government has indicated it is willing to freeze the fighting along the current frontline in exchange for security guarantees. Such a step could be supported by 60% of Ukrainians, according to a poll by the Kyiv International Institute of Sociology conducted in summer 2026. A similar majority of respondents rejected giving up territory that Russia hasn't been able to conquer. 33% said Ukraine should give up territory that Putin demands.

"For there to be a negotiated end to the war, there has to be parity. Right now, there's a stalemate on the front lines and not much is changing there, but in the air war, unfortunately, Russia currently has a significant advantage," Volodymyr Fesenko, a Kyiv-based political scientist, told DW. 

Ukraine is running low on interceptors for Russian ballistic missiles. Russia has also stepped up attacks with new jet-powered drones, which fly faster than older gasoline-powered models and are harder to intercept.

Russian airstrikes are increasingly targeting Ukraine's economy, including warehouses, energy facilities, gas stations and railway infrastructure.

The Kremlin has accused Ukraine of opening a "Pandora's box" by targeting Russia's economy and fuel and energy facilities with deep strikes since the summer. Ukraine says the attacks are intended to force Russia to the negotiating table.

"The escalation ... is not a problem. It's a sign of...
body.zh: 据基辅和莫斯科称，乌克兰、俄罗斯和美国之间的新三边会谈可能于十月开始。很少有人预计会取得突破，但乌克兰正在寻求部分缓和局势以帮助其度过冬天。 乌克兰和俄罗斯已表示愿意在美国的调解下恢复三边会谈。 乌克兰总统办公室主任基里洛·布达诺夫(Kyrylo Budanov)表示：“我们正在为十月份做准备。” 莫斯科也发出了类似的信号：“我们不排除这种可能性。我们正在谈论可预见的未来，”克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫说。 美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫（Steve Witkoff）和贾里德·库什纳（Jared Kushner）旨在重启三边会谈，以结束俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争，他们于九月的第一周访问了莫斯科和基辅。 上一轮三边会谈于2026年1月和2026年2月在阿布扎比和日内瓦举行，但由于乌克兰东部领土控制问题仍未解决，未能取得突破。 库什纳 9 月 12 日在基辅举行的 YES 安全会议上在线发表讲话时证实，弗拉基米尔·普京仍然要求获得比俄罗斯目前控制的更多的领土。 “普京总统已经制定了他想要实现的目标。如果乌克兰想撤回这条线，那么显然我们已经制定并整合了协议的其余部分。乌克兰现在不想这样做，”美国特使说。 乌克兰政府表示愿意冻结当前前线的战斗，以换取安全保障。根据基辅国际社会学研究所 2026 年夏季进行的一项民意调查，这一举措可能会得到 60% 的乌克兰人的支持。类似的大多数受访者拒绝放弃俄罗斯尚未征服的领土。 33%的人表示乌克兰应该放弃普京要求的领土。 基辅政治学家弗拉基米尔·费先科(Volodymyr Fesenko)告诉德国之声：“要通过谈判结束战争，就必须实现对等。目前，前线陷入僵局，没有太大变化，但不幸的是，在空战中，俄罗斯目前拥有显着优势。” 乌克兰的俄罗斯弹道导弹拦截器所剩无几。俄罗斯还加大了新型喷气式无人机的攻击力度，这种无人机比老式汽油动力无人机飞行速度更快，而且更难拦截。 俄罗斯空袭越来越多地针对乌克兰经济，包括仓库、能源设施、加油站和铁路基础设施。 克里姆林宫指责乌克兰自夏季以来对俄罗斯经济以及燃料和能源设施进行深度打击，打开了“潘多拉魔盒”。乌克兰表示，这些袭击旨在迫使俄罗斯坐到谈判桌前。 “升级……不是问题。这是……的迹象。”

reflection.en: As Ukraine and Russia signal readiness for new US-mediated talks, the pursuit of peace, even amidst deep conflict and low expectations, is a vital step. Romans 12:18 reminds us to 'live in peace with everyone, as much as it is possible.' These diplomatic efforts, however tentative, embody that call to actively seek peace.
reflection.zh: 随着乌克兰和俄罗斯表示愿意进行美国斡旋的新一轮会谈，对和平的追求，即使在深层冲突和低期望的背景下，也是至关重要的一步。罗马书12:18提醒我们“务要随众人和睦”。这些外交努力，无论多么初步，都体现了积极寻求和平的呼召。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Flash flooding interrupts half-marathon, submerges cars
title.zh: 洪水突袭半程马拉松，汽车被淹

summary.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding, leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners battling the floodwaters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS...
summary.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州的部分地区遭遇了山洪暴发，导致了水上救援、车辆滞留以及半程马拉松选手在洪水中艰难前行。据英国广播公司（BBC）的合作伙伴CBS新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员称该州部分地区在极短时间内降雨量高达七英寸。

body.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners struggling through waist-deep flood waters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS News.
body.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州部分地区遭受山洪袭击，导致水上救援、被困的驾车者和半程马拉松运动员在齐腰深的洪水中挣扎。据 BBC 合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员表示，该州部分地区在很短的时间内降雨量高达 7 英寸。

reflection.en: The sudden and intense flash flooding in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut brought chaos and danger, submerging cars and forcing runners to battle waist-deep water. In moments of overwhelming natural disaster, when the earth itself seems to shift, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a help readily found in times of distress. May...
reflection.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州突如其来的强烈山洪暴发带来了混乱和危险，淹没了汽车，迫使跑者在齐腰深的水中艰难前行。在压倒性的自然灾害面前，当大地似乎都在动摇时，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是在患难中随时可得的帮助。 愿受影响的人们找到安全并迅速恢复。面对如此强大的力量，我们可以转向神圣的慰藉和力量，即使脚下的土地不稳定，也能信靠那依然坚定的存在。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Body of missing runner found in South Africa
title.zh: 失踪跑步者遗体在南非被发现

summary.en: A nationwide appeal was launched after Elizabeth Moselakgomo went missing last week. Her body was identified on Monday. She is one of five women whose bodies have been found in the Kempton Park area, east of Johannesburg, with police issuing a public warning due to the concerning similarities.
summary.zh: 上周伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫失踪后，全国发起了搜寻呼吁。她的遗体于周一被确认。她是东兰德约翰内斯堡地区肯普顿公园地区发现的五名女性遗体中的一人，警方因令人担忧的相似之处发出了公众警告。

body.en:
South African police have confirmed the death of a jogger, who went missing during a routine run last week, sparking a nationwide appeal for help finding her.

The body of Elizabeth Moselakgomo was identified by her relatives on Monday after it was discovered east of Johannesburg on Saturday. She is one of five women whose bodies have been found half-naked and bruised in the same area, Kempton Park.

Police said they were not linking the deaths to a serial killer but added that the "similarities are sufficiently concerning… to issue a public warning".

A jogger who knew Moselakgomo through their running club told the BBC the discovery of the five bodies was "very scary".

"It's sad to know that every woman in South Africa… can't just go outside. You can't just go to the shop and buy flowers… because you are always in danger," said Keamo Sefularo.

Police have urged women in the Kempton Park area to avoid walking or running alone "particularly in isolated areas".

South Africa experiences some of the world's highest levels of gender-based violence (GBV), with the rate at which women are killed five times higher than the global average, according to UN Women.

Moselakgomo's body was found on Saturday night, badly bruised and partially clothed.

Just hours earlier on Monday, another woman's half-naked body was found about 25km (15 miles) away.

The latest discovery was made by a passer-by, who spotted the body on his way to work, police spokesperson Brig Athlenda Mathe told reporters at the scene.

One arrest has been made in connection with the discovery of the first body. The person is still in police custody.

The police have since set up a task team to investigate the murders but these grim discoveries and Moselakgomo's death have sparked renewed outrage and fear among South Africans.

Tributes poured in for the avid runner, affectionately known as "Tsontso" after police confirmed her death. South Africans also shared the fear and anxiety women often feel in the country.

Lesedi Ledwaba, in a post on X, said: "Women are not free if we have to calculate where, when and with whom we can walk, run or exist safely".

This was echoed by Sefularo, who said Moselakgomo's disappearance had been "heavy for the club".

The 29-year-old also asked whether Moselakgomo would "still be here if maybe she had a small community to run with [or] one or three people"?

"As we always say, when we go out for runs, there's safety in numbers," she reflected.

Sefularo shared the measures she often took to keep safe while running, including avoiding taking the same route each day and making sure she ran in areas with good visibility.

Advocacy group Women for Change said the discovery of these bodies was angering.

"What is the purpose of having a protective service like...
body.zh: 南非警方证实了一名慢跑者的死亡，这名慢跑者在上周的例行跑步中失踪，引发了全国范围内寻求帮助寻找她的呼吁。 伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫的尸体于周六在约翰内斯堡东部被发现，周一由她的亲属确认身份。她是在肯普顿公园同一地区被发现的五名半裸、遍体鳞伤的女性之一。 警方表示，他们并未将这些死亡事件与连环杀手联系起来，但补充说，“这些相似之处足以令人担忧……需要发出公开警告”。 一位通过跑步俱乐部认识莫塞拉克莫的慢跑者告诉英国广播公司，发现五具尸体“非常可怕”。 “令人遗憾的是，南非的每个女性......都不能出去。你不能只是去商店买花......因为你总是处于危险之中，”Keamo Sefularo 说。 警方敦促肯普顿公园地区的妇女避免独自行走或跑步，“尤其是在偏僻地区”。 据联合国妇女署称，南非是世界上性别暴力（GBV）最严重的国家之一，妇女被杀的比率是全球平均水平的五倍。 莫塞拉科莫的尸体于周六晚上被发现，身上伤痕累累，衣服也只剩下部分衣服。 就在周一几个小时前，另一名女性半裸尸体在约 25 公里（15 英里）外被发现。 警方发言人布里格·阿特伦达·马特在现场告诉记者，最新的发现是一名路人在上班途中发现了尸体。 因发现第一具尸体而逮捕了一名人员。该人仍被警方拘留。 此后，警方成立了一个工作组来调查这起谋杀案，但这些可怕的发现和莫塞拉科莫的死亡再次引发了南非人的愤怒和恐惧。 警方确认她死亡后，人们纷纷向这位狂热的跑步者表示哀悼，人们亲切地称她为“Tsontso”。南非人也和该国女性一样感到恐惧和焦虑。 Lesedi Ledwaba 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示：“如果我们必须计算我们可以在哪里、何时以及与谁一起安全地行走、跑步或生存，那么女性就不自由”。 塞夫拉罗对此表示赞同，他表示莫塞拉科莫的失踪“对俱乐部来说是沉重的打击”。 这位 29 岁的年轻人还问，莫塞拉科莫“如果她有一个小社区可以和一三个人一起经营的话，她是否还会在这里”？ “正如我们常说的，当我们出去跑步时，人多才安全，”她反思道。 Sefularo 分享了她在跑步时经常采取的确保安全的措施，包括避免每天走同一条路线，并确保在能见度良好的区域跑步。 倡导组织“女性变革”表示，这些尸体的发现令人愤怒。 “提供像这样的保护服务的目的是什么......

reflection.en: The discovery of Elizabeth Moselakgomo's body, alongside four other women in the Kempton Park area, is a tragic reminder of the violence that can prey on the vulnerable. The prophet Isaiah's call to 'learn to do good; seek justice, correct oppression; bring relief to the oppressed, give justice to the fatherless, plead for the widow' speaks to the deep...
reflection.zh: 伊丽莎白·莫塞拉科莫的遗体在约翰内斯堡以东的肯普顿公园地区与其他四名女性的遗体一同被发现，这令人悲痛地提醒我们，弱势群体可能遭受的暴力。先知以赛亚呼吁“你们要学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的，给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇争辩”，这呼应了人类对安全和保护的深切需求，尤其是对那些最处于危险中的人。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: IPO 'for the people' is out of reach for many in Nigeria
title.zh: “人民的”首次公开募股对尼日利亚许多人来说遥不可及

summary.en: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?
summary.zh: 丹格特寻求投资者16亿美元，为其143亿美元的扩张融资，从而使炼油厂的产能翻倍。此次发行可能使数百万尼日利亚人获得该公司股份。但谁又能真正负担得起呢？

body.en:
Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery's capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?

The industrialist Aliko Dangote is turning to Nigerians to help finance the next growth phase of his oil refinery: The richest man in Africa announced that he is seeking to attract about $1.6 billion (€1.4 billion) by going public.

This initial public offering of Dangote Industries is intended to help support a $14.3 billion expansion, which would more than double the refinery's production capacity. In absolute numbers, it would increase capacity from 700,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 1.4 million bpd.

It would also include new petrochemical and refining units designed to reduce Nigeria 's reliance on imports of some petrochemical products while also allowing the plant to produce different grades of diesel.

This plan would make the refinery one of the largest single-site refining complexes in the world.

Dangote's ambitious plans also include the launch of a processing plant in Kenya to extend his reach from the Atlantic to the Indian Ocean, which is planned to be launched in partnership with governments in eastern Africa.

Since it began operations in 2024, the Dangote Petroleum Refinery has started to reshape Nigeria's fuel market, and has become one of the few businesses in the world to benefit from the ongoing supply disruptions caused by the war in Iran.

The refinery has become an important supplier of petrol and other fuels domestically and abroad; in fact, it made Nigeria a net exporter of refined fuel for the first time after reaching its full capacity in early 2026.

The refinery reported making an after-tax profit of $1.82 ​billion in the first half ​of 2026, following ⁠a $476 million loss for all of 2025.

Things appear to be on the up-and-up for Dangote — so, why is the company seeking public investment now?

Ayodele Oni, an energy analyst and partner with the Bloomfield Law Practice in Lagos, told DW that the public offering could be a "game changer," as it alters the role of who could stand to benefit from Dangote's expansion drive.

Oni said equity invested by potentially millions of Nigerian and international shareholders would shield the corporation from having to rely solely on expensive dollar debt "with permanent Naira capital, which matches a business now earning heavily in Naira."

This could also unlock additional long-term investment as any "listed company answers to ... its shareholders every quarter." "That transparency is precisely what long-term lenders and international partners want to see before the next billion is committed," Oni said.

He said this would turn into a sustainable model for...
body.zh: 丹格特向投资者寻求 16 亿美元的资金，以资助 ​​143 亿美元的扩建，从而将炼油厂的产能提高一倍。该报价可能会让数百万尼日利亚人获得该公司的股份。但谁能真正负担得起呢？ 实业家阿利科·丹格特 (Aliko Dangote) 正在向尼日利亚人寻求帮助，为他的炼油厂下一阶段的发展提供资金：这位非洲首富宣布，他正在寻求通过上市吸引约 16 亿美元（14 亿欧元）的资金。 Dangote Industries 的此次首次公开募股旨在帮助支持 143 亿美元的扩张，这将使炼油厂的产能增加一倍以上。从绝对数字来看，产能将从 70 万桶/日增加到 140 万桶/日。 它还将包括新的石化和炼油装置，旨在减少尼日利亚对某些石化产品进口的依赖，同时允许该工厂生产不同等级的柴油。 该计划将使该炼油厂成为世界上最大的单一炼油厂之一。 丹格特雄心勃勃的计划还包括在肯尼亚建立一家加工厂，将其业务范围从大西洋扩展到印度洋，该工厂计划与东非各国政府合作启动。 自2024年开始运营以来，丹格特炼油厂开始重塑尼日利亚的燃料市场，并成为世界上少数受益于伊朗战争造成的持续供应中断的企业之一。 炼油厂已成为国内外汽油及其他燃料的重要供应商；事实上，这使尼日利亚在 2026 年初达到满负荷生产后首次成为精炼燃料净出口国。 该炼油厂报告称，2026 年上半年实现税后利润 18.2 亿美元，而 2025 年全年亏损 4.76 亿美元。 丹格特的情况似乎正在好转——那么，为什么该公司现在寻求公共投资呢？ 拉各斯布卢姆菲尔德律师事务所合伙人、能源分析师阿约德勒·奥尼 (Ayodele Oni) 告诉德国之声，此次公开发行可能会“改变游戏规则”，因为它改变了谁可以从丹格特扩张计划中受益。 奥尼表示，潜在的数百万尼日利亚和国际股东投资的股权将使该公司不必完全依赖昂贵的美元债务，“拥有永久的奈拉资本，这与目前在奈拉赚取巨额利润的企业相匹配”。 这还可以释放额外的长期投资，因为任何“上市公司每个季度都会对其股东做出回应”。奥尼表示：“这种透明度正是长期贷款机构和国际合作伙伴在承诺下一个十亿资金之前希望看到的。” 他说这将成为一个可持续的模式......

reflection.en: This news about Dangote's refinery expansion and its initial public offering (IPO) raises questions about economic fairness. While the goal is to offer shares to millions of Nigerians, the substantial investment required may place it out of reach for many. The proverb "Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights are his delight" speaks to the...
reflection.zh: 关于丹格特炼油厂扩张及其首次公开募股（IPO）的新闻，引发了对经济公平的疑问。虽然目标是向数百万尼日利亚人提供股份，但所需的大笔投资可能使许多人望而却步。《雅伟憎恶欺诈的天平，但公平的砝码是他的喜悦》这句箴言，强调了在包括金融市场在内的所有交易中，诚信和公平的重要性，确保机会真正惠及大众，而不仅仅是少数特权人士。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
title.zh: 野狗为寻找配偶穿越赞比亚，创下2500英里长途跋涉纪录

summary.en: Scientists report that three brothers from a pack of African wild dogs have completed a record-breaking journey of nearly 2,500 miles across Zambia in search of a mate. This remarkable feat offers hope for wildlife survival amidst increasing human pressures, though the study also highlights dangers like illegal...
summary.zh: 科学家报道，一群非洲野狗中的三只兄弟完成了穿越赞比亚、近2500英里的创纪录旅程，以寻找配偶。这一非凡的壮举在日益增长的人类压力下为野生动物的生存带来了希望，但研究也凸显了非法陷阱等危险，这不幸地终结了三只姐妹的旅程。

body.en:
A pack of African wild dogs has completed a record-breaking 2,485-mile (4000km) journey across the continent.

Scientists say it is the furthest recorded distance for any African land mammal searching for a mate, offering hope that wildlife can travel across vast distances despite growing human pressures.

The three brothers zigzagged across Zambia, navigating a landscape increasingly shaped by people and avoiding obstacles including major cities.

However, other wild dogs tracked with GPS collars in the study died in illegal snares, underlining the dangers they face.

Three sisters almost completed an equally epic journey, but stopped when one became trapped in a snare.

African wild dogs are among Africa's rarest predators, with only about 6,000 remaining in the wild.

They live in highly social packs, hunt together and are known for their vast roaming in search of new territory and breeding opportunities with other packs.

They cannot breed within the pack they are born into, so they either wait and may eventually inherit their pack, or set off at the age of two or three in search of a mate.

The brothers covered about 260 miles in a straight line over the course of eight months, but travelled nearly 10 times that overall while crossing through a broken-up landscape.

These sorts of journeys are known as dispersals - travelling one way in search of a mate, which is a behaviour distinct from migrations, where animals move back and forth with the seasons in search of food or habitat.

The UN Convention on Migratory Species identifies Africa's longest migrations as wildebeest moving seasonally between Tanzania and Kenya in search of grazing and water covering more than 400 miles.

Globally, caribou undertake the longest single land migrations of any animal - travelling 839 miles in a round trip, while grey wolves have been recorded travelling more than 4,350 miles over a year.

Perhaps even more significant than the distance itself was the route the wild dogs took through Zambia.

They moved between wildlife strongholds, skirting areas containing major human obstacles, including the capital, Lusaka, and heavily developed industrial areas.

The findings suggest wild dog populations across eastern and southern Africa may remain more connected than conservationists previously believed.

Professor Scott Creel of Montana State University, the paper's lead author, who has been studying African wild dogs since 1991, said the study provides cautious optimism.

"It's plausible to believe that every major wild dog population in eastern and southern Africa, other than fenced ones, are potentially connected," he said.

But he said, in conservation,"the glass is half empty and the glass is half full", highlighting the threat of poaching snares.

While the three...
body.zh: 一群非洲野狗完成了穿越非洲大陆 2,485 英里（4000 公里）的破纪录旅程。 科学家表示，这是有记录以来非洲陆地哺乳动物寻找配偶的最远距离，这为野生动物在人类压力日益增大的情况下进行长途旅行带来了希望。 三兄弟蜿蜒穿越赞比亚，在日益被人类塑造的风景中航行，并避开包括大城市在内的障碍。 然而，研究中使用 GPS 项圈追踪的其他野狗却死于非法陷阱中，这突显了它们面临的危险。 三姐妹几乎完成了同样史诗般的旅程，但当其中一人陷入陷阱时停止了。 非洲野狗是非洲最稀有的掠食者之一，野外仅存约 6,000 只。 它们生活在高度社会化的群体中，一起狩猎，并以广泛漫游寻找新领地和与其他群体繁殖的机会而闻名。 它们无法在出生的群体中繁殖，因此它们要么等待并最终继承自己的群体，要么在两三岁时出发寻找配偶。 兄弟俩在 8 个月的时间里直线行驶了约 260 英里，但在穿越一片破碎的土地时，总行程几乎是这一里程的 10 倍。 这些类型的旅行被称为分散——单向旅行以寻找配偶，这是一种与迁徙不同的行为，迁徙中动物随着季节来回移动以寻找食物或栖息地。 《联合国迁徙物种公约》将非洲最长的迁徙活动定为角马，它们季节性地在坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚之间迁徙，寻找牧场和水源，迁徙范围超过 400 英里。 在全球范围内，驯鹿在所有动物中进行了最长的单次陆地迁徙——一次往返行程 839 英里，而灰狼据记录一年行程超过 4,350 英里。 也许比距离本身更重要的是野狗穿越赞比亚的路线。 他们在野生动物据点之间移动，绕过有主要人类障碍的地区，包括首都卢萨卡和高度发达的工业区。 研究结果表明，东部和南部非洲的野狗种群之间的联系可能比自然资源保护主义者之前认为的更加紧密。 该论文的主要作者、蒙大拿州立大学的斯科特·克里尔教授自 1991 年以来一直在研究非洲野狗，他表示这项研究提供了谨慎的乐观态度。 他说：“有理由相信，除了围栏内的野狗之外，东部和南部非洲的所有主要野狗种群都可能存在联系。” 但他表示，在保护方面，“玻璃杯是半空的，玻璃杯是半满的”，强调了偷猎陷阱的威胁。 虽然三人...

reflection.en: The incredible journey of these wild dogs, navigating a human-shaped landscape to find a mate, speaks to the deep, instinctual drives woven into creation. Their remarkable trek across Zambia is a testament to the intricate design and resilience of life, revealing the Creator's power and wisdom in the natural world. Even amidst human pressures, such journeys...
reflection.zh: 这些野狗为了寻找配偶，穿越人类塑造的地貌，它们令人难以置信的旅程，体现了生命中深刻的本能驱动力。它们在赞比亚的非凡跋涉，证明了生命精妙的设计和韧性，揭示了造物主在自然界中的大能和智慧。即使在人类的压力之下，这样的旅程也提醒我们雅伟创造的永恒奇迹。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
title.zh: 俄乌边境一列车遭袭，此前约翰逊等官员刚乘火车离开

summary.en: A Russian drone struck a train engine near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and other European security officials had passed through on a different train. No casualties were reported as passengers had been evacuated. Russia stated it targeted "railway infrastructure,"...
summary.zh: 一架俄罗斯无人机在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊及其他欧洲安全官员乘坐的火车离开后不久，袭击了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列火车引擎。由于乘客已疏散，未报告伤亡。俄罗斯称袭击了“铁路基础设施”，而乌克兰则表示无人机可能瞄准了离开的官员。

body.en:
A Russian drone has hit a train near the Ukraine-Poland border shortly after former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and top European security officials had passed through.

No casualties were reported after the strike at Yahodyn, which hit the train's engine. All the passengers had been evacuated, Ukrainian authorities said.

Johnson and other European national security advisers, including the UK's Jonathan Powell, had passed along the same line on a different train on their way back from a conference in Kyiv.

Russia's defence ministry said it had struck "railway infrastructure" in western Ukraine, but Ukraine's state railway company Ukrzaliznytsia said the drone's target "could have been the diplomatic train".

Professor Katarzyna Pisarska, chair of the Warsaw Security Forum, told the BBC she was in the same carriage as Johnson and Powell, and the attack had happened about 30 minutes after their train had crossed into the Polish border.

In a statement, Ukraine's railway authority Ukrzaliznytsia said the diplomatic train "had left the station earlier than expected because of the timetable change... due to constant threats of Russian strikes".

It also said that an evacuation order for passengers on the hit train had been given "just 15 minutes" before the strike by a Russian jet-propelled drone.

Former CIA chief David Petraeus, who had been on board another train at Yahodyn station at the time of the strike, said the incident was "terrifying".

In an interview with the New York Times, Petraeus said: "This is the act of a truly barbaric leader trying to terrorise Ukrainian civilians."

Both Ukrainian and Polish authorities said the Russian drone had struck 2km (1.2 miles) from the Polish border.

Johnson wrote on X: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning.

He said this was "the kind of random and senseless attack Ukrainians are enduring every day - even on civilian railways" and urged Kyiv's allies to urgently provide Ukrainians "the air defences they need".

Ukraine has made repeated pleas to its allies - particularly the US - to provide more interceptors to defend against daily Russian attacks that increasingly use fast-moving ballistic missiles and jet-propelled drones.

Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the "barbaric strikes" at the Ukraine-Poland border in Yahodyn amounted to "[Russian President Vladimir] Putin's terror 'knocking' directly on the doors of the EU and Nato" and renewed calls for more sanctions on Moscow.

In Poland, Prime Minister Donald Tusk held an emergency meeting to discuss the latest developments, saying that Russian actions were "getting closer and closer to our border."

Meanwhile, the EU's foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas...
body.zh: 在英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊和欧洲高级安全官员经过乌克兰-波兰边境后不久，一架俄罗斯无人机撞上了乌克兰-波兰边境附近的一列火车。 雅霍丁的袭击击中了火车的引擎，但没有造成人员伤亡的报道。乌克兰当局表示，所有乘客已被疏散。 约翰逊和其他欧洲国家安全顾问，包括英国的乔纳森·鲍威尔，在从基辅参加会议返回途中乘坐另一列火车沿着同一条线路经过。 俄罗斯称其袭击了乌克兰西部的“铁路基础设施”，但乌克兰国家铁路公司Ukrzaliznytsia表示，“这架无人机的目标很可能是外交列车”。 它在一份声明中表示，这列火车“由于时刻表的变化……由于俄罗斯持续的罢工威胁，比预期更早离开了车站”。 它还表示，在袭击发生前“仅15分钟”，一架俄罗斯喷气式无人机就向被撞列车上的乘客下达了疏散命令。 铁路部门还表示，无人机袭击发生时，前中央情报局局长戴维·彼得雷乌斯正在雅霍丁车站的另一列火车上。 乌克兰和波兰当局均表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击了距离波兰边境2公里的地方。 瑞典前首相卡尔·比尔特也参加了在基辅举行的会议，他告诉英国广播公司，他的火车上的乘客已被告知准备撤离，然后才被允许继续他们的旅程。 “在我乘坐的火车上，我们接到命令，在火车停下后准备撤离。但几分钟后，我们被告知情况已经清楚，我们可以继续前进，”他说。 一些报道称比尔特与约翰逊乘坐同一列火车，但这位英国前首相尚未证实任何细节。 约翰逊在X上写道：“我不知道是什么扭曲的逻辑促使普京今天早上炸毁了波兰边境上一辆静止的乌克兰机车。 他说，这是“乌克兰人每天都在遭受的那种随机和毫无意义的袭击——即使是在民用铁路上”。 约翰逊还表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京“对乌克兰1700名工作人员的死亡负有责任”，并敦促基辅的盟友紧急向乌克兰提供“他们需要的防空系统”。 乌克兰一再请求其盟友——特别是美国——提供更多拦截器，以防御俄罗斯越来越多地使用快速弹道导弹和喷气式无人机的日常攻击。 乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈表示，雅霍丁乌克兰-波兰边境的“野蛮袭击”相当于“普京的恐怖直接‘敲击’了欧盟和北约的大门”，并再次呼吁对莫斯科实施更多制裁。 “普京需要...

reflection.en: The attack on the train, occurring just after important figures had passed, evokes the grim logic of conflict where every action seems to invite a counter-action. The temptation to respond with escalating force is ever-present in such cycles. Yet, the call remains to overcome evil not by mirroring it, but by choosing a different path, even when it seems...
reflection.zh: 袭击火车，发生在重要人物刚刚经过之后，这让人联想到冲突中严峻的报复逻辑，似乎每一个行动都会招致反击。在这样的循环中，以升级武力回应的诱惑无处不在。然而，呼召依然是不要以恶报恶，而是选择另一条道路，即使这条道路看起来不可能。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Nepal: thousands still missing as flood recovery begins
title.zh: 尼泊尔：洪水恢复工作开始，仍有数千人失踪

summary.en: Nepal is transitioning from rescue to recovery efforts after deadly flash floods swept through the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli river corridor. Authorities have recovered 1,386 bodies, with over 5,130 people still missing, including foreign nationals and workers. The nation faces a $4.8 billion reconstruction bill and renewed...
summary.zh: 尼泊尔正从救援行动转向恢复工作，此前致命的洪水冲毁了Bhotekoshi-Trishuli河走廊。当局已找到1386具遗体，仍有超过5130人失踪，其中包括外国公民和工人。该国面临48亿美元的重建账单，并再次呼吁气候正义。

body.en:
The Himalayan nation is moving from rescue operations to recovery, facing a $4.8 billion reconstruction bill amid renewed calls for climate justice.

Nearly three weeks after deadly flash floods swept through Nepal's Bhotekoshi-Trishuli river corridor near the Chinese border , the Himalayan nation is shifting from search-and-rescue operations to relief and reconstruction efforts.

Authorities in Nepal say at least 1,386 bodies have been recovered across five affected districts, while more than 5,130 people are still missing. The latter figure includes 587 foreign nationals and around 900 workers employed in hydropower tunnels and other energy facilities.

The deluge, which authorities say was triggered by a glacier collapse , devastated communities and swept away more than a dozen hydropower facilities. As search operations continue in submerged tunnels and along muddy riverbanks, families are growing increasingly desperate for news of missing loved ones.

The scale of human loss is particularly stark in the upper river basins, where entire settlements vanished within minutes. In many places, destroyed roads and bridges have cut off access, forcing rescue and relief teams to rely on helicopters to deliver essential supplies.

Niranjan Paudyal, a resident of Sole village in Nepal's Nuwakot District who lost his parents, uncle, aunt and sister in the flash floods , said the flood took away even the chance of burying his family members.

"We spent days searching through debris, hoping for signs of my missing parents and family," he told DW. "Sadly, the disaster left us with no choice but to perform their final rites without their bodies."

Public land in Uttargaya Rural Municipality in Rasuwa District has either been washed away or rendered unsafe.

"There is not even land left after the flood to perform the final rites of those who lost their lives," Chameli Gurung, the municipality's deputy chair, told DW. "Relatives have to travel to Kathmandu's Pashupati Aryaghat to perform the final rites."

In Uttargaya alone, at least 618 houses were swept away or buried and 877 people remain missing. Only 12 bodies have been recovered. Gurung said local authorities are exploring the possibility of leasing private land to accommodate displaced families before winter.

Nepal's communication minister, Bikram Timilsina, told DW that affected people are being resettled close to their original homes by securing nearby public or private land and providing financial assistance based on household size until they can become self-reliant.

As emergency relief efforts begin to stabilize, Nepal faces a massive financial burden. A preliminary rapid damage and needs assessment (RDNA) puts the total reconstruction requirement at about 723.3 billion Nepalese rupees...
body.zh: 这个喜马拉雅山国家正在从救援行动转向恢复，在人们重新呼吁气候正义的背景下，面临着 48 亿美元的重建费用。 致命的山洪席卷了靠近中国边境的尼泊尔博特科希-特里舒利河走廊近三周后，这个喜马拉雅国家正在从搜救行动转向救援和重建工作。 尼泊尔当局表示，已在五个受影响地区找到至少 1,386 具尸体，仍有 5,130 多人失踪。后者包括 587 名外国人和约 900 名在水电隧道和其他能源设施工作的工人。 当局称这场洪水是由冰川崩塌引发的，洪水摧毁了社区，并冲毁了十多个水力发电设施。随着水下隧道和泥泞河岸的搜寻工作继续进行，许多家庭越来越渴望失踪亲人的消息。 上游流域的人口损失尤为严重，整个定居点在几分钟内就消失了。在许多地方，道路和桥梁被毁，通道被切断，救援队伍只能依靠直升机运送必需品。 尼泊尔努瓦科特区索勒村的居民尼兰詹·鲍迪亚尔在山洪中失去了父母、叔叔、阿姨和妹妹。他说，洪水甚至夺去了埋葬家人的机会。 他告诉德国之声：“我们花了几天时间在废墟中搜寻，希望能找到我失踪的父母和家人的踪迹。” “可悲的是，这场灾难让我们别无选择，只能在没有他们尸体的情况下进行最后的仪式。” 拉苏瓦区乌塔加亚乡村市的公共土地要么被冲走，要么变得不安全。 市政府副主席查梅利·古隆 (Chameli Gurung) 告诉德国之声：“洪水过后，甚至连为遇难者举行最后仪式的土地都没有了。” “亲戚们必须前往加德满都的 Pashupati Aryaghat 举行最后的仪式。” 仅在 Uttagaya，至少有 618 所房屋被冲走或掩埋，877 人仍然失踪。仅找到12具尸体。 古隆说，地方当局正在探索在冬季之前租赁私人土地以安置流离失所家庭的可能性。 尼泊尔通讯部长比克拉姆·蒂米尔西纳(Bikram Timilsina)告诉德国之声，受影响的人们正在被重新安置在他们原来的家园附近，他们会获得附近的公共或私人土地，并根据家庭人数提供财政援助，直到他们能够自力更生。 随着紧急救援工作开始稳定，尼泊尔面临着巨大的财政负担。初步的快速损害和需求评估 (RDNA) 表明重建总需求约为 7,233 亿尼泊尔卢比……

This situation calls for profound compassion and practical aid, embodying the call to share our bread with the hungry and bring the homeless poor into our homes. May those affected find solace and support as recovery...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔毁灭性的洪水留下了悲伤的痕迹，仍有数千人失踪，国家面临着艰巨的重建任务。这种情况呼唤着深切的同情和实际的援助，体现了与饥饿者分享食物、将无家可归的穷人接到家中的呼召。愿受灾者在恢复工作开始之际找到安慰和支持。

verse.textEn: Is it not to share your food with the hungry and to provide the poor wanderer with shelter — when you see the naked, to clothe them?
verse.textZh: 不是要把你的饼分给饥饿的人，将飘流的穷人接到你家中，见赤身的给他衣服遮体？

title.en: EU leaders urge unity after Russian strike on train
title.zh: 欧盟领导人呼吁团结，以应对俄罗斯袭击火车事件

summary.en: A Russian drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has prompted EU leaders to call for increased support for Kyiv. The bloc's top diplomat urged allies to demonstrate they are 'not scared,' framing the strike as an attempt by Moscow to intimidate Ukraine's supporters.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰与波兰边境附近一列火车的无人机袭击，促使欧盟领导人呼吁增加对基辅的支持。欧盟最高外交官敦促盟友表明他们“不怕”，并将此次袭击定性为莫斯科试图恐吓乌克兰支持者。

body.en:
Russia's drone attack on a train near the Ukraine-Poland border has triggered EU calls to up support for Kyiv. Allies of Ukraine should show they "are not scared," said the bloc's top diplomat, Kaja Kallas.

Several top EU politicians have called a Russian drone strike on a passenger train ​on Ukraine's border with Poland a bid by Moscow to intimidate Kyiv's allies that should be met with even more resolution.

In the incident, a drone hit the train's locomotive at a railway station in the Volyn region, some 2 kilometers (1.24 miles) from the border, shortly after a diplomatic ‌train carrying former British ​Prime ⁠Minister Boris Johnson and other ⁠European ​diplomats had been at the station.

"It [the attack] is clearly meant to scare Western countries from supporting Ukraine, from going to Ukraine to show support," the EU's foreign policy chief, Kaja Kallas, said.

"I ​think we should act the opposite. ​We should show that we are ⁠there ​for Ukraine ​and we are ​not scared," ‌she told reporters in ​Finland, ⁠where she attended ⁠ a ​summit on Arctic strategy.

Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo, who was also at the meeting, said the attack demonstrated Russia's growing aggression and called both for more support for Kyiv and for harsher penalties on Moscow.

"For me, it means that we have to [...] do even more to help Ukraine, to support Ukraine. And we need more measures against Russia, more political measures, more sanctions, and make it clear that this is strong strategy," he said.

Lithuanian President Gitanas Nauseda said the attack showed that Russia was "challenging all of us."

"We should not talk about concrete geographic regions, because Russia's goal is much more ambitious: to test the rule of law, to test our style of life, to test democracy. And I think they will put additional efforts to do it," he said.

French Foreign Affairs Minister Jean-Noel Barrot said the attack had a "very clear goal, which is to intimidate Europeans, discourage them and, above all, drive a wedge between them."

Barrot said Russian President Vladimir Putin had constantly stepped up pressure on the EU and NATO over the past five years.

"Why? Because he knows that our strength lies in our unity, and that as long as we stand together, nothing can intimidate us," he said.

"I take the drones that were approaching trains near the (Ukrainian-Polish) border very seriously, but we must not be forced into an escalation," he said.

The Kremlin has commented on the attack only by saying that the Russian army operated across all Ukrainian territory and would continue to do so.

Speaking about the incident on Sunday, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andriy Sybiga has said Putin considered Russia to be "de facto" at...
body.zh: 俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和波兰边境附近的一列火车，引发欧盟呼吁加大对基辅的支持。欧盟最高外交官卡亚·卡拉斯表示，乌克兰的盟友应该表明他们“并不害怕”。 几位欧盟高级政界人士称，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰与波兰边境的一列客运列车，这是莫斯科试图恐吓基辅的盟友，应该采取更大的决议来应对。 在这起事件中，一架无人机击中了距离边境约 2 公里（1.24 英里）的沃林地区火车站的火车机车，此前不久，载有英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊和其他欧洲外交官的外交列车抵达车站后不久。 欧盟外交政策负责人卡贾·卡拉斯表示：“这（袭击）显然是为了吓唬西方国家，使其不再支持乌克兰，不再前往乌克兰表示支持。” “我认为我们应该采取相反的行动。我们应该表明我们是支持乌克兰的，而且我们并不害怕，”她在芬兰参加了北极战略峰会时对记者说。 出席会议的芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波表示，这次袭击表明俄罗斯的侵略性日益增强，并呼吁加大对基辅的支持，并对莫斯科实施更严厉的惩罚。 “对我来说，这意味着我们必须 [...] 采取更多措施来帮助乌克兰、支持乌克兰。我们需要针对俄罗斯采取更多措施、更多政治措施、更多制裁，并明确表示这是强有力的战略，”他说。 立陶宛总统吉塔纳斯·瑙塞达表示，这次袭击表明俄罗斯正在“挑战我们所有人”。 “我们不应该谈论具体的地理区域，因为俄罗斯的目标更加雄心勃勃：测试法治，测试我们的生活方式，测试民主。我认为他们会为此付出更多努力，”他说。 法国外交部长让-诺埃尔·巴罗表示，这次袭击有“非常明确的目标，就是恐吓欧洲人，劝阻他们，最重要的是，挑拨他们之间的关系”。 巴罗特表示，俄罗斯总统普京在过去五年中不断加大对欧盟和北约的压力。 “为什么？因为他知道我们的力量在于我们的团结，只要我们站在一起，就没有什么可以吓倒我们，”他说。 他说：“我非常严肃地对待在（乌克兰-波兰）边境附近接近火车的无人机，但我们绝不能被迫让事态升级。” 克里姆林宫对此次袭击仅表示，俄罗斯军队在乌克兰全境开展行动，并将继续这样做。 周日谈到这一事件时，乌克兰外交部长安德烈·西比加表示，普京认为俄罗斯“事实上”......

reflection.en: The drone attack near the Poland-Ukraine border, targeting a train, is a stark reminder of the fear and intimidation tactics used in conflict. In such moments, the temptation to respond with equal force or fear can be strong. Yet, the call from EU leaders to show they are 'not scared' points toward a different path: one of courage and resolve, refusing to...
reflection.zh: 俄罗斯在波兰-乌克兰边境附近袭击火车，是冲突中恐吓和威吓策略的严峻提醒。在这样的时刻，人们很容易想要以同等的力量或恐惧来回应。然而，欧盟领导人呼吁表明他们“不怕”，指向了一条不同的道路：一条充满勇气和决心的道路，拒绝被侵略所吓倒。

title.en: A 'winner-takes-all race' that could end in catastrophe, and the calls to slow it down
title.zh: 一场可能导致灾难的“赢者通吃”竞赛，以及要求放缓的呼声

summary.en: Frontier AI companies are raising alarms about the rapid pace of their own industry's development, with leaders calling for a slowdown to implement better safety measures and guardrails.
summary.zh: 世界前沿的人工智能公司正在对自身行业的发展速度敲响警钟，领导者们呼吁放缓步伐，以实施更完善的安全措施和保障措施。

body.en:
It sounds like science fiction — or the stuff of nightmares — as some of the biggest names in artificial intelligence warn that the technology their own companies are developing could go seriously wrong without an urgent slowdown.

Over the weekend, Anthropic boss Dario Amodei published an online essay calling for a coordinated reduction in the pace of AI development in order to give companies and governments more time to establish better guardrails.

While those concerns have existed for years, Amodei said events in recent months — including the Hugging Face AI hacking incident — had convinced him that action was needed.

Some experts have described that incident as a wake-up call that provided a concrete demonstration of the safety risks they had long warned about.

Amodei reportedly left industry giant Open AI over ethical concerns and co-founded Anthropic, another large US AI company that operates the popular Claude chatbot.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"I believe that if slowing down bought us even an extra year or two before models reach critical levels of capability, and we used that time to advance alignment, we could greatly reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong," Amodei wrote.

Key among Amodei's concerns was so-called "recursive self-improvement", where AI becomes capable of improving AI, potentially creating a cycle of increasingly powerful systems that outrun human ability to understand or control them.

The leaders of two rival AI companies, OpenAI's Sam Altman and xAI's Elon Musk, both voiced their agreement.

Alarm about the potentially existential risks posed by AI grew after an Anthropic researcher resigned last week, stating that "people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade".

If some of the industry's biggest players agree that AI development should slow down, what would that look like — and is it even possible?

It depends who you ask. United States President Donald Trump brushed off calls to check the development of AI and suggestions that the technology is moving too quickly, attributing those warnings to "negative forces".

"We're leading China on AI ... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins," he said over the weekend.

Experts say AI leaders may be genuinely concerned about the technology's consequences, yet they are also motivated to rapidly advance out of fear their competitors will outpace them.

body.zh: 这听起来像是科幻小说，或者是噩梦，因为人工智能领域的一些知名人士警告说，如果不紧急放慢速度，他们自己公司正在开发的技术可能会出现严重错误。 周末，Anthropic 老板达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在网上发表了一篇文章，呼吁协调一致地放慢人工智能的发展速度，以便给企业和政府更多的时间来建立更好的护栏。 尽管这些担忧已经存在多年，但阿莫迪表示，最近几个月发生的事件——包括 Hugging Face AI 黑客事件——让他确信需要采取行动。 一些专家将这一事件描述为一记警钟，具体展示了他们长期以来警告的安全风险。 据报道，Amodei 因道德问题离开了行业巨头 Open AI，并与他人共同创立了另一家美国大型人工智能公司 Anthropic，该公司运营广受欢迎的 Claude 聊天机器人。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 阿莫迪写道：“我相信，如果放慢速度，让我们在模型达到关键能力水平之前多花一两年的时间，并且我们利用这段时间来推进调整，我们就可以大大降低出现严重错误的风险。” 阿莫迪担心的关键是所谓的“递归自我改进”，即人工智能能够改进人工智能，有可能创造一个日益强大的系统的循环，超出人类理解或控制它们的能力。 两家竞争对手人工智能公司的领导人 OpenAI 的 Sam Altman 和 xAI 的 Elon Musk 都表示同意。 上周，一位人类研究人员辞职后，人们对人工智能带来的潜在生存风险的警觉越来越强烈，他表示“构建人工智能的人们真诚地相信，到本世纪末，它可能会杀死我们所有人”。 如果该行业的一些最大参与者同意人工智能发展应该放缓，那会是什么样子——这有可能吗？ 这取决于你问谁。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对检查人工智能发展的呼吁以及该技术发展太快的建议不予理睬，将这些警告归因于“负面力量”。 他周末表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 专家表示，人工智能领导者可能真正担心该技术的后果，但他们也担心竞争对手会超过他们，因此也有动力快速前进。 莫纳什大学数据科学与人工智能系的澳大利亚获奖者杰夫·韦伯 (Geoff Webb) 告诉 SBS 新闻，他认为人工智能公司“遥不可及”……

Today's AI race, while driven by innovation, also prompts urgent calls for caution and regulation to prevent unintended...

title.en: Israeli minister calls for Oscar-winning film directors to be stripped of citizenship
title.zh: 以色列部长呼吁取消奥斯卡获奖电影导演的公民身份

summary.en: An Israeli minister has called for the citizenship of the directors of an Israeli-made documentary about Gaza to be revoked, accusing them of "treason against the state." The film, "NAZA," features interviews with Israeli military and intelligence whistleblowers detailing AI-powered targeting systems used in Gaza. The...
summary.zh: 一位以色列部长呼吁取消一部以色列制作的关于加沙的纪录片导演的公民身份，指责他们犯有“叛国罪”。这部名为《NAZA》的电影采访了以色列军方和情报部门的举报人，详细介绍了在加沙使用的由人工智能驱动的瞄准系统。该纪录片在威尼斯电影节上获得了特别评审团奖。

body.en:
An Israeli minister has called for the award-winning directors of an Israeli-made Gaza documentary to be stripped of citizenship, accusing them of "treason against the state".

In the film NAZA, Israeli directors Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor spoke to 24 different Israeli military or intelligence whistleblowers who outlined the AI-powered targeting systems used to bombard Gaza that have killed tens of thousands of civilians.

The 80-minute documentary won a special jury prize at this year's Venice Film Festival over the weekend.

Israel's culture minister Miki Zohar accused the directors of being willing to "harm their homeland in order to receive applause from antisemites around the world".

"I will act immediately to revoke the Israeli citizenship of these despicable creators for treason against the state," he wrote on X.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Abraham and Szor won an Oscar in 2025 for their film No Other Land about Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank .

The documentary received a record 25-minute standing ovation at its premiere on Thursday — the second year in succession that a film about Gaza has resonated in Venice after The Voice of Hind Rajab, a true-life account of the killing of a Palestinian girl during the war.

"The Israeli intelligence officers we spoke with talked to us about how this mass killing is systemic, not by accident, but by ‌design, actions of murder and policies that are based on the total dehumanisation of Palestinians," Abraham said on Saturday.

In NAZA, 24 Israeli military insiders, including intelligence officers and soldiers, gave insight into the war in Gaza and what they say is the systemic killing of Palestinian civilians.

The film was shot in secret on rooftops in Tel Aviv over three years, and digital alterations obscure the subjects' identities by altering their voices and appearances.

The film's title references an Israeli military acronym used as a shorthand for civilian casualties, including men, women and children.

The subjects in the film detail the surveillance systems and remote bombing involved in the Israeli military's operation, which they say uses artificial intelligence to identify potential Hamas targets and bomb their homes and apartments, often knowing that families are inside.

"We just told these officers and soldiers, please describe to us what you did," Abraham said in a news conference on Thursday. "Of course there were other questions that arose but the principal question was a question of detail — 'sketch it for us, we want to know how it worked'. And sometimes just asking the question, you get answers."

title.en: Fears for two thirds of nation as displacement crisis grows in new front of Middle East war
title.zh: 也门冲突升级，人道危机加剧，或威胁全球航运路线

summary.en: Escalating conflict in Yemen has led to hundreds killed and tens of thousands displaced as Houthi forces advanced on key cities, seizing the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital global shipping route. The Houthis also claimed drone and missile attacks on Saudi Arabia.
summary.zh: 也门冲突升级，导致数百人死亡，数万人流离失所，胡塞武装部队向主要城市推进，并占领了重要的全球航运通道曼德海峡。胡塞武装还声称对沙特阿拉伯发动了无人机和导弹袭击。

body.en:
Hundreds have been killed and tens of thousands displaced as rebel Houthi forces in Yemen advanced on key cities in country over the weekend.

In advances following a week-long offensive that left hundreds dead, the Houthis seized the Yemeni side of the Bab al-Mandab Strait , one of the world's most important shipping arteries and the southern gateway to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal, threatening Saudi oil exports diverted from the Strait of Hormuz.

On Sunday, the Houthis — also known as Ansar Allah (supporters of God) — claimed to have used drones and missiles to target Saudi Arabia, including a military base just over the border with Yemen.

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree didn't provide evidence or say when the attack occurred, according to the Associated Press.

Global charity Oxfam said escalations in Yemen pose a "dire threat" to an already struggling population after over a decade of civil war.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The humanitarian impact is already severe," Yemen country director Ferran Puig said.

"Two thirds of the population in Yemen needs humanitarian assistance, and thousands are facing famine. Further military escalations will deepen hunger and displacement and disrupt the humanitarian assistance millions depend on to survive."

The Houthis are targeting Saudi oil infrastructure and shipping as part of a recently declared blockade, but they have said that other countries' shipping will not be targeted.

They now control the country's entire Red Sea coastline after capturing the key port city of Mocha in Taiz province from Yemeni government forces on Friday.

Government forces still control parts of Taiz province, including its capital city of the same name, but fighting in the area continues.

Military sources said that government forces had again attacked Houthi positions in the Taiz area.

More than 500 Yemeni troops have been killed during clashes with the Houthis between 9 August and 10 September, the government-aligned National Resistance Forces said in reports carried by local media in Yemen. The National Resistance Forces claimed that Houthi losses during the same period were far higher.

More than 950 violations against civilians have been documented across the western coast front lines following the Houthis’ entry into these cities, including more than 150 cases of killings, the Yemeni Network for Rights and Freedoms reported.

Residents have fled en masse towards Aden and the Lahj Governorate following the Houthis' takeover of the cities of Mocha and Khokha, as well as al-Wazi’iyah.

title.en: Swedish election in dead heat as anti-immigration far right loses ground
title.zh: 瑞典大选势均力敌，疑欧派和反移民的极右翼势力受挫

summary.en: Sweden's general election is virtually tied between the right-wing ruling party bloc and the centre-left opposition, with the far-right Sweden Democrats losing ground compared to previous elections.
summary.zh: 瑞典大选结果显示，执政的右翼政党集团与中左翼反对派几乎势均力敌，而极右翼的瑞典民主党则较以往选举失利。

body.en:
Sweden's leftwing opposition bloc held a razor-thin lead in Sunday's general election with half of the votes counted, with the far right seen losing ground.

With more than 50 per cent of votes counted, four opposition parties led by Social Democratic leader Magdalena Andersson, had a narrow lead with 49.3 per cent against 49.1 per cent for Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing alliance, which includes the anti-immigration Sweden Democrats.

In a big surprise, the anti-immigration Sweden Democrats lost support for the first time since it entered parliament in 2010, with 17.7 per cent of the vote, down from 20.5 per cent in 2022.

"Of course it's a bit of a disappointment that we are not the second-biggest party anymore in these polls. But it's still not finished, it can still change," Julia Kronlid, a Sweden Democrat member of parliament, told Agence France-Presse (AFP) just after exit polls had showed the party retreating.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

In the event of a left-wing victory, the four parties would face tough negotiations to form a government as they are splintered ideologically.

"I am confident that Magdalena is a skilled negotiator, and that she has a plan to make it work ... It might take a bit of time, but we will get a government led by Magdalena," Emilia Wikstrom Melin, a 40-year-old union analyst, told AFP at the Social Democrats' watch party.

Kristersson has headed a minority coalition backed by the Sweden Democrats for four years, giving the far-right influence over policy in exchange for support in parliament.

Kristersson promised the Sweden Democrats key cabinet posts if the right wing wins.

"It would be really tough for the country to go back to four years of the Social Democrats in power," Sweden Democrat supporter Bjorn Englen told AFP.

Throughout the campaign, opinion polls gave a comfortable lead to the left-wing opposition, but the gap narrowed to a dead heat in the final days.

Much of the campaign focused on healthcare and helping struggling households cope with rising costs.

Andersson, the first woman to head Sweden's government in 2021-22, is a staunch defender of Sweden's famed welfare state.

Her party ruled the Scandinavian country for most of the 20th century and remains Sweden's largest, though early results showed the party heading for its worst result in modern history.

Andersson has pledged to raise taxes on banks and high incomes, cut healthcare queues, and improve declining school results.

"We've had four years of rising unemployment, with a salary that pays for less and less," she said in a televised debate before the vote.
