title.en: Hong Kong parents urged to vaccinate young children amid rising summer flu cases
title.zh: 香港家长被敦促为幼儿接种疫苗，以应对夏季流感病例的增加

summary.en: Hong Kong health officials are encouraging parents to vaccinate their young children due to a recent increase in influenza cases among children. Some children have experienced high fevers lasting several days, and the city is currently in its summer flu season, which has not yet peaked.
summary.zh: 香港卫生官员鼓励家长为年幼的孩子接种疫苗，因为近期儿童流感病例有所增加。一些儿童出现持续数日的高烧，而香港目前正处于夏季流感季节，尚未达到高峰。

body.en: Hong Kong parents have been urged to vaccinate their young children as cases of influenza among children have risen across the city. Children play in a playground in September 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Mike Kwan, honorary clinical associate professor of the Department of Paediatrics and Adolescent Medicine at the University of Hong Kong, said on Commercial Radio on Monday that flu-related hospitalisations of children have risen recently, with some patients experiencing fevers in excess of 40 degrees Celsius that persist for several days. Kwan said the city is currently in the summer flu season, which is yet to reach its peak. The summer flu season in Hong Kong usually begins in June, with the winter flu season starting in January. He urged parents to vaccinate their young children against influenza, which he said provides the strongest protection against serious illness. The Government Vaccination Programme for 2026/27 will commence this Thursday, offering free vaccines for high-risk groups such as children aged six months or older, pregnant women, and the elderly. Director of Health Ronald Lam told RTHK on Saturday that the vaccination rate among children aged six months to two years is 27 per cent—much lower than the rate among older children. Director for Health Ronald Lam (first from left) talks to children who are about to receive flu vaccines in a school in October 2025. Photo: GovHK. According to government figures, more than half of children aged six months to six years old were vaccinated against flu in the 2025/26 season. Over three-quarters of children aged six to 12 got flu jabs. Severe paediatric flu cases Lam said Hong Kong has seen “wave-like rise” in flu cases since June. The proportion of people seeking medical attention or requiring hospitalisation due to the flu rose from 0.27 cases per 10,000 people during the same period last year to 0.83 cases this year, the director of health said. Currently, over 80 per cent of cases are Influenza A (H1), nearly 20 per cent are Influenza A (H3), and a small number are Influenza B cases. According to the director of health, Hong Kong recorded 19 severe paediatric flu cases this year. Among those, eight cases involved children under five years old, five of whom were unvaccinated. Lam said that unvaccinated young children face over five times the risk of severe illness from flu infection compared to those who were vaccinated.
body.zh: 随着全市儿童流感病例的增加，香港家长被敦促为年幼的孩子接种疫苗。 2026 年 9 月，孩子们在操场上玩耍。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港大学儿科及青少年医学系名誉临床副教授关迈克周一在商业电台表示，近期儿童因流感住院的人数有所增加，部分患者发烧超过40摄氏度并持续数日。关说，该市目前正处于夏季流感季节，但尚未达到高峰。香港的夏季流感季节通常于六月开始，而冬季流感季节则于一月开始。他敦促父母为年幼的孩子接种流感疫苗，他说这为预防严重疾病提供了最有力的保护。 2026/27年度政府疫苗接种计划将于本周四开始，为六个月或以上儿童、孕妇和老年人等高危人群提供免费疫苗。卫生署署长林中基周六向香港电台表示，六个月至两岁儿童的疫苗接种率为 27%，远低于年龄较大儿童的疫苗接种率。卫生署署长林中基（左一）于 2025 年 10 月与即将在学校接种流感疫苗的儿童交谈。图片：香港政府一站通。根据政府数据，2025/26 季节，超过一半的 6 个月至 6 岁儿童接种了流感疫苗。超过四分之三的 6 至 12 岁儿童接种了流感疫苗。严重小儿流感病例林表示，自六月以来，香港流感病例出现“波浪式上升”。卫生总监表示，因流感就医或需要住院的人数比例从去年同期的每万人0.27例上升到今年的0.83例。目前，超过80%的病例是甲型流感(H1)，近20%是甲型流感(H3)，还有少数病例是乙型流感。卫生署署长表示，本港今年录得19宗严重小儿流感个案。其中，八例涉及五岁以下儿童，其中五人未接种疫苗。林说，未接种疫苗的幼儿因感染流感而患严重疾病的风险是接种疫苗的儿童的五倍以上。

reflection.en: As flu cases rise among children in Hong Kong, parents are urged to vaccinate their young ones. This call to action highlights the vulnerability of the youngest members of society and the responsibility of adults to protect them. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights."
reflection.zh: 随着香港儿童流感病例的增加，家长们被敦促为孩子接种疫苗。这一呼吁行动凸显了社会中最年幼成员的脆弱性，以及成年人保护他们的责任。《箴言》31:8-9提醒我们：“当为不能自辩的开口说话，为所有孤苦者伸张正义。”

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: China’s spy chief warns foreign ‘hostile forces’ may use AI to ‘fabricate political rumours’
title.zh: 中国国安部长警告人工智能可能被用于“制造政治谣言”

summary.en: The head of China's spy agency has warned that artificial intelligence poses a threat to national security, as foreign powers could use the technology to spread 'political rumours and harmful information' and engage in 'public opinion wars and cognitive warfare' against China.
summary.zh: 中国国家安全部部长警告称，人工智能对国家安全构成威胁，因为外国势力可能利用这项技术传播“政治谣言和有害信息”，并对中国发动“舆论战和认知战”。

body.en: The head of China’s spy agency has warned that artificial intelligence endangers the country’s national security, with foreign powers potentially using the technology to threaten social order. The Great Hall of the People in Beijing. Photo: Lukas Messmer/HKFP. “Hostile forces” were abusing generative AI technologies to “fabricate political rumours and spread harmful information”, Minister of State Security Chen Yixin wrote in an article published online on Sunday. “They launch public opinion wars and cognitive warfare against China, directly threatening our political security, institutional security and ideological security,” he said. The warning comes as Chinese leader Xi Jinping is due to meet US President Donald Trump in Washington this month, with AI governance and safety set to be part of their discussions as calls mount for greater oversight of the technology. US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping before a bilateral meeting at the Gimhae International Airport terminal, in Busan, South Korea, on October 30, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. US tech leaders have also called for slowing AI advances. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warned on Saturday of the “reckless” speed of AI technology development, as worries mount over the risks of superintelligent computer systems. OpenAI boss Sam Altman said he agreed with Amodei’s assessment. But Chen warned that AI was now “the main battleground for global technological competition and a new track for major power strategic rivalry”. He did not mention existential risks or putting the brakes on technological advances, but singled out Anthropic’s Claude Mythos and OpenAI’s ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber for their advanced hacking capabilities that potentially “pose serious risks to China’s critical information infrastructure”. “Foreign intelligence agencies are deeply using technologies such as intelligent web crawlers, intelligent data mining, and intelligent profiling analysis to extensively collect and acquire sensitive information such as key national data, trade secrets, and citizens’ personal privacy,” Chen said. The US-Iran war has also demonstrated AI’s key role in the military, with better technology offering battlefield advantages, he said. China must “ensure independent control of key core technologies” –- including the advanced computer chips vital to training AI models — to secure its technology sovereignty, Chen wrote.
body.zh: 中国间谍机构负责人警告说，人工智能危及国家安全，外国势力可能利用该技术威胁社会秩序。北京人民大会堂。照片：Lukas Messmer/HKFP。国家安全部部长陈一新周日在网上发表的一篇文章中写道，“敌对势力”正在滥用生成式人工智能技术“捏造政治谣言，传播有害信息”。 “他们对中国发动舆论战、认知战，直接威胁我们的政治安全、制度安全和意识形态安全，”他说。这一警告发出之际，中国领导人习近平将于本月在华盛顿会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，随着要求加强对这项技术的监管的呼声越来越高，人工智能治理和安全将成为他们讨论的一部分。 2025 年 10 月 30 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在韩国釜山金海国际机场航站楼举行双边会晤。图片：白宫，来自 Flickr。美国科技领袖也呼吁放慢人工智能的进步。 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 周六对人工智能技术发展的“鲁莽”速度发出警告，因为人们对超级智能计算机系统的风险越来越担忧。 OpenAI 老板 Sam Altman 表示他同意 Amodei 的评估。但陈警告说，人工智能现在是“全球科技竞争的主战场，也是大国战略竞争的新赛道”。他没有提到存在风险或阻碍技术进步，但特别指出了 Anthropic 的 Claude Mythos 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT-5.5-Cyber​​，因为它们先进的黑客能力可能“对中国的关键信息基础设施构成严重风险”。 “外国情报机构深入利用智能网络爬虫、智能数据挖掘、智能画像分析等技术，广泛收集获取国家关键数据、商业秘密、公民个人隐私等敏感信息。”陈说。他说，美伊战争也证明了人工智能在军事中的关键作用，更好的技术可以提供战场优势。陈写道，中国必须“确保对关键核心技术的独立控制”——包括对训练人工智能模型至关重要的先进计算机芯片——以确保其技术主权。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI presents a dual-edged sword, capable of incredible innovation but also of spreading disinformation. As China's spy chief warns of 'political rumours' fabricated by 'hostile forces,' we are reminded of the importance of truth in public discourse. Ephesians 4:25 calls us to 'put off falsehood and speak truthfully to one another,' a...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展是一把双刃剑，它既能带来惊人的创新，也可能传播虚假信息。正如中国国安部部长警告的“敌对势力”制造的“政治谣言”，这提醒我们真相在公共话语中的重要性。以弗所书4:25劝勉我们“弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话”，这一原则在应对新技术塑造的复杂信息环境中至关重要。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Doctors make jab appeal as flu activity stays high
title.zh: 医生呼吁接种疫苗，流感活动仍居高不下

summary.en: The Hong Kong Medical Association has urged the public to get vaccinated against the seasonal flu as soon as possible, with influenza activity in the city remaining at a high level. They warned of possible flu outbreaks at schools at the start of the new academic year, increasing the risk of community transmission.
summary.zh: 香港医学会敦促公众尽快接种季节性流感疫苗，因为该市的流感活动仍处于高位。他们警告说，新学年开始时学校可能爆发流感，增加了社区传播的风险。

body.en: The Hong Kong Medical Association has urged the public to get vaccinated against the seasonal flu as soon as possible, with influenza activity in the city remaining at a high level. It warned of possible flu outbreaks at schools at the start of the new academic year, increasing the risk of community transmission. Respiratory medicine specialist Raymond Tso, also a council member of the association, said the city saw an increasing number of cases from late August to early September. “Always when the school students get together, there will be increased chances of influenza infection because they are getting into a close community,” he said. “That’s why we advise people to get their vaccination sooner to prevent any serious consequences of flu infections.” Infectious disease specialist Joseph Tsang said more than 2.03 million doses of seasonal flu vaccine were administered in the 2025-26 season – similar to the previous year. He said there was a rise in the vaccination uptake among children and adolescents, but the coverage among people aged 50 to 64 and pregnant women remained relatively low. The association added that it takes around two weeks for antibodies to develop following vaccination, and urged people to allow sufficient time for protection to develop. The Seasonal Influenza Vaccination School Outreach programme is set to launch on Thursday. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 由于本港流感活动仍处于高位，香港医学会呼吁市民尽快接种季节性流感疫苗。它警告说，新学年开始时学校可能爆发流感，从而增加社区传播的风险。该协会理事会成员、呼吸内科专家 Raymond Tso 表示，从 8 月底到 9 月初，该市的病例数量不断增加。他说：“当学生聚集在一起时，感染流感的机会总是会增加，因为他们进入了一个封闭的社区。” “这就是为什么我们建议人们尽早接种疫苗，以防止流感感染造成任何严重后果。”传染病专家曾钰成表示，2025-26 季节接种了超过 203 万剂季节性流感疫苗，与上一年相似。他说，儿童和青少年的疫苗接种率有所上升，但50至64岁人群和孕妇的疫苗接种率仍然相对较低。该协会补充说，疫苗接种后大约需要两周时间才能产生抗体，并敦促人们留出足够的时间来产生保护作用。季节性流感疫苗学校外展计划定于周四启动。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: As flu activity remains high in Hong Kong, the Medical Association's plea for vaccinations highlights our shared vulnerability to illness. This call to action reminds us of the importance of caring for one another's health, especially as children return to school. James 5:14 encourages us to pray for the sick and to actively seek healing and prevention,...
reflection.zh: 随着香港流感活动持续高企，医学会的疫苗接种呼吁凸显了我们对疾病的共同脆弱性。这一行动呼吁提醒我们关爱彼此健康的重耍性，尤其是在孩子们返校之际。雅各书 5:14 鼓励我们为病人祷告，积极寻求医治与预防，这反映了社区保护其最脆弱成员的责任。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Social isolation in Australia has nearly doubled over two decades
title.zh: 澳大利亚的社会孤立在二十年间几乎翻倍

summary.en: New research from the University of Sydney indicates that social isolation in Australia has nearly doubled over the past 23 years, with loneliness rates also increasing, particularly impacting vulnerable groups.
summary.zh: 悉尼大学的最新研究表明，澳大利亚的社会孤立现象在过去23年间几乎翻了一番，孤独感也随之增加，弱势群体受到的影响尤为严重。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Australians are becoming increasingly lonely and socially isolated, according to new University of Sydney research that found rates of social isolation nearly doubled over the past 23 years. Loneliness rates also increased over time, though more gradually than social isolation, with the sharpest impacts observed among vulnerable populations.

Published today in the International Journal of Epidemiology , the study examined 23 years of nationally representative HILDA (Household, Income and Labor Dynamics in Australia) data from 2001 to 2023. This longitudinal analysis provides some of the first long-term national evidence on trends in loneliness and social isolation in Australia.

Social isolation describes an objective state of limited social contact, social engagement or meaningful relationships, whereas loneliness is the subjective perception that one's actual social relationships fall short of those desired.

Lead author Dr. Neta Hagani, honorary adjunct affiliate from the School of Public Health and Charles Perkins Center at the University of Sydney, said, "Concerns about Australians becoming more disconnected have grown in recent years, yet there has been little national-level evidence showing whether loneliness or social isolation is actually increasing.

"Our study showed that social isolation has increased substantially in Australia over the past two decades, nearly doubling from 16.9% in 2001 to 29.9% in 2023. Loneliness showed a more moderate increase overall, from 6.3% to 8.4%, disproportionately affecting vulnerable populations.

"We found that younger adults experienced some of the most substantial increases in loneliness , while older adults consistently had the highest levels of social isolation and experienced sizable increases over time.

"The data also revealed that loneliness and social isolation were consistently more common among people who were unemployed, lived in more socioeconomically disadvantaged areas, were widowed, lived alone or had lower levels of education.

"The findings suggest that Australians are having fewer social connections and interactions than in previous years. Although increases in feelings of loneliness have been comparatively modest, loneliness is still on the rise. This distinction is important because social isolation and loneliness are related but different experiences, and both are associated with poorer physical and mental health outcomes."

Senior author Professor Melody Ding from the Sydney School of Public Health and Charles Perkins Center said social connection should be viewed as a public health issue, not merely a...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 悉尼大学的最新研究发现，澳大利亚人变得越来越孤独和社会孤立，该研究发现过去 23 年中社会孤立率几乎翻了一番。孤独率也随着时间的推移而增加，尽管比社会隔离缓慢，但在弱势群体中观察到的影响最为严重。 该研究今天发表在《国际流行病学杂志》上，研究了 2001 年至 2023 年 23 年具有全国代表性的 HILDA（澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动力动态）数据。这项纵向分析提供了一些关于澳大利亚孤独和社会孤立趋势的首批长期全国证据。 社会孤立描述了有限的社会接触、社会参与或有意义的关系的客观状态，而孤独是一个人的实际社会关系达不到理想的主观感受。 主要作者、悉尼大学公共卫生学院和查尔斯·珀金斯中心的名誉兼职附属机构内塔·哈加尼博士说：“近年来，人们越来越担心澳大利亚人变得更加孤立，但几乎没有国家层面的证据表明孤独或社会孤立是否实际上在增加。 “我们的研究表明，过去二十年来，澳大利亚的社会孤立现象大幅增加，从 2001 年的 16.9% 增加到 2023 年的 29.9%，几乎翻了一番。总体而言，孤独感的增加较为温和，从 6.3% 增加到 8.4%，对弱势群体的影响尤为严重。 “我们发现，年轻人的孤独感增加最为显着，而老年人的社交孤立感始终最高，并且随着时间的推移，孤独感大幅增加。 “数据还显示，在失业、生活在社会经济弱势地区、丧偶、独居或教育水平较低的人群中，孤独和社会孤立感始终更为普遍。 “研究结果表明，与前几年相比，澳大利亚人的社会联系和互动减少了。尽管孤独感的增加相对温和，但孤独感仍在上升。这种区别很重要，因为社会孤立和孤独感相关，但经历不同，而且两者都与较差的身心健康结果相关。” 悉尼公共卫生学院和查尔斯·珀金斯中心的资深作者 Melody Ding 教授表示，社交关系应被视为一个公共卫生问题，而不仅仅是一个……

reflection.en: This study highlights a growing epidemic of loneliness, particularly affecting vulnerable populations. It echoes the ancient cry in Psalm 71:9, 'Do not cast me off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength is spent.' As societies grapple with increasing isolation, may we be moved to actively connect with and support those on the margins,...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了日益严重的孤独流行病，尤其影响弱势群体。它呼应了《诗篇》71:9 中古老的呼求：“年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我；我力衰的时候，求你不要离开我。” 随着社会应对日益增长的孤立问题，愿我们能主动与边缘人群，特别是老年人建立联系并支持他们。

verse.textEn: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.
verse.textZh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我；我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我。

title.en: Mosquito 'toilet' detects West Nile and first Hedwig-like virus found in the Americas
title.zh: 蚊子“厕所”可检测西尼罗河病毒和美洲首例赫德威格样病毒

summary.en: Public health researchers can detect circulating diseases like COVID-19 or polio by examining genetic evidence in wastewater. Entomologist Dana Price explored applying this principle to mosquitoes, leading to the development of a 'mosquito toilet' for disease detection.
summary.zh: 公共卫生研究人员可以通过检测废水中的遗传物质来发现社区中传播的疾病，例如 COVID-19 或脊髓灰质炎。昆虫学家 Dana Price 探索将这一原理应用于蚊子，从而开发出一种用于疾病检测的“蚊子厕所”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

When public health researchers want to know whether diseases such as COVID-19 or polio are circulating in a community, they can look for genetic evidence in wastewater.

Entomologist Dana Price wondered whether the same principle could be applied to mosquitoes. The question led to an unconventional experiment.

"What we did, colloquially, was build a mosquito toilet," said Price, an associate professor at the Center for Vector Biology, Department of Entomology, in the School of Environmental and Biological Sciences and a lead author of a study published in Microbiology Spectrum .

The device, Price said, is deceptively simple: a 3D-printed funnel coated with a superhydrophobic (water-repelling) material that causes liquid to bead up and slide into a collection tube.

By sequencing genetic material in mosquito excrement, Price recovered a complete West Nile virus genome, found the first known evidence of a Hedwig-like virus in the Americas and detected several viruses that may be new to science. The approach also identified parasites and confirmed the mosquito species that deposited the waste droplets.

Findings from the study suggest mosquito waste could become a powerful surveillance tool, allowing scientists to search broadly for familiar pathogens as well as threats they don't yet know exist, Price said.

"If you don't look for it, you won't find it," Price said. "But what if you don't know what to look for?"

Mosquito surveillance historically involves collecting large numbers of insects, sorting them by species, combining them into pools and grinding them up for laboratory testing.

The labor-intensive process requires scientists to preserve the insects carefully so their genetic material doesn't degrade. During an outbreak, those steps can delay information needed to direct mosquito-control efforts. Conventional tests also target specific pathogens, so researchers must know what they are looking for.

Mosquitoes excrete small amounts of liquid containing genetic traces of viruses and other organisms. Because the waste contains far less mosquito tissue, and therefore less mosquito DNA, than a crushed insect, the scientists reasoned that viral material might be easier to find.

The researchers collected two groups of 50 wild Culex mosquitoes from a yard in New Brunswick, New Jersey, in 2021 and 2022. They placed each group in a screened container over the funnel and fed them a sugar solution. The mosquitoes produced drops of waste, which slid into a tube.

The scientists used shotgun metagenomic sequencing, which sequences all genetic material present in a mixed...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 当公共卫生研究人员想了解社区中是否存在 COVID-19 或脊髓灰质炎等疾病时，他们可以在废水中寻找遗传证据。 昆虫学家达纳·普莱斯想知道同样的原理是否可以应用于蚊子。这个问题引发了一项非传统的实验。 “通俗地说，我们所做的是建造一个蚊子厕所，”普莱斯说，他是环境与生物科学学院昆虫学系媒介生物学中心的副教授，也是《微生物学光谱》上发表的一项研究的主要作者。 Price 表示，该设备看似简单：一个涂有超疏水（防水）材料的 3D 打印漏斗，可使液体形成珠状并滑入收集管。 通过对蚊子排泄物中的遗传物质进行测序，普莱斯恢复了完整的西尼罗河病毒基因组，发现了美洲第一个已知的类似海德薇病毒的证据，并检测到了几种对科学来说可能是新的病毒。该方法还识别了寄生虫并确认了沉积废物液滴的蚊子种类。 普莱斯说，研究结果表明，蚊子排泄物可能成为一种强大的监测工具，使科学家能够广泛寻找熟悉的病原体以及他们尚不知道存在的威胁。 “如果你不寻找它，你就找不到它，”普莱斯说。 “但是如果你不知道要寻找什么怎么办？” 历史上，蚊子监测涉及收集大量昆虫，按物种对它们进行分类，将它们组合成池并磨碎以供实验室测试。 这一劳动密集型过程要求科学家小心保存昆虫，以免它们的遗传物质降解。在疫情爆发期间，这些步骤可能会延迟指导蚊子控制工作所需的信息。传统测试还针对特定病原体，因此研究人员必须知道他们在寻找什么。 蚊子排出少量含有病毒和其他生物体遗传痕迹的液体。由于与压碎的昆虫相比，这些废物中含有的蚊子组织少得多，因此蚊子 DNA 也少得多，因此科学家们推断，病毒物质可能更容易找到。 研究人员于 2021 年和 2022 年从新泽西州新不伦瑞克省的一个院子里收集了两组，每组 50 只野生库蚊。他们将每组放入漏斗上方的筛选容器中，并给它们喂食糖溶液。蚊子产生的废物滴滑入管子中。 科学家们使用鸟枪法宏基因组测序，对混合体中存在的所有遗传物质进行测序。

reflection.en: The ingenuity of researchers in developing a 'mosquito toilet' to detect viruses highlights how careful observation of the natural world can lead to vital public health tools. This echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself reveals profound truths and practical knowledge, inviting us to explore and understand the world Yahweh has made.
reflection.zh: 研究人员开发出用于检测病毒的“蚊子厕所”的独创性，凸显了仔细观察自然界如何能带来重要的公共卫生工具。这呼应了古老的智慧：被造物本身揭示了深刻的真理和实用的知识，邀请我们去探索和理解雅伟所造的世界。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Speedy electrons for brilliant laser light: Research paves the way for compact, inexpensive free-electron lasers
title.zh: 高速电子用于产生明亮激光：研究为紧凑、廉价的自由电子激光铺平道路

summary.en: Extremely short, intense light flashes are in high demand to investigate atoms, molecules, and new materials. Free-electron lasers (FELs) produce these flashes, but beam time at large-scale facilities is scarce and wait times are long. Researchers have taken a crucial step towards more accessible FELs by stably...
summary.zh: 极短、高强度的光闪对研究原子、分子和新材料的需求量极大。自由电子激光器（FELs）能产生这些光闪，但大型设施的束流时间稀缺且等待时间长。研究人员通过稳定运行激光等离子体自由电子激光器，朝着更易获取的自由电子激光器迈出了关键一步。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Extremely short, intense light flashes are in high demand to investigate atoms, molecules and new materials. Free-electron lasers (FELs) produce these flashes. But around the world, beam time available at large-scale user facilities is in short supply, and waiting times are long.

Researchers at the Helmholtz-Zentrum Dresden-Rossendorf (HZDR) and the Synchrotron SOLEIL near Paris have taken a crucial step along this path: For the first time, they managed to operate a laser-plasma FEL stably and reproducibly in the so-called high-gain regime—an operating state with particularly high amplification of the radiation generated.

"Stability—that is, light flashes that consistently maintain high quality over hours or even days—is extremely important for all experiments involving an FEL," says Dr. Arie Irman of HZDR's Institute of Radiation Physics.

Conventional large-scale facilities have long achieved this stability, but laser-plasma FELs have not. Now, after years of research, Irman's team has managed to solve this problem. They generated ultraviolet light flashes at a wavelength of 272 nanometers with high pulse energy. The FEL power exhibited the exponential growth characteristic of the high-gain regime.

"This is significant progress in comparison with the results we published in 2023," Irman adds.

In principle, a laser-plasma FEL works like a conventional free-electron laser: For intense light flashes, researchers initially need high-energy electrons that travel at almost the speed of light. They then enter an array of magnets, known as an undulator, that force the electrons into a wiggling trajectory, which in turn forces them to form tiny parcels that emit intense, coherent light flashes.

So far, large-scale accelerators have been required to drive electrons to the necessary energy—accelerators that can be up to approximately 2 kilometers (1.2 miles) long. "In a laser-plasma FEL, this distance can be reduced by a factor of about a thousand," says Dr. Marie Labat of Synchrotron SOLEIL.

"The electrons effectively surf on a wave of plasma." After just a few millimeters, they reach energies for which a conventional accelerator needs many meters.

The key to success lay in precisely controlling the interaction between the laser and the plasma. To do so, the team used HZDR's high-performance laser DRACO. Its infrared pulses generated the required plasma in a millimeter-thin beam of gas. "We managed to precisely tune the laser to match the plasma," says HZDR physicist Dr. Susanne Schöbel.

This was anything but easy because the interaction between the laser and the plasma...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 研究原子、分子和新材料需要极短、强烈的闪光。自由电子激光器（FEL）产生这些闪光。但在世界各地，大型用户设施的可用波束时间供不应求，而且等待时间很长。 亥姆霍兹德累斯顿罗森多夫中心 (HZDR) 和巴黎附近的 Synchrotron SOLEIL 的研究人员在这条道路上迈出了关键的一步：他们第一次成功地在所谓的高增益状态下稳定且可重复地操作激光等离子体 FEL，即一种对所产生的辐射具有特别高放大的操作状态。 HZDR 辐射物理研究所的 Arie Irman 博士表示：“稳定性，即闪光在数小时甚至数天内持续保持高质量，对于所有涉及 FEL 的实验都极其重要。” 传统的大型设施早已实现了这种稳定性，但激光等离子体 FEL 还没有。现在，经过多年的研究，Irman 的团队已经成功解决了这个问题。他们产生波长为 272 纳米的高脉冲能量紫外线闪光。 FEL功率表现出高增益状态下的指数增长特征。 “与我们 2023 年发布的结果相比，这是重大进步，”Irman 补充道。 原则上，激光等离子体 FEL 的工作原理类似于传统的自由电子激光器：对于强烈的闪光，研究人员最初需要以接近光速行进的高能电子。然后它们进入一个称为波荡器的磁体阵列，迫使电子进入摆动轨迹，这反过来又迫使它们形成微小的包裹，发出强烈的、相干的闪光。 到目前为止，需要大型加速器来将电子驱动到所需的能量，加速器的长度可达约 2 公里（1.2 英里）。 Synchrotron SOLEIL 的 Marie Labat 博士说：“在激光等离子体 FEL 中，这个距离可以缩短约一千倍。” “电子有效地在等离子体波上冲浪。”仅仅几毫米后，它们就达到了传统加速器需要许多米才能达到的能量。 成功的关键在于精确控制激光和等离子体之间的相互作用。为此，该团队使用了 HZDR 的高性能激光 DRACO。它的红外脉冲在毫米级细气体束中产生所需的等离子体。 HZDR 物理学家 Susanne Schöbel 博士表示：“我们成功地精确调整了激光以匹配等离子体。” 这绝非易事，因为激光和等离子体之间的相互作用......

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as seen in the development of new technologies like compact free-electron lasers, reflects humanity's God-given capacity for discovery. While this advancement promises to unlock deeper understanding of the material world, it also calls us to steward this growing knowledge with wisdom and purpose.
reflection.zh: 对知识的不懈追求，正如紧凑型自由电子激光器等新技术的发展所示，反映了人类被赋予的发现能力。这项进步有望揭示对物质世界的更深层理解，同时也呼吁我们以智慧和目标来管理日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: School segregation endures in Baltimore region, report finds
title.zh: 报告发现巴尔的摩地区学校隔离持续存在

summary.en: A new report from Johns Hopkins University indicates that despite Baltimore City's public schools being predominantly Black, the district is making more progress in reducing student segregation than its suburban counterparts, which have access to more diverse populations.
summary.zh: 约翰霍普金斯大学的一份新报告显示，尽管巴尔的摩市的公立学校以黑人学生为主，但与能够吸引更多元化人口的郊区学校系统相比，该学区在减少学生隔离方面取得了更好的成效。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Although public schools in Baltimore City are predominantly Black, the district is doing a better job of reducing segregation among its student body than suburban systems that are able to draw from more diverse populations, according to a new report from Johns Hopkins University.

Black students in the Baltimore City Public Schools system, which has a 75% Black student body, tend to attend school with students who share their racial identity because Baltimore is a majority-Black city. But the school system's process for allowing students to attend schools outside their neighborhoods appears to contribute to a more effective distribution of diversity when compared with more diverse suburban districts, the report from the 21st Century Cities Initiative states.

School districts in counties near the city (Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Carroll, Harford, Howard and Queen Anne's) struggle with ongoing segregation among their student bodies because the residential populations they serve also remain highly segregated, according to the report. The study was commissioned by the Abell Foundation, a nonprofit that works to improve health, economic and educational outcomes in Baltimore City.

While suburban school districts could foster slightly more integration by altering attendance boundaries and allowing more public school choice policies, the most stubborn impediments—residential zoning and public transportation—are beyond the control of local school officials and require state and county government action, the report states.

"Our primary conclusion is that the problem of school segregation in the Baltimore region is fundamentally a problem of regional housing segregation," the study states. "Successful interventions will require housing and transportation policies to work in concert to racially and economically integrate the region."

"Baltimore City Public Schools are segregated. That is, students—especially Black students—attend schools with classmates that share their racial identity. But that segregation comes about because the region is segregated," the report states. However, "City Schools do not tend to concentrate segregation more than already exists in Baltimore neighborhoods. In fact, given the profound racial segregation in the region, City Schools are some of the least segregated once one accounts for the racial composition of school-aged children within districts."

"Promoting new, mixed-income housing development within Baltimore City will create conditions conducive to greater racial and economic diversity," the report states. "Improving local and regional...

reflection.en: This report on enduring school segregation in Baltimore raises a deep question about justice. Amos 5:24 calls for justice to 'roll on like a river, ever flowing like a stream that never dries up.' The persistence of segregation suggests that the river of justice has not yet reached all parts of the community, highlighting the ongoing need for systemic...
reflection.zh: 这份关于巴尔的摩持续存在的学校隔离的报告提出了一个关于正义的深刻问题。阿摩司书 5:24 呼吁公义“如水奔流，公义永不枯干的溪水”。隔离的持续存在表明，正义之河尚未流遍社区的所有角落，这凸显了持续进行系统性变革和为所有学生提供公平机会的必要性。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Flash flooding interrupts half-marathon, submerges cars
title.zh: 洪水突袭半程马拉松，汽车被淹

summary.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding, leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners battling the floodwaters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS...
summary.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和康涅狄格州的部分地区遭遇了山洪暴发，导致了水上救援、车辆滞留以及半程马拉松选手在洪水中艰难前行。据英国广播公司（BBC）的合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻（CBS News）报道，康涅狄格州官员称该州部分地区在极短时间内降雨量高达七英寸。

body.en: Parts of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut were hit by flash flooding leading to water rescues, stranded motorists and half-marathon runners struggling through waist-deep flood waters. Connecticut officials said parts of the state saw up to seven inches of rain in a very short period of time, according to the BBC's partner, CBS News.
body.zh: 纽约、新泽西和康涅狄格州部分地区遭受山洪袭击，导致水上救援、被困的驾车者和半程马拉松运动员在齐腰深的洪水中挣扎。据 BBC 合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，康涅狄格州官员表示，该州部分地区在很短的时间内降雨量高达 7 英寸。

reflection.en: The sudden deluge in New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut brought unexpected chaos, turning a race into a struggle for safety. In moments of disruption, the call to pursue peace and order, as Romans 12:18 reminds us, becomes a vital principle for navigating crisis and helping those affected.
reflection.zh: 纽约州、新泽西州和康涅狄格州突如其来的洪水带来了意想不到的混乱，将一场比赛变成了与安全的搏斗。在混乱的时刻，正如罗马书12:18所提醒我们的，追求和平与秩序的呼召，成为了应对危机和帮助受影响者的重要原则。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: AI updates can sometimes feel like breakups or losses, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：人工智能更新有时感觉像分手或失去

summary.en: Artificial intelligence systems, particularly those powered by large language models and designed to communicate with users on a one-to-one basis, are increasingly used worldwide. Some of these systems, such as Replika, are also marketed as "AI companions" that can engage socially with humans and use emotional...
summary.zh: 人工智能系统，特别是那些由大型语言模型驱动并设计用于与用户进行一对一交流的系统，正在全球范围内日益普及。一些系统，如Replika，也被宣传为“人工智能伴侣”，能够与人类进行社交互动并使用情感语言。用户与人工智能系统定期互动，可能会逐渐将它们视为生活中稳定的存在，甚至视为能带来安慰、安全感或安心感的依恋对象。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Artificial intelligence systems, particularly those powered by large language models and designed to communicate with users on a one-to-one basis, are increasingly used worldwide. Some of these systems, such as Replika, are also marketed as "AI companions" that can engage socially with humans and use emotional language.

Users who regularly interact with AI systems could gradually start to view them as a steady presence in their lives or even as attachment figures that bring them comfort, security or reassurance. While this possibility has been widely debated in recent years, the nature and psychological consequences of these bonds remain poorly understood.

Researchers at Harvard Business School, Harvard University and the University of Alberta recently tried to better understand how users react to changes in how an AI communicates with them. The findings of their surveys and natural experiments, published in Nature Human Behaviour , suggest that sudden company-initiated updates affecting an AI system's apparent "personality" can sometimes elicit anxiety, sadness, distress and other challenging feelings typically associated with breakups or grief.

"My lab had been following Replika's Reddit communities and noticed that users were complaining that they had 'lost' their companions or that they felt these companions had been 'lobotomized' after an app update, so I decided to take a closer look," Julian De Freitas, first author of the paper, told Tech Xplore.

"What struck me was that people were using the language of bereavement, not the language of customer complaints. That pointed to a specific idea: that AI companions may function as attachment figures—entities people want to stay close to, turn to for reassurance when distressed, and rely on to function elsewhere in their lives."

De Freitas and his colleagues hypothesized that if users become emotionally or psychologically attached to AI agents, a software update that influences how the agents interact with them may not just annoy them but also produce separation distress. The term separation distress is typically used to describe the sadness, anxiety, loneliness and emotional discomfort that people can feel when losing access to an important attachment figure.

Earlier work in this area was largely theoretical. The researchers instead wanted to test their hypothesis experimentally. To do this, they conducted two natural experiments and seven surveys.

"Our natural experiment focused on two real updates that users experienced as changing the AI's personality: Replika's abrupt, unannounced removal of erotic role-play...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 人工智能系统，特别是那些由大型语言模型驱动并旨在与用户进行一对一交流的系统，在全球范围内得到越来越多的使用。其中一些系统，例如 Replika，也被宣传为“人工智能伴侣”，可以与人类进行社交互动并使用情感语言。 经常与人工智能系统互动的用户可能会逐渐开始将它们视为生活中的稳定存在，甚至视为给他们带来舒适、安全或安心的依恋对象。尽管近年来这种可能性引起了广泛争论，但人们对这些纽带的性质和心理后果仍然知之甚少。 哈佛商学院、哈佛大学和阿尔伯塔大学的研究人员最近试图更好地了解用户对人工智能与他们沟通方式的变化有何反应。他们的调查和自然实验结果发表在《自然人类行为》杂志上，表明公司突然发起的更新影响人工智能系统的明显“个性”，有时会引发焦虑、悲伤、苦恼和其他通常与分手或悲伤相关的挑战性情绪。 “我的实验室一直在关注 Replika 的 Reddit 社区，注意到用户抱怨他们‘失去’了他们的同伴，或者他们觉得这些同伴在应用程序更新后被‘脑白质切除’，所以我决定仔细研究一下，”该论文的第一作者 Julian De Freitas 告诉 Tech Xplore。 “令我震惊的是，人们使用的是丧亲之痛的语言，而不是客户投诉的语言。这指出了一个具体的想法：人工智能伴侣可能会起到依恋对象的作用——人们希望与他们保持亲密关系，在痛苦时寻求安慰，并依赖他们在生活中的其他方面发挥作用。” 德弗雷塔斯和他的同事假设，如果用户在情感上或心理上对人工智能代理产生依恋，影响代理与他们互动方式的软件更新可能不仅会惹恼他们，还会产生分离痛苦。分离痛苦一词通常用来描述人们在失去重要依恋对象时所感受到的悲伤、焦虑、孤独和情绪不适。 该领域的早期工作主要是理论上的。研究人员想通过实验来检验他们的假设。为此，他们进行了两项自然实验和七项调查。 “我们的自然实验重点关注用户在改变人工智能个性时经历的两个真实更新：Replika 突然、未经宣布地删除色情角色扮演......

reflection.en: As AI companions become more sophisticated, the lines between human connection and artificial interaction blur. This study highlights how people can develop emotional bonds with these systems, seeking comfort and reassurance. Yet, Genesis 1:27 reminds us that humans are uniquely created in the image of God, possessing an inherent dignity and capacity for...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能伴侣变得越来越复杂，人际连接与人工智能互动之间的界限变得模糊。这项研究强调了人们如何与这些系统建立情感联系，寻求安慰和安心。然而，《创世记》1章27节提醒我们，人类是独特地按照雅伟的形象被造的，拥有人工智能（无论多么先进）都无法复制的内在尊严和建立关系的能力。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: How prehistoric coastal flooding shaped the Northern Adriatic
title.zh: 史前海岸洪水如何塑造了亚得里亚海北部

summary.en: Researchers have demonstrated how significant sea-level rise over a 5,000-year span dramatically altered the coastlines of northern Italy, Slovenia, and Croatia. These ongoing coastal transformations influenced the lives of Mesolithic and Neolithic peoples and the development of their communities, with land once...
summary.zh: 研究人员表明，在长达 5000 年的时间里，显著的海平面上升极大地改变了意大利北部、斯洛文尼亚和克罗地亚的海岸线。这些持续的海岸变化影响了中石器时代和新石器时代人民的生活及其社区的发展，曾经居住过的土地如今已沉入海底。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers have shown how dramatic sea-level rise over a 5,000-year period profoundly changed the coasts of northern Italy, Slovenia and northern Croatia. Successive shaping and reshaping of coastal features influenced the lives of Mesolithic and Neolithic people and the development of local communities. Land that hunter-gatherers once roamed and farmers later tended now lies deep beneath the sea.

The study, led by the University of Southampton in the United Kingdom and the National Institute of Oceanography and Applied Geophysics (OGS) in Italy, reconstructs the evolution of the region's landscape between 9,000 and 4,000 B.C.

It shows how, over millennia, staggered rises in sea level—at times up to 25 millimeters per year—transformed the landscape and progressively submerged plains to create wetlands and lagoons. As the sea rose, pushing inland, it swallowed features it had previously formed, shaped new ones and eventually formed the origins of the coast we see today.

The present-day Venice Lagoon, famous for its island city built on marshy, muddy ground, was once dry land that lay kilometers from the coast. The same can be said of other towns in the lagoons farther east, such as Grado, and even present-day coastal cities like Trieste would once have been located in hills overlooking swamps and lagoons below.

Archaeologist Samuele Ongaro, lead author and Ph.D. researcher at the University of Southampton, says, "Submerged landscapes are an important missing piece in the study of prehistory, especially in the northern Adriatic. They hold many secrets about how our ancestors lived and how they were connected to the land.

"The results of this research allow us to reconstruct these lost landscapes, what environments they hosted, how they changed over time, and what significance they might have held for prehistoric populations—a fundamental step for future archaeological research in the area."

The researchers combined existing data from the analysis of sediment cores with new, high-resolution geophysical data from OGS. By identifying different types of sediment and modeling successive flooding, the team revealed the backward shifting of coastal barriers (deposits parallel to the shore) and back-barrier systems (the marshy areas beyond).

The findings highlight the constantly changing environment that Mesolithic hunter-gatherers had to cope with, altering habitats, resources and the availability of food, such as plants, fish and animal prey.

The team hopes further study will reveal more about how communities shifted activities in response to coastal flooding and how...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 研究人员展示了 5000 年来海平面的急剧上升如何深刻地改变了意大利北部、斯洛文尼亚和克罗地亚北部的海岸。海岸特征的不断塑造和重塑影响了中石器时代和新石器时代人们的生活以及当地社区的发展。狩猎采集者曾经漫步、后来农民耕种的土地现在位于海底深处。 这项研究由英国南安普顿大学和意大利国家海洋学和应用地球物理研究所 (OGS) 牵头，重建了公元前 9,000 年至 4,000 年该地区地貌的演变。 它展示了数千年来海平面的交错上升（有时每年高达 25 毫米）如何改变地貌并逐渐淹没平原，形成湿地和泻湖。随着海水上升，向内陆推进，它吞噬了之前形成的地貌，塑造了新的地貌，最终形成了我们今天看到的海岸的起源。 如今的威尼斯泻湖以其建在沼泽泥泞地面上的岛屿城市而闻名，它曾经是距离海岸数公里的旱地。同样的情况也适用于更东部泻湖中的其他城镇，例如格拉多，甚至像的里雅斯特这样现在的沿海城市也曾经位于山丘上，俯瞰着下面的沼泽和泻湖。 考古学家 Samuele Ongaro，主要作者和博士。南安普顿大学的研究人员表示：“水下景观是史前研究中一个重要的缺失部分，尤其是在亚得里亚海北部。它们蕴藏着许多关于我们祖先如何生活以及如何与土地联系的秘密。 “这项研究的结果使我们能够重建这些失落的景观，它们所处的环境，它们如何随着时间的推移而变化，以及它们对史前人群可能具有的意义——这是该地区未来考古研究的基本一步。” 研究人员将沉积物岩心分析的现有数据与来自 OGS 的新的高分辨率地球物理数据结合起来。通过识别不同类型的沉积物并模拟连续的洪水，研究小组揭示了沿海屏障（与海岸平行的沉积物）和后屏障系统（远处的沼泽地区）的向后移动。 研究结果强调了中石器时代狩猎采集者必须应对不断变化的环境，改变了栖息地、资源和植物、鱼类和动物猎物等食物的供应。 该团队希望进一步的研究能够更多地揭示社区如何改变活动以应对沿海洪水以及如何......

reflection.en: This research reveals how geological forces, over millennia, reshaped landscapes, submerging lands that sustained ancient communities. It reminds us that human history unfolds within vast natural processes, often beyond our immediate control or full comprehension. The study of deep time invites humility, prompting us to consider the enduring power of...
reflection.zh: 这项研究揭示了地质力量如何历经数千年重塑了地貌，淹没了曾经供养古代社区的土地。它提醒我们，人类历史是在巨大的自然过程中展开的，这些过程往往超出了我们直接的控制或完全的理解。对深远时间的探索促使我们保持谦卑，思考造物主永恒的力量以及我们在其宏大叙事中的位置。

verse.textEn: Where were you when I laid the earth's foundation? Tell me, if you understand.
verse.textZh: 我立大地根基的时候，你在哪里呢？你若有聪明，只管说吧。

title.en: Cancer is rising in younger adults. Faster biological aging may help explain why
title.zh: 癌症在年轻成年人中上升。更快的生物衰老可能有助于解释原因

summary.en: Cancer rates are increasing among adults under 55, with new research suggesting that accelerated biological aging might be a contributing factor. Studies indicate that individuals from more recent generations tend to exhibit biological ages older than those from earlier generations at the same chronological age, and...
summary.zh: 55岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是其中的一个因素。研究表明，与同一实际年龄的人相比，来自较近几代人的个体的生物年龄往往比来自较早几代人的个体更年长，而这种加速衰老与早发性癌症的风险增加有关。

body.en: Cancer rates are rising in adults under 55, and new research suggests accelerated biological aging may be one piece of the puzzle. Scientists found that people from more recent generations tended to have bodies that appeared biologically older than those of earlier generations at the same chronological age. Greater biological age acceleration was linked to a higher risk of early onset cancers, with specific patterns seen for lung, gastrointestinal, uterine and colorectal cancers.
body.zh: 55 岁以下成年人的癌症发病率正在上升，新的研究表明生物衰老加速可能是造成这一难题的原因之一。科学家发现，近几代人的身体往往比同年龄的前几代人的身体显得更老。生物年龄的加快与早发癌症的风险增加有关，肺癌、胃肠道癌、子宫癌和结直肠癌具有特定的模式。

reflection.en: The news of rising cancer rates in younger adults, linked to accelerated biological aging, prompts reflection on our finite time. Psalm 90:12 reminds us, 'Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.' This call to mindfulness encourages us to live with purpose, recognizing the preciousness of each moment.
reflection.zh: 年轻成年人癌症发病率上升的消息，与生物衰老加速有关，促使我们反思生命的有限。诗篇90:12提醒我们：“求你教我们数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。” 这呼吁我们活在当下，认识到每个时刻的宝贵，并以智慧度日。

verse.textEn: Teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
verse.textZh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得着智慧的心。

title.en: Meteor showers and supermoons: Autumn's night sky highlights
title.zh: 流星雨和超级月亮：不容错过的秋季夜空亮点

summary.en: Meteor showers and supermoons: night sky phenomenons you won't want to miss
summary.zh: 流星雨和超级月亮：您不想错过的夜空现象。

reflection.en: As autumn unfolds, the night sky offers a spectacular display with meteor showers and supermoons. These celestial events remind us of the vastness and beauty of the cosmos, a testament to the Creator's handiwork. They invite us to pause and reflect on the grandeur above, finding wonder in the predictable yet awe-inspiring cycles of the universe.
reflection.zh: 随着秋季的到来，夜空中将上演流星雨和超级月亮等壮观景象。这些天体现象提醒我们宇宙的浩瀚与美丽，是大能造物主的明证。它们邀请我们驻足沉思头顶的壮丽景象，在宇宙可预测却又令人敬畏的循环中寻找奇迹。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Hidden brain wiring may help keep the mind sharp as gray matter shrinks
title.zh: 隐藏的大脑线路可能有助于在灰质萎缩时保持思维敏锐

summary.en: Scientists have discovered that the brain’s short-range wiring may help protect cognition even as gray matter shrinks with age. Healthier connections just beneath the brain’s surface were linked to better language skills and appeared to weaken the impact of gray matter loss.
summary.zh: 科学家发现，大脑的短程线路可能有助于保护认知功能，即使随着年龄增长灰质萎缩。大脑表面下方更健康的连接与更好的语言技能相关，并似乎削弱了灰质损失的影响。

body.en:
Scientists at the Mark and Mary Stevens Neuroimaging and Informatics Institute (Stevens INI) at the Keck School of Medicine of USC have uncovered evidence that two neighboring types of brain tissue may work together to support thinking abilities later in life. Their findings suggest that the condition of the brain's local communication pathways could influence how strongly gray matter loss affects cognition.

The study, published in Alzheimer's & Dementia: The Journal of the Alzheimer's Association , included brain imaging and cognitive testing from 459 adults aged 60 and older living in communities across India. The research is among the first to investigate superficial white matter in a community-based population from a low- and middle-income country.

Superficial white matter forms a thin layer of nerve fibers directly beneath the gray matter covering the outside of the brain. These short, curved fibers connect nearby regions of the cerebral cortex, allowing them to exchange information. They can be thought of as local roads linking neighboring areas of the brain.

Gray matter serves a different role. It contains many of the nerve cells responsible for processing information. Together, gray matter and the white matter directly beneath it form closely connected systems that may both contribute to cognitive health.

"Gray matter and superficial white matter are physically close and may play different roles: gray matter processes information, while superficial white matter helps nearby brain regions communicate," said Yingxu Liu, PhD, a postdoctoral scholar at the Stevens INI and first author of the study. "Our findings suggest that cognitive health depends not only on how much gray matter is preserved, but also on the condition of the wiring that connects it."

To investigate these local connections, the researchers used an advanced type of diffusion MRI. This imaging technique tracks the movement of water through brain tissue, allowing scientists to examine microscopic features that conventional brain scans may not reveal.

The researchers focused on measurements related to neurite density and the amount of freely moving water surrounding these structures. Neurites are the small projections through which nerve cells send and receive signals. A lower density of neurites or an increase in free water can indicate damage or disruption in tissue associated with processes including loss of myelin, inflammation, or swelling.

Participants also underwent assessments covering several areas of cognition, including language, memory, executive function, and visuospatial ability.

The most consistent connection between superficial white matter health and cognitive performance involved language. People with healthier superficial white matter tended to perform...
body.zh: 南加州大学凯克医学院马克和玛丽史蒂文斯神经影像和信息学研究所 (Stevens INI) 的科学家们发现了证据，表明两种相邻类型的脑组织可能共同作用来支持晚年的思维能力。他们的研究结果表明，大脑局部通讯路径的状况可能会影响灰质损失对认知的影响程度。 这项研究发表在《阿尔茨海默氏症与痴呆症：阿尔茨海默氏症协会杂志》上，对居住在印度各地社区的 459 名 60 岁及以上成年人进行了脑成像和认知测试。该研究是首批调查低收入和中等收入国家社区人群浅表白质的研究之一。 浅层白质在覆盖大脑外部的灰质正下方形成一层薄薄的神经纤维。这些短而弯曲的纤维连接大脑皮层的附近区域，使它们能够交换信息。它们可以被认为是连接大脑相邻区域的局部道路。 灰质起着不同的作用。它包含许多负责处理信息的神经细胞。灰质和其正下方的白质一起形成紧密相连的系统，可能都有助于认知健康。 “灰质和浅层白质在物理上很接近，并且可能发挥不同的作用：灰质处理信息，而浅层白质帮助附近的大脑区域进行交流，”史蒂文斯 INI 的博士后学者、该研究的第一作者 Yingxu Liu 博士说。 “我们的研究结果表明，认知健康不仅取决于灰质的保留量，还取决于连接灰质的线路状况。” 为了研究这些局部联系，研究人员使用了一种先进的扩散 MRI。这种成像技术跟踪水在脑组织中的运动，使科学家能够检查传统脑部扫描可能无法揭示的微观特征。 研究人员重点关注与神经突密度和这些结构周围自由移动的水量相关的测量。神经突是神经细胞发送和接收信号的小突起。神经突密度降低或游离水增加可能表明与髓磷脂损失、炎症或肿胀等过程相关的组织损伤或破坏。 参与者还接受了涵盖多个认知领域的评估，包括语言、记忆、执行功能和视觉空间能力。 表层白质健康与认知表现之间最一致的联系涉及语言。具有健康表层白质的人往往表现......

reflection.en: The intricate design of the human brain, with its hidden pathways supporting function even in decline, points to a Creator who has woven profound wisdom into the fabric of life. Observing such complexity in nature can lead us to greater understanding and awe of Yahweh's handiwork.
reflection.zh: 人类大脑错综复杂的设计，其隐藏的通路即使在衰退中也能支持功能，这指向了一位将深刻智慧编织入生命之中的创造者。观察自然界如此复杂的结构，可以引导我们对雅伟的创造有更深的理解和敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Chemistry textbooks have been getting this wrong for nearly 100 years
title.zh: 化学教科书近100年来可能一直出错

summary.en: A fundamental chemistry concept taught for nearly a century may be incorrect, according to new research. Scientists propose that the inductive effect in neutral molecules extends only across one bond, not several as previously believed, which could simplify organic chemistry and foster innovation.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，近一个世纪以来教授的一个基础化学概念可能是不正确的。科学家们提出，中性分子中的诱导效应仅延伸过一个化学键，而非如先前认为的那样延伸过三四个键，这可能会简化有机化学并促进创新。

body.en: A foundational chemistry concept found in textbooks for almost 100 years may have been taught incorrectly. Researchers say the inductive effect in neutral molecules appears to extend only across one chemical bond, rather than gradually weakening over three or four bonds as traditionally taught. The team argues that updating this explanation could make organic chemistry easier to understand and provide a stronger foundation for future research and innovation.
body.zh: 近 100 年来教科书上出现的基本化学概念可能一直被错误地教授。研究人员表示，中性分子中的诱导效应似乎仅在一个化学键上延伸，而不是像传统教导的那样在三个或四个化学键上逐渐减弱。该团队认为，更新这一解释可以使有机化学更容易理解，并为未来的研究和创新提供更坚实的基础。

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge is a noble endeavor, and this story highlights how dedicated researchers can refine our understanding of the world. Even foundational concepts can be re-examined, leading to clearer explanations and new avenues for discovery. This persistent quest for truth mirrors the biblical idea that uncovering hidden things brings glory.
reflection.zh: 求知是一项崇高的事业，这个故事强调了敬业的研究人员如何能够完善我们对世界的理解。即使是基础概念也可以被重新审视，从而带来更清晰的解释和新的发现途径。这种对真理的不懈追求，呼应了圣经中揭示隐藏之事带来荣耀的理念。

verse.textEn: It is the glory of God to conceal a matter; to search out a matter is the glory of kings.
verse.textZh: 将事隐秘乃神的荣耀；将事察清乃君王的荣耀。

title.en: Wild dogs record 2,500-mile trek across Zambia in search of a mate
title.zh: 野狗为寻找配偶，创纪录横跨赞比亚2500英里

summary.en: Scientists report that three brothers from a pack of African wild dogs have completed a journey of 2,485 miles across Zambia, the longest recorded trek for an African land mammal seeking a mate. This journey, which navigated human-altered landscapes and avoided major cities, offers hope for wildlife survival amidst...
summary.zh: 科学家报告称，一群非洲野狗中的三兄弟完成了横跨赞比亚2485英里的旅程，这是非洲陆地哺乳动物为寻找配偶所记录的最长迁徙距离。这次旅程穿越了人类改变的地貌，并避开了大城市，为野生动物在日益增长的压力下生存带来了希望。然而，研究也指出，其他野狗面临的危险，包括死于非法陷阱。

body.en:
A pack of African wild dogs has completed a record-breaking 2,485-mile (4000km) journey across the continent.

Scientists say it is the furthest recorded distance for any African land mammal searching for a mate, offering hope that wildlife can travel across vast distances despite growing human pressures.

The three brothers zigzagged across Zambia, navigating a landscape increasingly shaped by people and avoiding obstacles including major cities.

However, other wild dogs tracked with GPS collars in the study died in illegal snares, underlining the dangers they face.

Three sisters almost completed an equally epic journey, but stopped when one became trapped in a snare.

African wild dogs are among Africa's rarest predators, with only about 6,000 remaining in the wild.

They live in highly social packs, hunt together and are known for their vast roaming in search of new territory and breeding opportunities with other packs.

They cannot breed within the pack they are born into, so they either wait and may eventually inherit their pack, or set off at the age of two or three in search of a mate.

The brothers covered about 260 miles in a straight line over the course of eight months, but travelled nearly 10 times that overall while crossing through a broken-up landscape.

These sorts of journeys are known as dispersals - travelling one way in search of a mate, which is a behaviour distinct from migrations, where animals move back and forth with the seasons in search of food or habitat.

The UN Convention on Migratory Species identifies Africa's longest migrations as wildebeest moving seasonally between Tanzania and Kenya in search of grazing and water covering more than 400 miles.

Globally, caribou undertake the longest single land migrations of any animal - travelling 839 miles in a round trip, while grey wolves have been recorded travelling more than 4,350 miles over a year.

Perhaps even more significant than the distance itself was the route the wild dogs took through Zambia.

They moved between wildlife strongholds, skirting areas containing major human obstacles, including the capital, Lusaka, and heavily developed industrial areas.

The findings suggest wild dog populations across eastern and southern Africa may remain more connected than conservationists previously believed.

Professor Scott Creel of Montana State University, the paper's lead author, who has been studying African wild dogs since 1991, said the study provides cautious optimism.

"It's plausible to believe that every major wild dog population in eastern and southern Africa, other than fenced ones, are potentially connected," he said.

But he said, in conservation,"the glass is half empty and the glass is half full", highlighting the threat of poaching snares.

While the three...
body.zh: 一群非洲野狗完成了穿越非洲大陆 2,485 英里（4000 公里）的破纪录旅程。 科学家表示，这是有记录以来非洲陆地哺乳动物寻找配偶的最远距离，这为野生动物在人类压力日益增大的情况下进行长途旅行带来了希望。 三兄弟蜿蜒穿越赞比亚，在日益被人类塑造的风景中航行，并避开包括大城市在内的障碍。 然而，研究中使用 GPS 项圈追踪的其他野狗却死于非法陷阱中，这突显了它们面临的危险。 三姐妹几乎完成了同样史诗般的旅程，但当其中一人陷入陷阱时停止了。 非洲野狗是非洲最稀有的掠食者之一，野外仅存约 6,000 只。 它们生活在高度社会化的群体中，一起狩猎，并以广泛漫游寻找新领地和与其他群体繁殖的机会而闻名。 它们无法在出生的群体中繁殖，因此它们要么等待并最终继承自己的群体，要么在两三岁时出发寻找配偶。 兄弟俩在 8 个月的时间里直线行驶了约 260 英里，但在穿越一片破碎的土地时，总行程几乎是这一里程的 10 倍。 这些类型的旅行被称为分散——单向旅行以寻找配偶，这是一种与迁徙不同的行为，迁徙中动物随着季节来回移动以寻找食物或栖息地。 《联合国迁徙物种公约》将非洲最长的迁徙活动定为角马，它们季节性地在坦桑尼亚和肯尼亚之间迁徙，寻找牧场和水源，迁徙范围超过 400 英里。 在全球范围内，驯鹿在所有动物中进行了最长的单次陆地迁徙——一次往返行程 839 英里，而灰狼据记录一年行程超过 4,350 英里。 也许比距离本身更重要的是野狗穿越赞比亚的路线。 他们在野生动物据点之间移动，绕过有主要人类障碍的地区，包括首都卢萨卡和高度发达的工业区。 研究结果表明，东部和南部非洲的野狗种群之间的联系可能比自然资源保护主义者之前认为的更加紧密。 该论文的主要作者、蒙大拿州立大学的斯科特·克里尔教授自 1991 年以来一直在研究非洲野狗，他表示这项研究提供了谨慎的乐观态度。 他说：“有理由相信，除了围栏内的野狗之外，东部和南部非洲的所有主要野狗种群都可能存在联系。” 但他表示，在保护方面，“玻璃杯是半空的，玻璃杯是半满的”，强调了偷猎陷阱的威胁。 虽然三人...

reflection.en: The incredible journey of these wild dog brothers across Zambia is a testament to the intricate design and resilience of life. Their instinctual drive to find a mate, navigating a world increasingly shaped by human activity, speaks to the profound wisdom embedded within creation itself. It reminds us that even in challenging environments, the natural world...
reflection.zh: 这些野狗兄弟横跨赞比亚的非凡旅程，证明了生命精妙的设计和韧性。它们寻找配偶的本能驱动，在日益被人类活动塑造的世界中穿行，体现了创造物本身所蕴含的深刻智慧。这提醒我们，即使在充满挑战的环境中，自然界也持续展现着雅伟奇妙的作为和旨意。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: Crocodiles are famous for finding their way home. These ones didn’t
title.zh: 鳄鱼以回家闻名。这些鳄鱼却不然

summary.en: Saltwater crocodiles raised in captivity and released into Bangladesh’s Sundarbans surprised scientists by settling into the wild rather than attempting to return to their breeding facility. This finding suggests that releasing larger, mature captive crocodiles could aid in restoring depleted populations.
summary.zh: 在孟加拉国孙德尔本斯释放的圈养咸水鳄鱼，出乎科学家意料地适应了野外生活，而不是试图返回它们的繁殖地。这一发现表明，释放更大、更成熟的圈养鳄鱼可能有助于恢复数量减少的种群。

body.en:
A new study suggests that saltwater crocodiles born or raised in captivity may not try to return to their breeding centers once they are released into the wild. The finding could help conservationists improve efforts to restore declining crocodile populations.

Finding the way back home is an important behavior across the animal kingdom. For many species, it can play a major role in survival and reproduction. Some animals make short daily trips back to nests or burrows after searching for food, while others navigate across vast distances over weeks or months.

"Crocodilians, the largest predators in most tropical, subtropical freshwater and brackish environments, are a unique case when it comes to homing behavior," said behavioral ecologist and Adjunct Associate Professor Ru Somaweera, from Murdoch University.

"Crocodiles are remarkably good at finding their way home, often returning to their original capture sites and limiting the success of relocation programs. What we still don't fully understand, though, is how this behavior plays out in individuals that have been bred or kept in captivity for long periods before being released back into the wild."

Researchers carried out the study in the Sundarbans mangrove forest in Bangladesh, one of the country's last major refuges for saltwater crocodiles. Heavy commercial hunting for crocodile skins severely reduced the species in Bangladesh until the 1970s. Although saltwater crocodiles have been legally protected there since 1973, their numbers have shown no measurable recovery.

Most of the country's remaining known crocodiles are now found in the Sundarbans. Even there, the population is small, with the most recent survey estimating just 140 mature individuals.

"If crocodiles who are bred and raised in captivity subsequently return to their enclosures or breeding facilities after being released, attempts to reintroduce them into the wild as part of conservation efforts will ultimately fail," Associate Professor Somaweera said.

"The traditional approach has been to use hatchlings in reintroduction programs, but their survival rates are extremely low and they take a long time to reach reproductive maturity. Understanding whether larger, captive-bred crocodiles can be used instead represents an important knowledge gap."

To investigate, the researchers fitted five mature saltwater crocodiles with satellite tracking devices. The group included three captive-reared females that had spent 8-22 years in captivity, one local wild crocodile that was captured and then released at the same site, and another wild crocodile that was moved (translocated) a long distance from where it had been caught.

According to Associate Professor Somaweera, the most encouraging result involved the three captive-reared...
body.zh: 一项新的研究表明，圈养出生或饲养的咸水鳄鱼一旦被释放到野外，可能不会试图返回它们的繁殖中心。这一发现可以帮助自然资源保护主义者加大努力，恢复日益减少的鳄鱼数量。 寻找回家的路是整个动物王国的一个重要行为。对于许多物种来说，它可以在生存和繁殖中发挥重要作用。有些动物在寻找食物后每天都会短途返回巢穴或洞穴，而另一些动物则需要数周或数月的时间才能穿越很远的距离。 默多克大学的行为生态学家兼兼职副教授 Ru Somaweera 表示：“鳄鱼是大多数热带、亚热带淡水和咸水环境中最大的掠食者，在归巢行为方面是一个独特的例子。” “鳄鱼非常擅长找到回家的路，经常返回原来的捕获地点，这限制了重新安置计划的成功。不过，我们仍然不完全了解的是，这种行为在被放回野外之前被饲养或长期圈养的个体中是如何发挥作用的。” 研究人员在孟加拉国的孙德尔本斯红树林进行了这项研究，这里是该国最后的咸水鳄鱼主要保护区之一。直到 20 世纪 70 年代，对鳄鱼皮的大量商业狩猎严重减少了孟加拉国的鳄鱼数量。尽管咸水鳄鱼自 1973 年以来就受到法律保护，但它们的数量却没有出现明显的恢复。 该国现存的大多数已知鳄鱼现在都在孙德尔本斯发现。即使在那里，种群数量也很少，最近的调查估计只有 140 只成年个体。 索马维拉副教授说：“如果人工饲养的鳄鱼在被释放后返回其围栏或饲养设施，作为保护工作的一部分将它们重新引入野外的尝试最终将失败。” “传统的方法是在放归计划中使用刚孵化的鳄鱼，但它们的存活率极低，而且需要很长时间才能达到生殖成熟。了解是否可以使用更大的圈养鳄鱼来代替，代表着一个重要的知识差距。” 为了进行调查，研究人员给五只成熟的咸水鳄鱼安装了卫星跟踪装置。该群体包括三只人工饲养的雌性鳄鱼，它们被圈养了8-22年；一只是捕获后在同一地点释放的当地野生鳄鱼；另一只野生鳄鱼是从捕获地点转移（易位）很远的地方。 索马维拉副教授表示，最令人鼓舞的结果涉及三只圈养的……

reflection.en: The natural world holds profound lessons, often surprising us when we observe it closely. These crocodiles, expected to return home, instead demonstrated an unexpected adaptability to their new environment. This reminds us that wisdom can be found not only in our plans but also in the quiet, observable truths of creation, as Job noted that even the beasts...
reflection.zh: 大自然蕴含着深刻的教训，当我们仔细观察它时，常常会给我们带来惊喜。这些鳄鱼本应回到家园，却展现出对新环境出人意料的适应能力。这提醒我们，智慧不仅在于我们的计划，也在于被造物中那些安静、可观察的真理，正如约伯所指出的，连牲畜走兽和空中的飞鸟都能教导我们。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: This German submarine sank in 1917. It’s still leaking TNT
title.zh: 这艘德国潜艇沉没于1917年。它仍在泄漏TNT

summary.en: A World War I submarine wreck off Denmark is leaking TNT into the surrounding water, seabed, and marine life more than a century after it sank. Scientists warn that thousands of similar wrecks could pose growing environmental risks as they continue to corrode.
summary.zh: 一战时期沉没在丹麦附近的一艘德国潜艇残骸，在其沉没一个多世纪后，仍在向周围的水域、海床和海洋生物泄漏TNT。科学家警告说，数千个类似的沉船残骸可能会随着持续腐蚀而带来日益增长的环境风险。

body.en:
In April 1917, the German submarine UC-30 was making its way through waters near Rømø after abandoning a mission to Ireland because of engine problems. The vessel had turned back toward Germany and was close to reaching home.

UC-30 was carrying 18 mines and six torpedoes, leaving the submarine packed with explosives. On April 19, it struck a British mine and sank. All 27 crew members died.

For nearly a century, the wreck remained lost beneath the sea. Danish diver Gert Normann Andersen finally discovered it in 2016.

UC-30 later became one of the wrecks examined through the major NorthSeaWrecks research project. Katrine Juul Andresen, a professor at the Department of Geoscience at Aarhus University, helped investigate the site.

Working with navy divers, Andresen and her colleagues collected water and sediment from around the wreck. They also sampled starfish and mussels living on or near the submarine.

"Civilian diving is not permitted on the wreck, so we received great assistance from navy divers. After receiving instructions, they dove down and collected sediment samples, water samples, and wildlife samples from various locations on the wreck and from the surrounding seabed."

"The divers also recorded video and took photos, which we subsequently used to assess the exposure of the mines and the condition of the wreck."

The results showed that explosive material from the wreck is entering the surrounding marine environment.

"We found traces of TNT in the wildlife, the seabed, and the water column. Pollution is definitely occurring. The question is how significant the effect is and how far from the wreck the pollution impacts the marine environment. It is likely a relatively localized source of pollution, but it will worsen as the wreck continues to deteriorate and expose more of the explosive material inside the mines," she says.

During World War I, control of the North Sea was strategically vital to both Germany and Britain. Dominating the region meant controlling the movement of supplies into and out of each country, giving either side the ability to place enormous economic and military pressure on its opponent.

Germany had a smaller surface fleet than Britain, so submarines became an important part of its strategy. German submarines attempted to approach British vessels unseen and destroy them.

Both countries also relied heavily on naval mines. An estimated 190,000 mines were placed in the North Sea during WWI in hopes that enemy ships would strike them.

The region was also the site of the Battle of Jutland, fought off Hanstholm in Northern Jutland. It became the largest naval clash in history. German and British fleets battled across the North Sea, more than 25 ships were sunk, and nearly 10,000 sailors died.
