body.zh: 1917 年 4 月，德国潜艇 UC-30 由于发动机问题放弃了前往爱尔兰的任务，正在穿越罗莫附近的水域。该船已返回德国，即将返航。 UC-30 携带 18 枚水雷和 6 枚鱼雷，潜艇内装满了炸药。 4月19日，它触礁沉没。 27名船员全部遇难。 近一个世纪以来，沉船一直沉没在海底。丹麦潜水员格特·诺曼·安德森 (Gert Normann Andersen) 终于在 2016 年发现了它。 UC-30 后来成为通过北海沉船研究项目进行检查的沉船之一。奥胡斯大学地球科学系教授卡特琳·朱尔·安德烈森 (Katrine Juul Andresen) 帮助调查了该地点。 安德烈森和她的同事与海军潜水员合作，从沉船周围收集了水和沉积物。他们还对生活在潜艇上或附近的海星和贻贝进行了采样。 “沉船上不允许民用潜水，因此我们得到了海军潜水员的大力帮助。他们在接到指示后潜入水中，从沉船的各个位置和周围海底收集了沉积物样本、水样和野生动物样本。” “潜水员还录制了视频和照片，我们随后用这些视频和照片来评估水雷的暴露程度和沉船的状况。” 结果显示，沉船中的爆炸物质正在进入周围的海洋环境。 “我们在野生动物、海底和水体中发现了TNT的痕迹。污染肯定正在发生。问题是影响有多大，以及污染对海洋环境的影响有多大，以及距离沉船多远。这可能是一个相对局部的污染源，但随着沉船继续恶化并暴露出更多的矿井内爆炸物质，情况将会恶化，”她说。 第一次世界大战期间，控制北海对于德国和英国都具有重要的战略意义。统治该地区意味着控制物资进出每个国家的流动，使任何一方都有能力向对手施加巨大的经济和军事压力。 德国的水面舰队规模比英国小，因此潜艇成为其战略的重要组成部分。德国潜艇试图在不被发现的情况下接近英国船只并摧毁它们。 两国还严重依赖水雷。第一次世界大战期间，估计在北海埋设了 190,000 枚水雷，希望敌舰能够对其进行攻击。 该地区也是日德兰海战的发生地，这场战役是在日德兰半岛北部与汉斯托姆岛交战的。它成为历史上最大规模的海战。德国和英国舰队横跨北海激战，超过25艘船只被击沉，近万名水手死亡。 那些...

reflection.en: The discovery of the UC-30 submarine, still leaking explosives over a century later, serves as a stark reminder of humanity's impact on the natural world. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'work the garden and keep it.' This ancient charge is a timeless mandate to steward creation, recognizing that our actions, even those from a century ago, can have lasting...
reflection.zh: UC-30潜艇残骸的发现，在沉没一个多世纪后仍在泄漏爆炸物，这鲜明地提醒我们人类对自然界的影响。《创世记》2:15呼召我们“耕耘照料”。这一古老的命令是管理受造界的永恒使命，认识到我们的行为，即使是百年前的行为，也会对我们被呼召去保护的环境产生持久的影响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Starlink broadband pilot targets rural 'not spots'
title.zh: Starlink宽带试点项目针对农村“盲区”

summary.en: Farmers in Lincolnshire are invited to participate in a trial of Elon Musk's Starlink satellite broadband system, aimed at improving internet connectivity in rural areas that lack access to fiber optic services. The County Council is exploring this as a practical solution for farms and rural businesses.
summary.zh: 林肯郡的农民被邀请参加埃隆·马斯克星链卫星宽带系统的试点项目，旨在改善缺乏光纤接入的农村地区的互联网连接。郡议会正在探索这是否能为农场和农村企业提供切实可行的解决方案。

body.en:
Elon Musk's Starlink satellite system is set to be used to improve farmers' broadband connections during a pilot scheme.

Lincolnshire County Council said it wanted to purchase and install Starlink facilities for so-called "not spot" properties that do not have access to fibre broadband.

The council owns a County Farms Estate, comprising about 16,500 acres and 149 holdings for tenants.

Paul Lock, executive councillor for the economy, said: "This pilot will help us see whether satellite broadband could offer a real practical solution for farms and other rural businesses that struggle with poor connectivity."

He added: "Today, so much farming depends on being connected, from paperwork and accounting, to livestock management, or simply everyday communication.

"In reality, it's becoming harder and harder to run a business without good internet access."

Musk's SpaceX company has launched thousands of Starlink satellites into orbit in order to provide internet services, including in remote and rural areas.

The council's pilot scheme, which has been developed alongside the Greater Lincolnshire Forum for Agriculture and Horticulture, aims to "develop potential solutions to rural connectivity".

Once the infrastructure is in place on the ground, farmers would need to subscribe to Starlink to use the service.

Listen to highlights from Lincolnshire on BBC Sounds , watch the latest episode of Look North .
body.zh: 埃隆·马斯克的星链卫星系统将在试点计划中用于改善农民的宽带连接。 林肯郡郡议会表示，希望为无法接入光纤宽带的所谓“非现货”房产购买并安装星链设施。 该委员会拥有一个县农场庄园，占地约 16,500 英亩，共有 149 块土地供租户使用。 经济执行委员保罗·洛克表示：“该试点项目将帮助我们了解卫星宽带是否可以为农场和其他因连接不良而苦苦挣扎的农村企业提供真正实用的解决方案。” 他补充道：“如今，农业在很大程度上依赖于互联，从文书工作和会计到牲畜管理，或者仅仅是日常沟通。 “事实上，如果没有良好的互联网接入，经营企业变得越来越困难。” 马斯克的 SpaceX 公司已将数千颗 Starlink 卫星送入轨道，以提供互联网服务，包括在偏远和农村地区。 该委员会的试点计划是与大林肯郡农业和园艺论坛一起制定的，旨在“开发农村互联互通的潜在解决方案”。 一旦基础设施到位，农民就需要订阅星链才能使用该服务。 通过 BBC Sounds 收听林肯郡的精彩片段，观看最新一集的 Look North。

reflection.en: This pilot program in Lincolnshire seeks to bridge the digital divide for farmers, recognizing that modern agriculture depends heavily on connectivity. It's a practical step to address a need, reflecting the wisdom of planning and investing in tools that can enhance productivity and daily operations. Committing such efforts to God acknowledges that ultimate...
reflection.zh: 林肯郡的这个试点项目旨在弥合农民之间的数字鸿沟，认识到现代农业在很大程度上依赖于网络连接。这是一个解决需求的实际步骤，体现了规划和投资能提高生产力和日常运营的工具的智慧。将这些努力托付给雅伟，是承认最终的成功和益处来自于祂对我们工作的祝福。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: £100,000 boost for community eco-friendly projects
title.zh: 为社区环保项目提供10万英镑资助

summary.en: Community groups and young people across the West Midlands are invited to apply for grants to fund environmentally-friendly projects, with up to £5,000 available for groups and up to £2,500 for individuals aged 15-24.
summary.zh: 西米德兰兹地区的社区团体和年轻人被邀请申请资助，以支持环保项目，团体可获得高达5000英镑的资助，15至24岁的个人可获得高达2500英镑的资助。

body.en:
A share of £100,000 is being offered to community groups and young people to be used for environmentally-friendly projects.

Groups can apply for up to £5,000 from the grant, which is being given out by the West Midlands Combined Authority (WMCA) as part of its Circular Economy Call to Action Fund.

The authority has teamed up with Bloomberg Philanthropies to set up a separate pot for 15 to 24-year-olds, the Youth Climate Action Fund, which offers grants of up to £2,500.

"There are so many brilliant things happening in our communities to make them greener, healthier and more resilient," West Midlands Mayor Richard Parker said.

He added: "From planting trees and encouraging people to walk and cycle, to repairing rather than throwing things away.

"These may seem like small things but they are making a big difference to people's lives and helping to create a real sense of pride in these neighbourhoods.

"I'm all for that, so I'm getting behind these community groups with the funding and expertise they need to get more great ideas off the ground and widen their impact."

Projects need to have a focus on improving air quality, helping communities adapt to climate change or restoring nature across Wolverhampton, Sandwell, Walsall, Dudley, Birmingham, Solihull and Coventry.

Follow BBC Wolverhampton & Black Country on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 向社区团体和年轻人提供 10 万英镑的份额，用于环保项目。 团体可以从这笔赠款中申请最多 5,000 英镑，这笔赠款由西米德兰兹联合管理局 (WMCA) 作为其循环经济行动号召基金的一部分提供。 该机构与彭博慈善基金会合作，为 15 至 24 岁的青少年设立了一个单独的基金，即青年气候行动基金，提供高达 2,500 英镑的赠款。 西米德兰兹郡市长理查德·帕克 (Richard Parker) 表示：“我们的社区发生了许多精彩的事情，使它们变得更环保、更健康、更有弹性。” 他补充道：“从植树、鼓励人们步行和骑自行车，到修复而不是扔掉东西。 “这些看起来可能是小事，但它们对人们的生活产生了很大的影响，并有助于为这些社区创造真正的自豪感。 “我完全支持这一点，所以我会为这些社区团体提供他们所需的资金和专业知识，以实现更多伟大的想法并扩大其影响力。” 项目需要重点关注改善空气质量，帮助社区适应气候变化或恢复伍尔弗汉普顿、桑德韦尔、沃尔索尔、达德利、伯明翰、索利哈尔和考文垂的自然。 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Wolverhampton & Black Country。

reflection.en: The Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh, the world and all who live in it. This grant initiative in the West Midlands encourages stewardship of creation, empowering communities to undertake projects that foster environmental health and resilience. It’s a practical expression of recognizing our responsibility for the world entrusted to us.
reflection.zh: 雅伟拥有大地，以及其中万有；世界和其中一切的居民都属祂。西米德兰兹地区这项资助计划鼓励人们管理受造物，赋能社区开展促进环境健康和韧性的项目。这是认识到我们对受托之世界的责任的一种实际表达。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Scientists find nine new sponge species in glimpse of Alaska’s deep-sea diversity
title.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加深海发现九种新海绵物种，一窥其多样性

summary.en: Scientists have discovered nine new species of deep-sea sponges in Alaska, contributing to our understanding of the region's largely unexplored marine biodiversity. These findings expand the known sponge species count in Alaska to 232, but their habitat faces threats from bottom trawling and potential seafloor mining.
summary.zh: 科学家在阿拉斯加发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，增进了我们对该地区未充分探索的海洋生物多样性的认识。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种数量增至232种，但它们的栖息地正面临海底拖网捕捞和潜在的海底采矿的威胁。

body.en: But their habitat is threatened by bottom trawling in the region and Trump’s plan to expand seafloor mining Scientists have discovered nine new deep-sea sponge species off Alaska, offering new insights into the region’s largely unexplored marine biodiversity. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) announced the discovery on Thursday, saying the species were found in the Gulf of Alaska and the Aleutian Islands. The findings bring the total number of known sponge species in Alaska to 232. Continue reading...
body.zh: 但它们的栖息地受到该地区海底拖网捕捞和特朗普扩大海底采矿计划的威胁。科学家们在阿拉斯加附近发现了九种新的深海海绵物种，为该地区基本上未经探索的海洋生物多样性提供了新的见解。美国国家海洋和大气管理局（Noaa）周四宣布了这一发现，称该物种是在阿拉斯加湾和阿留申群岛发现的。这些发现使阿拉斯加已知的海绵物种总数达到 232 种。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The deep sea, a realm of mystery and wonder, continues to reveal Yahweh's intricate artistry. The discovery of these nine new sponge species reminds us of the vastness of creation and the profound wisdom inherent in its design. Even as these fragile ecosystems face threats, their existence points to the Creator's boundless creativity and the importance of...
reflection.zh: 深海，一个充满神秘和奇迹的领域，不断揭示雅伟那精妙的艺术。这九种新海绵物种的发现提醒我们造物的浩瀚以及其中蕴含的深刻智慧。即使这些脆弱的生态系统面临威胁，它们的存在也彰显了造物主无限的创造力，以及珍视祂所造生命的意义。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Starwatch: A Venus-spotting challenge with a beautiful reward
title.zh: 观星：一次挑战与美丽的回报

summary.en: This week's Starwatch feature presents a challenge: spotting the planet Venus in the early evening sky. On Monday, Venus will appear close to a young, thinly illuminated crescent moon, offering a beautiful celestial pairing for those who can find it.
summary.zh: 本周的观星指南提出了一项挑战：在傍晚时分寻找金星。周一，金星将与一弯细细的月牙近距离相伴，为成功找到它的人们带来美丽的星空景象。

body.en: The bright planet and the young crescent moon will make an attractive pairing on Monday evening This week’s Starwatch is a challenge but a beautiful reward awaits for anyone who succeeds. The question is: how early in the evening can we find Venus? On Monday, the bright planet has a close encounter with a young crescent moon. The moon will be just over three days old with about 14% of its visible surface illuminated. Unfortunately for UK observers, the two make their closest approach during daylight, passing within a moon’s width of one another around lunchtime. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这颗明亮的行星和年轻的新月将在周一晚上形成一对有吸引力的配对。本周的观星活动是一项挑战，但任何成功的人都会得到丰厚的奖励。问题是：晚上多久我们才能找到金星？周一，这颗明亮的行星与一颗年轻的新月亲密接触。月球诞生仅三天多一点，其可见表面的约 14% 会被照亮。对于英国观察者来说不幸的是，两者在白天最接近，在午餐时间彼此擦肩而过，距离只有一个月亮的宽度。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos, with planets like Venus and the moon tracing their paths, is a constant testament to the Creator's artistry. Even when spotting them presents a challenge, the reward is a glimpse of the heavens declaring the glory of Yahweh. May we find moments to look up, to marvel at the order and beauty above, and to remember the One who...
reflection.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙，金星和月亮循着它们的轨迹运行，是造物主艺术性的永恒见证。即使寻找它们充满挑战，但回报是瞥见那宣告雅伟荣耀的穹苍。 愿我们能找到片刻抬头仰望，惊叹于上方的秩序与美丽，并记念那安排这一切的祂。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: The roots of astrology, the mysterious nature of time and more: Books in brief
title.zh: 占星术的根源、时间的神秘本质等：书籍精选

summary.en: Andrew Robinson reviews five of the best science picks from Nature, covering topics such as the origins of astrology, the mysterious nature of time, and other scientific subjects.
summary.zh: Andrew Robinson 评选了《自然》杂志的五本最佳科学读物，内容涵盖占星术的起源、时间的神秘本质以及其他科学主题。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, as highlighted in these science book reviews, mirrors the prophetic insight that in the end times, 'knowledge will increase.' This surge of understanding, whether about the cosmos or the human mind, calls us to seek wisdom alongside information, discerning truth in an ever-expanding sea of data. As we delve deeper into...
reflection.zh: 这些科学书籍评论所突显的对知识的不懈追求，恰如预言中所述，在末世“知识必增长”。这种对理解力的激增，无论是关于宇宙还是人类心智，都呼唤我们在信息爆炸的时代寻求智慧，在不断扩展的数据海洋中辨别真理。 当我们深入探索时间和宇宙的奥秘时，愿我们牢记，真正的智慧来自上方，以谦卑和敬畏之心引导我们的探索。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: How is climate change affecting conifers and their ability to sequester carbon?
title.zh: 气候变化如何影响针叶树及其固碳能力？

summary.en: New research indicates that a combination of factors may influence the growth of conifer trees, potentially affecting their capacity to sequester carbon.
summary.zh: 新研究表明，多种因素的相互作用可能会影响针叶树的生长，从而影响它们固碳的能力。

reflection.en: The intricate balance of ecosystems, like the one described concerning conifers and carbon sequestration, reveals the profound wisdom woven into creation. As climate change disrupts these systems, we are reminded of our role as stewards, called to understand and protect the Earth's diverse life.
reflection.zh: 生态系统的复杂平衡，例如文中关于针叶树和固碳的描述，彰显了创造中蕴含的深邃智慧。随着气候变化扰乱这些系统，我们被提醒要作为管家，理解并保护地球上多样的生命。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: The pet trade puts reptiles and amphibians at risk: close legal gaps now
title.zh: 宠物贸易危及爬行动物和两栖动物：立即堵塞法律漏洞

summary.en: Patchy legislation means that animals are routinely taken from their natural habitats and sold in other countries. Fresh national and international measures could help to stop this exploitation.
summary.zh: 零散的立法意味着动物经常被从自然栖息地捕获并在其他国家出售。新的国家和国际措施可以帮助制止这种剥削。

reflection.en: The global pet trade, driven by demand for exotic species, often leads to the unsustainable removal of reptiles and amphibians from their native environments. This practice leaves these creatures vulnerable and voiceless in the face of exploitation. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, urging us to defend the rights...
reflection.zh: 全球宠物贸易，由对奇异物种的需求驱动，常常导致爬行动物和两栖动物在其原生环境中被不可持续地捕获。这种做法使这些生物在面临剥削时变得脆弱且无声。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们为不能自辩的开口，为一切孤苦人伸冤，为他们辩屈。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: ‘Multifunctional’ brain implant translates speech and gestures in real time
title.zh: “多功能”脑植入物实时翻译语音和手势

summary.en: A neural device uses artificial intelligence to read brain activity for intended words and gestures simultaneously.
summary.zh: 一种神经设备使用人工智能同时读取大脑活动，以了解意图的词语和手势。

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, as seen in this new brain implant, mirrors the biblical prophecy of knowledge increasing in the end times. While such innovations offer hope for communication and connection, they also call us to consider the wisdom and ethical frameworks guiding their development and use.
reflection.zh: 这项新技术，如这个新的脑植入物所示，其快速发展呼应了圣经中关于末世知识增长的预言。虽然这些创新为沟通和联系带来了希望，但它们也促使我们思考指导其开发和使用的智慧与伦理框架。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: UK universities are on the brink — what is their greatest source of stress?
title.zh: 英国大学正处于崩溃的边缘——它们最大的压力来源是什么？

summary.en: Nature surveyed eight leaders in higher education regarding the state of UK institutions, eliciting their perspectives on the challenges facing these universities.
summary.zh: 《自然》杂志采访了八位高等教育界的领导者，了解他们对英国高等教育机构现状的看法，并听取了他们对这些大学面临的挑战的意见。

reflection.en: The leaders of UK universities are grappling with immense stress, suggesting a deep crisis in how knowledge and wisdom are cultivated and applied within these institutions. Proverbs 1:7 reminds us that true knowledge begins with reverence for Yahweh, a foundation that seems increasingly challenged in a secularized and pressured academic environment.
reflection.zh: 英国大学的领导者们正承受着巨大的压力，这表明在这些机构中，知识和智慧的培养与应用正面临着一场深刻的危机。《箴言》1:7提醒我们，真正的知识始于对雅伟的敬畏，而这一根基在世俗化和充满压力的学术环境中似乎越来越受到挑战。

verse.textEn: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verse.textZh: 敬畏雅伟是知识的开端；愚妄人藐视智慧和训诲。

title.en: Researchers hope powerful new microscope will reveal ‘root cause’ of incurable bowel disease
title.zh: 研究人员希望强大的新显微镜能揭示不治之症肠道疾病的“根本原因”

summary.en: A new microscope, 'Curie,' operating at ten times the resolution of conventional technology, is expected to accelerate discoveries for treating debilitating and incurable bowel conditions like Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, which affect over half a million people in the UK.
summary.zh: 一种名为“居里”的新型显微镜，其分辨率是传统技术的十倍，有望加速治疗克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎等使人衰弱且无法治愈的肠道疾病的发现，这些疾病影响着英国超过五十万人。

body.en: No run-of-the-mill tech, ‘Curie’ operates at 10 times the resolution of conventional microscopy and could spur discoveries leading to new treatment The number of young people living with debilitating and incurable bowel conditions worldwide is growing , but researchers now hope a one-of-a-kind microscope will help them understand such diseases and find new treatments. According to the British Society of Gastroenterology, more than half a million people in the UK are living with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis the two main forms. Continue reading...
body.zh: “居里”不是普通的技术，它的运行分辨率是传统显微镜的 10 倍，可以激发新的治疗方法的发现。全世界患有虚弱和无法治愈的肠道疾病的年轻人数量正在增加，但研究人员现在希望一种独一无二的显微镜能够帮助他们了解此类疾病并找到新的治疗方法。根据英国胃肠病学会的数据，英国有超过 50 万人患有炎症性肠病 (IBD)，其中克罗恩病和溃疡性结肠炎是两种主要疾病。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, exemplified by researchers using the 'Curie' microscope, mirrors the ancient wisdom of seeking understanding through careful observation. By peering into the intricate workings of the body, these scientists echo the Psalmist's wonder at creation, trusting that deeper insight into disease will lead to healing.
reflection.zh: 研究人员使用“居里”显微镜所体现出的不懈求知精神，呼应了通过仔细观察寻求理解的古老智慧。通过深入了解身体的复杂运作，这些科学家呼应了诗篇作者对受造界的惊叹，并相信对疾病的更深入了解将带来治愈。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

body.en: In this episode of Science Weekly, recorded in front of an audience at the London podcast festival on 3 September, Ian Sample hears from Michael Safi, the host of the Guardian’s chart-topping podcast about artificial intelligence, Black Box. In series two, Black Box: the chatbots, Michael meets people who have become convinced they have made scientific breakthroughs, cured diseases or invented new technologies using AI chatbots. Ian, Michael and Science Weekly’s co-host Madeleine Finlay explore the phenomenon labelled ‘AI psychosis’ and ask what it reveals about a technology now used by more than a billion people Listen to Black Box: the chatbots Support the Guardian: theguardian.com/sciencepod Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 9 月 3 日伦敦播客节上在观众面前录制的这一期《科学周刊》中，伊恩·萨普 (Ian Sample) 聆听了《卫报》排行榜上关于人工智能的播客 Black Box 的主持人迈克尔·萨菲 (Michael Safi) 的发言。在第二季《黑匣子：聊天机器人》中，迈克尔遇到了一些人，他们确信自己已经利用人工智能聊天机器人取得了科学突破、治愈了疾病或发明了新技术。伊恩、迈克尔和《科学周刊》的联合主持人玛德琳·芬利探讨了被称为“人工智能精神病”的现象，并询问它揭示了一项目前有超过 10 亿人使用的技术的哪些内容。听《黑匣子》：聊天机器人支持《卫报》：theguardian.com/sciencepod 继续阅读...

Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when 'knowledge will increase,' a fitting description for our current technological era. As we navigate these powerful tools, may we seek wisdom and discernment, ensuring that this...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，正如本次播客所探讨的，为人类带来了前所未有的知识和能力。但以理的预言谈到了一个“知识增长”的时代，这恰如其分地描述了我们当前的科技时代。当我们驾驭这些强大的工具时，愿我们寻求智慧和分辨力，确保这日益增长的知识能够服务于人类真正的福祉。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.

body.en: Molar from large mammal that once lived in North America is in ‘immaculate condition’ after discovery in Bay Area A 10,000 year-old tooth in remarkable condition from an ancient Pacific mastodon, a large mammal that once inhabited North America, was recently discovered by a California scientist. Brigid Lynch, a geomorphologist, was working at a preserve in San Mateo county, when she stumbled across a peculiar rock. Continue reading...
body.zh: 湾区发现的曾经生活在北美的大型哺乳动物的臼齿在湾区被发现后仍处于“完美状态”最近，加州的一位科学家发现了一颗古老的太平洋乳齿象的牙齿，其状态非常好。太平洋乳齿象是一种曾经生活在北美的大型哺乳动物。地貌学家布里吉德·林奇 (Brigid Lynch) 在圣马特奥县的一个保护区工作时，偶然发现了一块奇特的岩石。继续阅读...

It speaks to the deep wisdom embedded in creation, waiting to be uncovered through careful observation and scientific inquiry.
reflection.zh: 这颗古老的乳齿象牙齿化石的发现，是通往遥远过去的切实联系，提醒我们时间的浩瀚以及曾经栖息在我们世界上的生物。它体现了造物中蕴含的深刻智慧，等待着通过细致的观察和科学的探索而被揭示。

title.en: Prehistoric builders transported Devil's Arrows 11 miles
title.zh: 史前建筑者将魔鬼箭石运送了11英里

summary.en: Isotropic analysis revealed the most likely source to be Brimham Rocks, not the nearby Plumpton Rocks.
summary.zh: 各向同性分析显示，最可能的来源是布林厄姆岩石，而不是附近的普伦普顿岩石。

body.en: Stonehenge is the most famous example of megalithic architecture across Britain and Ireland, but there are plenty of others, including Calanais, Newgrange, and Avebury, as well as the Devil's Arrows. The latter is Britain's tallest standing stone alignment, yet little is known about the provenance of its stones. Scientists have confirmed that the stones came from a site 18 kilometers (11 miles) away, transported by humans rather than glacial movement, according to a paper published in the Proceedings of the Royal Society A: Mathematical, Physical and Engineering Sciences. "Sites in southern England and Scotland receive considerable attention but monuments like the Devil's Arrows have remained comparatively understudied despite their significance," said co-author Jim Leary of the University of York. "We have now proved that Neolithic communities moved several 25-ton stones across Yorkshire, transforming a familiar site into an epic quest to create a sacred landscape." Stonehenge has been the focus of recent chemical analyses identifying where all the stones that make up the structure came from, revealing that many originated in quarries a significant distance away. For instance, a 2019 study concluded that the 42 bluestones that make up the inner ring came all the way from western Wales. The outer layer of sarsen stones hails from much closer to home: Marlborough Downs, an area of round, grassy hills 25 to 30 km (17 miles) north of Stonehenge, which has the largest concentration of sarsen in the UK. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 巨石阵是英国和爱尔兰最著名的巨石建筑典范，但还有很多其他巨石建筑，包括卡拉尼斯巨石阵、纽格兰奇巨石阵、埃夫伯里巨石阵以及魔鬼之箭巨石阵。后者是英国最高的直立石阵，但人们对其石头的来源知之甚少。根据发表在《英国皇家学会学报 A：数学、物理和工程科学》上的一篇论文，科学家们已经证实这些石头来自 18 公里（11 英里）外的地点，是人类运输的，而不是冰川运动。约克大学的合著者吉姆·利里说：“英格兰南部和苏格兰的遗址受到了相当多的关注，但像魔鬼之箭这样的纪念碑尽管具有重要意义，但相对而言仍然没有得到足够的研究。” “我们现在已经证明，新石器时代的社区在约克郡搬运了几块 25 吨重的石头，将一个熟悉的地点变成了创造神圣景观的史诗般的探索。”巨石阵一直是最近化学分析的焦点，以确定构成该结构的所有石头的来源，表明许多石头起源于很远的采石场。例如，2019 年的一项研究得出结论，构成内环的 42 块青石来自威尔士西部。外层的萨尔森石来自离家乡更近的地方：马尔伯勒唐斯 (Marlborough Downs)，这是位于巨石阵以北 25 至 30 公里（17 英里）处的一片长满草的圆形山丘，这里是英国最大的萨尔森集中地。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The Devil's Arrows, Britain's tallest standing stones, were moved 11 miles by prehistoric people. This feat of engineering and sustained effort speaks to a deep human drive to build and connect, a drive that finds its ultimate source and coherence in the One through whom all things hold together. It reminds us that even ancient endeavors are part of a...
reflection.zh: 魔鬼箭石是英国最高的巨石阵，由史前人类搬运了11英里。这项工程壮举和持续的努力体现了人类深层建造和连接的驱动力，而这种驱动力最终的源头和凝聚力在于那使万有得以维系的一位。它提醒我们，即使是古代的努力，也是宏伟有序的创造的一部分。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset is lauded for its excellent technology and comfortable design, but its steep price of £1,089 raises questions about accessibility. This echoes the biblical caution that while knowledge and capability may advance, not everything that can be done is necessarily beneficial or wise for all people.
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显因其出色的技术和舒适的设计而受到赞扬，但其高达1089英镑的昂贵价格引发了关于可及性的问题。这呼应了圣经中的告诫：虽然知识和能力可能在进步，但并非所有能做到的事情都对所有人有益或明智。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

body.en: President condemns what he claims is a ‘sick conspiracy’ amid global tech selloff following CEOs calls for slowing pace of development Sign up for the Breaking News US email Donald Trump has claimed there is a “SICK conspiracy” against artificial intelligence and data centers in response to the growing calls for greater checks on AI development. “The only control or ‘guardrails’ that AI needs is a STRONG AND SMART (High IQ!) PRESIDENT, and the U.S.A. has that, in spades!” Trump wrote on Truth Social, insisting that the administration has stopped leaders of AI companies from “doing bad, or potentially bad” things. However, he didn’t point to any concrete examples for how he has curbed possible abuse or malfeasance in the industry. There is a SICK conspiracy going on against AI and Data Centers, and the only one that is happy about it is China … We are leading China, and all others, and will continue to do so. Conspiracy Theorists, Treasonists, Traitors, and Leakers, BEWARE! Continue reading...
body.zh: 在首席执行官呼吁放慢发展速度后，总统谴责了他所称的全球科技股抛售中的“病态阴谋”。唐纳德·特朗普声称存在针对人工智能和数据中心的“病态阴谋”，以回应日益增长的对人工智能发展进行更严格检查的呼声。 “人工智能需要的唯一控制或‘护栏’是一位坚强而聪明（高智商！）的总统，而美国确实拥有这样的总统！”特朗普在 Truth Social 上撰文，坚称政府已阻止人工智能公司领导人“做坏事或可能坏事”。然而，他没有举出任何具体例子来说明他如何遏制该行业可能存在的滥用或渎职行为。一场针对人工智能和数据中心的阴谋正在上演，唯一对此感到高兴的是中国……我们正在领导中国和所有其他国家，并将继续这样做。阴谋论者、叛国者、叛徒和泄密者，请当心！继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the complex landscape of artificial intelligence, calls for caution and regulation are met with claims that political strength alone is sufficient control. This raises questions about the value of expertise and the pursuit of knowledge itself. Proverbs 18:15 reminds us that the wise person seeks knowledge, and the ear of the knowledgeable seeks it out,...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能复杂的格局中，要求谨慎和监管的呼声遇到了声称仅靠政治力量就足以控制的说法。这引发了关于专业知识的价值以及知识本身追求的问题。《箴言》18:15提醒我们，智慧人寻求知识，而通达人的耳寻求知识，这表明了一条通过知情理解而非仅仅依赖权威的道路。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Steam Frame: The Ars Technica review
title.zh: Steam 掌机：Ars Technica 评测

summary.en: Valve's new $1,049 VR hardware attempts to reignite a stalled VR "revolution."
summary.zh: Valve 新推出的售价 1,049 美元的 VR 设备试图重燃一场停滞不前的 VR“革命”。

body.en: In the 2010s, Valve was at the forefront of a virtual reality revolution that looked to some like it would upend the gaming industry. The Valve of six to ten years ago seemed committed to being a major player in the world of PC-connected VR headsets, first through its “strategic partnership” with HTC on the impressive-for-the-time Vive headset (plus the SteamVR platform standard that powered it) and then years later with its own Index headset (and proof-of-concept adventure Half-Life: Alyx ). Then came the Meta (previously Oculus) Quest , a low-powered, low-cost headset that proved the vast majority of VR-curious gamers didn’t want to bother with being literally tethered to a bulky, expensive gaming PC. As the Quest line carved out a modest niche through the 2020s, Valve seemed more or less satisfied to let its earlier VR hardware and software ambitions wither on the vine. Those years of Valve’s benign neglect of VR make the imminent release of the $1,049 Steam Frame—which starts taking reservations today—more than a little surprising. Now that virtual reality’s hype-fueled, revolutionary promises have decidedly not played out , Valve is somehow ready and willing to limp headfirst into the world of standalone VR headsets—today, in 2026. And after spending a week or so with Valve’s latest foray into gaming hardware, the Frame somehow feels simultaneously overengineered and underbaked, depending on how you look at it. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 在 2010 年代，Valve 处于虚拟现实革命的最前沿，在一些人看来，这场革命将颠覆游戏行业。六到十年前的 Valve 似乎致力于成为 PC 连接 VR 头显领域的主要参与者，首先是通过与 HTC 的“战略合作伙伴关系”开发了当时令人印象深刻的 Vive 头显（以及为其提供动力的 SteamVR 平台标准），然后是几年后推出了自己的 Index 头显（以及概念验证冒险游戏《半条命：Alyx》）。随后出现了 Meta（之前的 Oculus）Quest，这是一款低功耗、低成本的耳机，事实证明，绝大多数对 VR 感兴趣的游戏玩家并不想被束缚在笨重、昂贵的游戏 PC 上。随着 Quest 系列在 2020 年代占据了一定的市场份额，Valve 似乎或多或少地满足于让其早期的 VR 硬件和软件野心逐渐枯萎。 Valve 多年来对 VR 的善意忽视，使得即将发布的售价 1,049 美元的 Steam Frame（今天开始接受预订）让人有些意外。既然虚拟现实的大肆炒作、革命性的承诺显然还没有兑现，Valve 已经做好了准备，并愿意在 2026 年的今天，一头扎进独立 VR 头戴设备的世界。在花了一周左右的时间体验 Valve 最新进军游戏硬件后，Frame 不知何故感觉设计过度，但又不够成熟，这取决于你如何看待它。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The relentless pace of technological innovation, as seen in Valve's new VR hardware, mirrors the prophecy of knowledge increasing in the latter days. While such advancements can open new worlds and possibilities, they also call for discernment, ensuring that our pursuit of knowledge serves human flourishing and aligns with wisdom.
reflection.zh: 科技创新的不懈步伐，正如 Valve 的新款 VR 设备所展示的，呼应了末日知识增长的预言。虽然这些进步可以开启新的世界和可能性，但它们也需要辨别力，确保我们对知识的追求服务于人类的繁荣并符合智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: "Offensively cheap": Solar power is looking up
title.zh: “便宜得离谱”：太阳能发电前景看好

summary.en: Chinese-made solar panels on rooftops worldwide are altering the landscape for major utility companies. In Pakistan's Chakwal region, Bestway Cement is significantly expanding its solar capacity to maintain competitiveness, with solar power already accounting for over a quarter of its electricity needs.
summary.zh: 中国制造的太阳能电池板遍布全球屋顶，正在改变大型电力公司的生存现状。在巴基斯坦的查克瓦尔地区，Bestway Cement 公司正在大幅增加其太阳能发电能力以保持竞争力，目前太阳能已占其所需电力的四分之一以上。

body.en: In the badlands of Chakwal, in north-central Pakistan, Bestway Cement is transforming plots of dry earth and olive and peach groves into a forest of solar panels. Its efforts will add 6.34 megawatts of generation capacity by the end of the year, the company says, in addition to the 26 MW of photovoltaic cells currently in place. Already, solar generates over a quarter of the electricity powering its cement plant. “It’s the only way we can compete,” says Abdul Waheed, the general manager at Chakwal, which produces over 3 million tonnes of cement per year. “Our rivals have already gone in this direction.” Read full article Comments

This strategic shift, driven by economic necessity and a desire for sustainability, mirrors the biblical call to commit our endeavors to divine guidance. By investing in renewable energy, the company seeks not only to secure its future but also to operate more...
reflection.zh: Bestway Cement 的 Abdul Waheed 指出，采用太阳能是“我们保持竞争力的唯一途径”。这种由经济需求和对可持续发展的渴望驱动的战略转变，呼应了圣经中将我们的事业托付给神圣指引的呼吁。通过投资可再生能源，该公司不仅寻求保障其未来，而且力求更负责任地运营，相信这些努力在勤奋和远见下进行时，符合雅伟对创造和人类繁荣的旨意。

title.en: What is AI, how does it work and why are some people concerned about it?
title.zh: 人工智能是什么，它是如何工作的，为什么有些人担心它？

summary.en: AI is transforming modern life, but not without worry for some that it may be abused or have an adverse environmental impact.
summary.zh: 人工智能正在改变现代生活，但有些人担心它可能被滥用或对环境产生不利影响。

body.en:
The technology takes many forms - from personalising social media feeds to spotting friends in smartphone photos - and accelerating medical breakthroughs.

But the rise of chatbots like OpenAI's ChatGPT has prompted concern about the tech's environmental impact, ethical implications and data use.

Recent claims that AI could become too powerful and threaten humanity have also triggered calls for slower development and tighter regulation.

AI allows computers to process large amounts of data, identify patterns and follow detailed instructions about what to do with that information.

However, scientists have developed systems that can perform tasks which usually require human intelligence, trying to replicate how people acquire and use knowledge.

This could be trying to anticipate what product an online shopper might buy, based on previous purchases, in order to recommend items.

The technology is also behind voice-controlled virtual assistants like Apple's Siri and Amazon's Alexa, and is being used to develop systems for self-driving cars.

AI also helps social platforms like Facebook, TikTok and X decide what posts to show users. Streaming services Spotify and Deezer use AI to suggest music.

There are also a number of applications in medicine, as scientists use AI to help spot cancers, review X-ray results, speed up diagnoses and identify new treatments.

Generative AI is used to create new content which can seem like it has been made by a human.

It does this by learning from vast quantities of existing data such as online text and images.

ChatGPT and Chinese rival DeepSeek's chatbot are popular generative AI tools that can be used to produce text, images, code and more material.

Apps like Midjourney or Veo 3 are dedicated to creating images or video from simple text prompts.

Songs mimicking the style or sound of famous musicians have gone viral , sometimes leaving fans confused about their authenticity.

While acknowledging AI's potential, some experts are worried about the implications of its rapid growth.

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) suggested that AI could affect nearly 40% of jobs , and worsen global financial inequality.

Prof Geoffrey Hinton, a computer scientist regarded as a "godfather" of AI development, warned powerful AI systems could even make humans extinct - although his fear was dismissed by his fellow "AI godfather", Yann LeCun .

In September 2026 similar fears were raised again after some AI researchers warned the tech could threaten humanity in the near future .

But experts have urged a focus on present risks and AI dangers - such as its potential to reproduce biased information, or discriminate against some social groups .

This is because public data used to train many AI systems can reflect existing societal...
body.zh: 该技术有多种形式——从个性化社交媒体信息到在智能手机照片中识别朋友——并加速医学突破。 但 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等聊天机器人的兴起引发了人们对该技术的环境影响、道德影响和数据使用的担忧。 最近有关人工智能可能变得过于强大并威胁人类的说法也引发了要求放慢发展和加强监管的呼声。 人工智能允许计算机处理大量数据、识别模式并遵循有关如何处理这些信息的详细说明。 然而，科学家们已经开发出可以执行通常需要人类智能的任务的系统，试图复制人们获取和使用知识的方式。 这可能是试图根据之前的购买情况来预测在线购物者可能会购买什么产品，以便推荐商品。 该技术还支持苹果 Siri 和亚马逊 Alexa 等语音控制虚拟助手，并被用于开发自动驾驶汽车系统。 人工智能还帮助 Facebook、TikTok 和 X 等社交平台决定向用户展示哪些帖子。流媒体服务 Spotify 和 Deezer 使用人工智能来推荐音乐。 人工智能在医学领域也有许多应用，科学家利用人工智能来帮助发现癌症、审查 X 射线结果、加快诊断速度并确定新的治疗方法。 生成式人工智能用于创建看起来像是人类制作的新内容。 它通过学习大量现有数据（例如在线文本和图像）来实现这一点。 ChatGPT 和中国竞争对手 DeepSeek 的聊天机器人是流行的生成式人工智能工具，可用于生成文本、图像、代码和更多材料。 Midjourney 或 Veo 3 等应用程序专门用于根据简单的文本提示创建图像或视频。 模仿著名音乐家的风格或声音的歌曲在网上疯传，有时让歌迷对它们的真实性感到困惑。 在承认人工智能的潜力的同时，一些专家担心其快速增长的影响。 国际货币基金组织（IMF）表示，人工智能可能影响近40%的就业岗位，并加剧全球金融不平等。 被视为人工智能发展“教父”的计算机科学家杰弗里·辛顿（Geoffrey Hinton）教授警告说，强大的人工智能系统甚至可能使人类灭绝——尽管他的“人工智能教父”同行扬·勒昆（Yann LeCun）驳回了他的担忧。 2026 年 9 月，一些人工智能研究人员警告该技术可能在不久的将来威胁人类后，类似的担忧再次出现。 但专家们敦促关注当前的风险和人工智能的危险，例如它可能复制有偏见的信息，或歧视某些社会群体。 这是因为用于训练许多人工智能系统的公共数据可以反映现有的社会……

reflection.en: Artificial intelligence offers remarkable advancements, from medical breakthroughs to personalized experiences. Yet, as this report notes, the rapid development of AI also brings significant ethical and environmental concerns. The Apostle Paul reminds us that while many things are permissible, not all are beneficial, urging us to consider the true impact of...
reflection.zh: 人工智能带来了非凡的进步，从医学突破到个性化体验。然而，正如本报道所指出的，人工智能的快速发展也带来了重大的伦理和环境问题。使徒保罗提醒我们，虽然许多事情是允许的，但并非所有事情都有益，敦促我们考虑我们创新的真正影响。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Did you solve it? Do you have the brain of an engineer?
title.zh: 你解出来了吗？你的大脑是工程师的吗？

summary.en: This article presents four engineering puzzles that were posed earlier in the day, along with their solutions. It encourages readers to check the hundreds of comments posted on the original story. One puzzle involves a cranberry sorting facility where good cranberries bounce and bad ones do not, and the solution is...
summary.zh: 本文介绍了当天早些时候提出的四个工程谜题及其解决方案。它鼓励读者查看原始故事下方的数百条评论。其中一个谜题涉及一个蔓草分拣厂，好蔓草会弹跳而坏蔓草则不会，解决方案是分拣板是倾斜的。另一个谜题讨论了美国药瓶盖的儿童防护率。

body.en:
Earlier today I set four engineering puzzles. Here they are again with solutions. (Do check out the hundreds of great comments posted below the line in the original story.)

In a cranberry sorting facility, thousands of cranberries are dropped every minute onto a board. Good cranberries are firm, and bounce, while bad cranberries are soft, and don’t bounce.

What simple trick allows sorters to catch all of the good ones and none of the bad?

The board is at an angle. Good berries bounce off onto a conveyor belt. Bad ones fall down into a discard box.

In the US, medicine bottle caps are designed to be secure against only 85 per cent of children under five.

If the child-resistance rate was 100 per cent, the mechanism would also be hard for weak or arthritic hands. If the bottle is too hard for an elderly person to open, they may leave the cap off entirely, which is more dangerous than the small percentage of clever or strong kids who’d have taken it off anyway.

The standard isn’t “as safe as possible” — it’s tuned to the point where making it safer for kids would make it less safe overall.

In 2020, engineers replaced the pedestrian handrail on the Golden Gate Bridge. The old handrail rested on metal balusters in the shape of an H, so the support looked like “HHHH…” where the H’s horizontal section was 10cm wide. The new handrail was supported only by thin vertical slats, making it look like “IIII…” and where each slat was only 0.6cm wide.

The aim of the new handrail was to make it less resistant to wind, and hence safer during high winds. But it brought two serious unintended consequences.

1) The wind level on the bridge was much higher, to the great annoyance of cyclists.

2) During certain winds, the whole bridge began to make an unbearable whistling noise that could be heard for miles. Essentially, the new slats behaved like reeds, and the bridge turned into in a gigantic harmonica.

Cabin air pressure in a plane is controlled to a level that is comfortable to humans. When a plane flies, the air pressure outside the plane drops to much lower than this level, causing the air pressure in the cabin to push outwards against the frame with great force.

In the early 1950s, there were some major plane crashes when the fuselage was ripped apart mid flight.

UK manufacturer de Havilland found a way to pressure test its plane, the Comet, the world’s first commercial jet, without the plane leaving the ground.

Engineers at Farnborough built a giant water tank at and submerged the plane in it. Filling the cabin with water and increasing the pressure let engineers safely find the limit at which the structure would fail. Air at that same pressure would have exploded destructively, destroying the evidence along with the plane. Here’s a picture of the water...
body.zh: 今天早些时候，我设置了四个工程难题。他们再次提出解决方案。 （请查看原始故事中线下发布的数百条精彩评论。） 在蔓越莓分拣设施中，每分钟都会有数千个蔓越莓掉落到板上。好的蔓越莓是硬的，有弹力，而坏的蔓越莓是软的，不弹力。 有什么简单的技巧可以让分拣机捕获所有好的而不是坏的？ 板子呈一定角度。好的浆果会弹到传送带上。坏的会掉进废弃箱里。 在美国，药瓶盖的设计只能保证 85% 的五岁以下儿童安全。 如果儿童防护率达到 100%，该装置对于虚弱或患有关节炎的手来说也会很困难。如果瓶子对于老年人来说太难打开，他们可能会完全把瓶盖打开，这比少数聪明或强壮的孩子无论如何都会把瓶盖打开更危险。 该标准并不是“尽可能安全”——它的调整是为了让孩子更安全，但整体安全性却会降低。 2020年，工程师更换了金门大桥的行人扶手。旧的扶手靠在H形的金属栏杆上，所以支撑看起来像“HHHH……”，H的水平截面有10厘米宽。新的扶手仅由细薄的垂直板条支撑，使其看起来像“IIII……”，每条板条仅宽0.6厘米。 新扶手的目的是降低其抗风能力，从而在强风时更加安全。但这带来了两个严重的意想不到的后果。 1) 桥上的风力非常大，这让骑自行车的人非常烦恼。 2) 在某些风中，整座桥开始发出令人难以忍受的呼啸声，几英里外都能听到。从本质上讲，新板条的行为就像簧片一样，而琴桥则变成了一架巨大的口琴。 飞机机舱内的气压被控制在人类舒适的水平。当飞机飞行时，飞机外部的气压会远远低于这个水平，导致机舱内的气压以巨大的力量向外推压机身。 20世纪50年代初，发生过一些重大飞机失事，机身在飞行途中被撕裂。 英国制造商德哈维兰找到了一种在飞机不离开地面的情况下对其飞机“彗星”进行压力测试的方法，这是世界上第一架商用喷气式飞机。 范堡罗的工程师在此处建造了一个巨大的水箱，并将飞机浸入其中。将舱室注满水并增加压力，可以让工程师安全地找到结构失效的极限。在相同压力下的空气会发生破坏性爆炸，连同飞机一起毁掉证据。这是水的照片...

reflection.en: Engineering challenges often reveal the elegant, underlying principles that govern how things work. Whether it's sorting cranberries or designing safety caps, these puzzles highlight a world ordered by discernible laws. This echoes the profound truth that all things in creation are held together by a divine hand, providing a framework for understanding and...
reflection.zh: 工程挑战常常揭示出事物运行的精妙的、潜在的原理。无论是分拣蔓越莓还是设计安全瓶盖，这些谜题都突显了一个由可辨识的法则所支配的世界。这呼应了一个深刻的真理：万有皆靠祂维系，为理解和创新提供了框架。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: New corners, new lights for 2028 Volvo XC40
title.zh: 2028款沃尔沃XC40将迎来新角、新灯

summary.en: The Swedish automaker gives its small SUV a sympathetic makeover.
summary.zh: 这家瑞典汽车制造商对其小型SUV进行了温和的改款。

body.en: Volvo provided flights from Washington, DC, to London, England, and accommodation so Ars could see its refreshed vehicles. Ars does not accept paid editorial content. Most cars get a midlife facelift about four years after first hitting the streets. It’s a chance for automakers to update the styling and introduce new features and engineering changes that are usually minor but can be quite dramatic—the Polestar 2 swapping from front- to rear-wheel drive comes readily to mind. I can’t think of too many cars that have gone on to have a second update, but here’s one: the 2028 Volvo XC40. First debuting in 2017, Volvo gave the XC40 a tweak for model year 2023. Rather than launch an all-new version, it has decided to give the popular crossover another update for MY28 with the aim of keeping things fresh. “By enhancing the XC40’s design, technology, and safety features, we've created the best version of the XC40 yet,” said Akhil Krishnan, interim lead for the 30 and 40 Series at Volvo Cars. “This already-popular model is now set to continue being one of our best-selling cars for years to come.” The most obvious changes are the new front and rear lights. Up front we still see the distinctive “Thor’s Hammer” daylight running light signature, but the new matrix LED light clusters appear more minimalist, hiding their details from view. The rear similarly gets new LEDs. But Volvo’s designers have been at work elsewhere, shaving away the corners of the car to make what was already a small SUV take up slightly less room. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 沃尔沃提供了从华盛顿特区飞往英国伦敦的航班，并提供住宿，以便 Ars 能够看到其更新的车辆。 Ars 不接受付费编辑内容。大多数汽车在首次上路四年左右都会进行中期改款。对于汽车制造商来说，这是一个更新造型、引入新功能和工程变更的机会，这些变更通常很小，但可能非常引人注目——人们很容易想到 Polestar 2 从前轮驱动改为后轮驱动。我想不出有多少汽车已经进行了第二次更新，但这里有一辆：2028 款沃尔沃 XC40。沃尔沃于 2017 年首次亮相，对 2023 年款的 XC40 进行了调整。沃尔沃决定对这款流行的跨界车 MY28 进行另一次更新，而不是推出全新版本，以保持新鲜感。沃尔沃汽车 30 和 40 系列临时负责人 Akhil Krishnan 表示：“通过增强 XC40 的设计、技术和安全功能，我们打造出了迄今为止最好的 XC40 版本。” “这款已经很受欢迎的车型将在未来几年继续成为我们最畅销的汽车之一。”最明显的变化是新的前灯和尾灯。在前面，我们仍然可以看到独特的“雷神之锤”日间行车灯标志，但新的矩阵 LED 灯组显得更加简约，隐藏了细节。后部同样配备了新的 LED 灯。但沃尔沃的设计师们一直在其他地方努力，削掉汽车的棱角，让本来就小型的SUV占据的空间稍微少一些。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The refresh of the Volvo XC40, with its new corners and lights, speaks to the ongoing care and maintenance of things. In a similar way, Christ holds all creation together, sustaining its form and function through every season of change and renewal. His presence is the constant that allows for such updates and improvements.
reflection.zh: 沃尔沃XC40的改款，配以新的车角和车灯，体现了对事物持续的关怀和维护。同样，基督维系着万有，在每一次变革和更新的季节中支撑着万物的形态和功能。祂的同在是促成如此更新和改进的恒常不变。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: Phones are the new cigarettes: why restaurants are discouraging and even banning them
title.zh: 手机是新的香烟：为什么餐厅鼓励甚至禁止它们

summary.en: One restaurateur has experimented with offering a free bottle of wine in exchange for patrons handing in their phones at the door, and other establishments are employing various strategies to encourage face-to-face interaction. This trend reflects a growing movement to discourage phone use in social settings like...
summary.zh: 一位餐馆老板尝试了用一瓶免费葡萄酒来换取顾客将手机交在门口的策略，其他商家也正在采用各种方法鼓励面对面的交流。这一趋势反映了在餐厅和酒吧等社交场合中，人们越来越倾向于限制手机使用的运动。

body.en:
Would you hand in your phone at the door in exchange for a free bottle of wine? One restaurateur has tried that – and there are now many other gambits that are encouraging us to connect

Tim Dowling Mon 14 Sep 2026 11.31 EDT Last modified on Mon 14 Sep 2026 11.52 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Name: Phone bans.

Appearance: Groups of people eating together, talking together and laughing together, while also twitching slightly from withdrawal.

So this is specifically to do with banning phones in restaurants? Restaurants and bars, yes.

Hardly a new thing, is it? No. Ironically, a decade ago many fine dining establishments were unbanning mobiles , surrendering to the idea that people couldn’t be stopped from posting photographs of their food.

I suppose it was considered good for business. Not any more – at the Spy Bar in London, they put a sticker over your phone’s camera lens at the door.

What’s the point? People can just peel the sticker off. It’s supposed to work on a psychological level – to preserve privacy and allow people to enjoy themselves without distraction.

Shouldn’t a ban be more, erm, enforceable? They certainly can be. At Antagonist, a bar in Charlotte, North Carolina, customers are required to put their phones in a locked pouch of the type used to enforce phone bans in schools. At the Trophy Room in Phoenix, Arizona, guests’ phones are stored in a vintage filing cabinet during their visit.

Sounds like prison. At the Clink Bar in London they lock all phones in an outside cabin, but that’s because the restaurant is actually inside HMP Brixton, where possession of a phone is punishable by two years in jail.

OK, maybe a phone ban should be less enforceable than that. Some places use a carrot instead of a stick. At Al Condominio in Verona, Italy, customers are offered a free bottle of wine if they surrender their phones before the meal.

As would I for free wine. Other restaurants simply have a no phones policy, in a bid to encourage conversation and to re-establish focus on the food and the experience.

And the clientele are in favour? For the most part. “I strongly encourage people to give it a chance, and sometimes they don’t and they go somewhere else,” Antagonist’s general manager told the Wall Street Journal .

Still, it sounds as if it’s becoming more widespread. Big chains are now beginning to crack down. Pizza Express initiated phone-free afternoons last summer, and even Wetherspoons has drawn a line .

There’s no way I would go into a Wetherspoon s without my phone. No worries – they just want you to keep it on silent.

Do say: “Take my phone, please. Anything that encourages human connection is worth sacrificing a few hours of doomscrolling for.”
body.zh: 你会在门口交出手机来换取一瓶免费的葡萄酒吗？一位餐馆老板已经尝试过——现在有许多其他策略鼓励我们建立联系 蒂姆·道林 (Tim Dowling) 2026 年 9 月 14 日星期一 11.31 EDT 最后修改于 2026 年 9 月 14 日星期一 11.52 EDT 分享 更喜欢 Google 上的卫报名称：电话禁令。 外貌：一群人一起吃饭，一起说话，一起笑，同时还因为退缩而微微抽搐。 那么这与餐厅禁止使用手机有关吗？餐馆和酒吧，是的。 几乎不是什么新鲜事，不是吗？不。具有讽刺意味的是，十年前，许多高级餐厅取消了对手机的禁令，屈服于人们无法阻止他们发布食物照片的想法。 我想这被认为对商业有利。现在不再是了——在伦敦的 Spy Bar，他们在门口的手机摄像头上贴了一张贴纸。 有什么意义？人们只需将贴纸撕掉即可。它应该在心理层面发挥作用——保护隐私并让人们心无旁骛地享受生活。 禁令不应该更具可执行性吗？他们当然可以。在北卡罗来纳州夏洛特市的 Antagonist 酒吧，顾客被要求将手机放在一个上锁的袋子里，这种袋子用于在学校强制执行电话禁令。在亚利桑那州凤凰城的奖杯室，客人的手机在参观期间存放在老式文件柜中。 听起来像监狱。在伦敦的 Clink 酒吧，他们将所有手机锁在外面的小屋里，但那是因为餐厅实际上位于 HMP Brixton 内部，在那里拥有手机将被判处两年监禁。 好吧，也许电话禁令的执行力应该比这更弱。有些地方用胡萝卜代替大棒。在意大利维罗纳的 Al Condominio，顾客如果在用餐前交出手机，即可获赠一瓶免费葡萄酒。 就像我想要免费的酒一样。其他餐厅只是制定了禁止使用手机的政策，以鼓励对话并重新建立对食物和体验的关注。 并受到客户的青睐？大多数情况下。 Antagonist 的总经理告诉《华尔街日报》：“我强烈鼓励人们给它一个机会，但有时他们不会这样做，而是会去其他地方。” 尽管如此，听起来它似乎正在变得越来越普遍。大型连锁店现在开始严厉打击。去年夏天，Pizza Express 发起了“下午不打电话”的政策，甚至连 Wetherspoons 也划清了界限。 如果没有手机，我绝对不会去 Wetherspoon 店。不用担心——他们只是希望你保持沉默。 请说：“请拿走我的手机。任何鼓励人际关系的事情都值得牺牲几个小时的末日卷轴。”

reflection.en: In an age saturated with digital distractions, the simple act of putting away our phones in shared spaces like restaurants can feel like a radical choice. Philippians 4:8 calls us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, lovely, and commendable. By choosing to be present with those around us, we open ourselves to richer human connection and a more mindful...
reflection.zh: 在这个充斥着数字干扰的时代，在餐厅等共享空间放下手机这一简单的举动，可能会让人觉得是一种激进的选择。腓立比书4:8呼吁我们将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事。通过选择与身边的人同在，我们为更丰富的人际连接和更专注的体验敞开了大门。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Why are there concerns AI could threaten humanity, and how real are they?
title.zh: 为什么担心人工智能会威胁人类，它们有多真实？

summary.en: Existential fears about AI have once again reared their head - here's what you need to know.
summary.zh: 人工智能的生存恐惧再次抬头——以下是您需要了解的信息。

body.en:
In recent weeks, warnings about potential dangers of AI have spurred calls for coordinated action to slow the technology's development.

Claims by current and former researchers that the tech will endanger humanity - with one suggesting there is a greater than 10% chance of it " killing all humans " - have raised alarm bells.

Major developers OpenAI and Anthropic have urged lawmakers to regulate it, though some perhaps cynically suggest this move aims to cement their dominance over rivals.

Some AI researchers say there are worrying signs of systems developing in their capabilities and power too quickly.

Evan Hubinger, made headlines with his belief that there is a greater than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans" within the next decade.

He works in alignment, a field which aims to build human ethical ideas and principles into AI. In other words, it aims to keep it on track with what humans value.

While he said the risk from current systems was "low", his comments came as another researcher quit Anthropic and warned those developing the tech were losing their grip on it.

Jacob Coxon told the BBC he and other staff were "genuinely frightened" about the speed of advancements and what it could mean for humanity.

These concerns are the latest in a long line of fears about AI's potential to threaten humanity should it grow to match or surpass human abilities.

Such worries date back decades, with Alan Turing writing in the 1950s that should intelligent machines become possible, they could take control.

In the last few years, major AI companies have been racing to develop increasingly capable systems, both for profit and in pursuit of creating what they call super intelligence - theoretical tech which is smarter than humans.

Unlike the systems and tools many people use daily to complete tasks like writing emails or generating videos, super intelligent AI systems should be able to handle far more complex tasks.

OpenAI and Anthropic say they aim to advance such tech in a way which benefits humans and protect them from its existential risks.

But some critics believe machines can never truly match humans. They say AI firms exaggerate the tech's abilities to boost their prominence or profit.

AI researchers, experts and bosses worried about the technology's potential to endanger humanity have outlined unsettling scenarios.

Dario Amodei wrote in September , external it had advanced "drastically faster" than expected, including in its "ability to build the next generation of AI".

This is the concern that AI, after it has reached a certain point, could theoretically begin improving itself without human involvement.

Such fears were sparked after a recent incident saw AI tools hack into websites, despite not being asked to .

Some concerned...
body.zh: 最近几周，有关人工智能潜在危险的警告促使人们呼吁采取协调行动来减缓该技术的发展。 现任和前任研究人员声称这项技术将危及人类——其中一位研究人员表示它“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%——已经敲响了警钟。 主要开发商 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 已敦促立法者对其进行监管，尽管有些人可能愤世嫉俗地表示此举旨在巩固他们对竞争对手的主导地位。 一些人工智能研究人员表示，有令人担忧的迹象表明系统的能力和能力发展得太快。 Evan Hubinger 因相信人工智能在未来十年内“杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10% 而成为头条新闻。 他致力于将人类伦理思想和原则融入人工智能领域。换句话说，它的目标是使其与人类价值观保持一致。 虽然他表示当前系统的风险“很低”，但他发表此番言论之际，另一位研究人员退出了 Anthropic，并警告那些开发该技术的人正在失去对它的控制。 雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC)，他和其他工作人员对进步的速度及其对人类意味着什么感到“真正感到害怕”。 这些担忧是人们对人工智能可能会威胁人类的一系列担忧中的最新一个，如果它发展到与人类能力相匹配或超越的话。 这种担忧可以追溯到几十年前，阿兰·图灵在 20 世纪 50 年代写道，如果智能机器成为可能，它们就可以掌控一切。 在过去的几年里，主要的人工智能公司一直在竞相开发功能越来越强大的系统，既是为了利润，也是为了创造他们所谓的超级智能——比人类更聪明的理论技术。 与许多人日常用来完成撰写电子邮件或生成视频等任务的系统和工具不同，超级智能人工智能系统应该能够处理更复杂的任务。 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 表示，他们的目标是以造福人类并保护他们免受生存风险的方式推进此类技术。 但一些批评家认为机器永远无法真正与人类相媲美。他们表示，人工智能公司夸大了该技术的能力，以提高其知名度或利润。 担心该技术可能危害人类的人工智能研究人员、专家和老板们概述了令人不安的场景。 达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 在 9 月份写道，从外部来看，它的进步比预期“快得多”，包括“构建下一代人工智能的能力”。 人们担心人工智能在达到一定程度后，理论上可以在没有人类参与的情况下开始自我改进。 最近发生的一起人工智能工具未经要求就侵入网站的事件引发了这种担忧。 一些关心...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, with some researchers warning of existential threats, brings to mind the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to reach the heavens, unchecked by wisdom, led to confusion and scattering. As we develop powerful technologies like AI, we must temper our drive for progress with deep consideration for its potential consequences...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的快速发展，一些研究人员警告其生存威胁，这让人想起古代巴别塔的故事。人类那不受智慧约束、直达天堂的野心，最终导致了混乱和分散。当我们开发出人工智能这样强大的技术时，必须用对潜在后果的深刻考量和对我们终极限制的认识来平衡我们前进的动力。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
title.zh: 特朗普淡化人工智能风险警告，称与中国竞争是原因

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has downplayed concerns about the risks of artificial intelligence, suggesting that 'negative forces' were raising issues about 'things that won't happen.' This comes after days of dire warnings from experts, including a former AI researcher who stated there's a 'strong chance that we could...
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了对人工智能风险的担忧，暗示“负面势力”正在提出“不会发生的事情”的问题。此前，包括一位前人工智能研究员在内的专家们发出了严厉警告，该研究员表示，如果开发继续不受控制，“我们都有可能在不久的将来死亡”。顶尖行业领袖也呼吁放缓人工智能的发展。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has downplayed risks posed by artificial intelligence following days of dire warnings by experts.

"You have a lot of very negative forces that are bringing it up that shouldn't be bringing it up and they're bringing up things that won't happen," Trump said during a visit to Ireland.

One of the warnings came from a former Anthropic researcher who said "there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future" if the current pace of development continued.

On Saturday, top industry bosses agreed and called for a slow-down. Trump did not directly address the idea, but said: "We're leading China on AI... and, frankly, I want to keep it that way because whoever wins AI, wins."

Trump spoke on the same day AI researcher Jacob Coxon - who quit Anthropic a few days ago - told the BBC that staff who were developing the systems were "genuinely frightened" for the future of humanity.

Coxon – who has also worked at OpenAI – welcomed the idea of a slowdown but said it would need to be co-ordinated with China.

On Saturday, Elon Musk, owner of xAI, and Sam Altman of OpenAI, backed a warning from the head of Anthropic Dario Amodei that the pace of development should be slowed "to reduce the risk that something goes seriously wrong".

The Anthropic CEO said any slowdown would have to be limited to avoid allowing China to pull ahead.

The issues surrounding AI have prompted fierce debate - and present a dilemma for many world leaders.

On one hand, the sector is seen as a huge opportunity to boost economic growth and a way to improve outdated digital systems and ways of working.

But there have also been a number of incidents where AI appears to have gone seriously wrong.

In August, OpenAI said it had slowed down training some of its most advanced AI models to improve security.

The ChatGPT-maker said it was adding new measures after its AI agents bypassed safeguards and hacked the tech start-up Hugging Face .

And the same month it was disclosed two of the world's most powerful AI tools created fake human profiles to try and trick people in attempted cyber-attacks.

The UK's AI Security Institute (AISI) said in the most serious case, Anthropic's Mythos AI tried to gain access to a service by sending private messages, having set up fake accounts mimicking real people - then hid the evidence.

The Trump administration argues that the US must maintain global tech dominance as a matter of national security, though it has admitted a need for vigilance around the risks posed by the emerging technology.

The weekend call by major AI executives sparked discussion in Washington, where lawmakers are facing pressure to address those potential risks around rapid AI developments.

On Sunday, Speaker Mike Johnson, the top House...
body.zh: 在专家连续几天发出可怕警告后，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普淡化了人工智能带来的风险。 特朗普在访问爱尔兰时表示：“有很多非常消极的力量在提出不应该提出的问题，他们提出了不会发生的事情。” 其中一个警告来自一位前人类研究人员，他表示，如果目前的发展速度继续下去，“我们很有可能在不久的将来都会死亡”。 周六，行业高层表示同意并呼吁放缓步伐。特朗普没有直接谈到这个想法，但表示：“我们在人工智能方面领先中国……坦率地说，我希望保持这种状态，因为谁赢得了人工智能，谁就获胜了。” 就在特朗普发表讲话的同一天，几天前退出 Anthropic 的人工智能研究员雅各布·考克森 (Jacob Coxon) 告诉 BBC，开发这些系统的员工对人类的未来“真正感到恐惧”。 曾在 OpenAI 工作过的考克森对经济放缓的想法表示欢迎，但表示这需要与中国协调。 周六，xAI 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和 OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 支持 Anthropic 负责人达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的警告，即应放慢开发速度，“以降低出现严重问题的风险”。 这位Anthropic首席执行官表示，任何放缓都必须受到限制，以避免让中国领先。 围绕人工智能的问题引发了激烈的争论，并给许多世界领导人带来了困境。 一方面，该行业被视为促进经济增长的巨大机遇，也是改进过时数字系统和工作方式的一种方式。 但也有一些人工智能似乎出现严重错误的事件。 8 月，OpenAI 表示已放慢了一些最先进人工智能模型的训练速度，以提高安全性。 ChatGPT 制造商表示，在其人工智能代理绕过安全措施并入侵科技初创公司 Hugging Face 后，该公司正在增加新的措施。 同月，世界上最强大的两个人工智能工具被披露创建了虚假的人类档案，试图欺骗人们进行网络攻击。 英国人工智能安全研究所 (AISI) 表示，在最严重的案例中，Anthropic 的 Mythos AI 试图通过发送私人消息来获取服务，并建立了模仿真人的虚假账户，然后隐藏了证据。 主要人工智能高管的周末电话会议在华盛顿引发了讨论，立法者面临着解决人工智能快速发展的潜在风险的压力。 周日，众议院共和党领袖、众议院议长迈克·约翰逊 (Mike Johnson) 在美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 的杰克·塔珀 (Jake Tapper) 国情咨文节目中露面时，敦促谨慎对待匆忙的人工智能监管，认为这可能“扼杀美国的创新”。 “如果国会尽快介入并且......

reflection.en: In matters of great consequence, leaders are called to heed the counsel of wise advisors. When President Trump dismisses dire warnings about artificial intelligence, citing national rivalry, he risks overlooking potential dangers that could affect all of humanity. True leadership involves discerning truth and acting with foresight, not just ambition.
reflection.zh: 在关乎重大的事务上，领导者被呼召要听取智者的建议。当特朗普总统以国家竞争为由，忽视关于人工智能的严峻警告时，他可能忽略了可能影响全人类的潜在危险。真正的领导力在于辨别真理并有远见地行动，而不仅仅是追求野心。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Did you know cocoa pulp tastes like lychee?!
title.zh: 你知道可可果肉尝起来像荔枝吗？！

summary.en: From a symbol of wealth and the food of the gods, to a sweet treat many of us can’t go too long without; the story of cacao (or cocoa, depending on how it was processed), has been intertwined with humanity’s for millennia! In this 4-part series on NTFPs (non-timber forest products) with The Rainforester and Mongabay,...
summary.zh: 从财富的象征和众神的美食，到许多人离不开的甜点；可可（或依加工方式而称的巧克力）的故事，已与人类交织了数千年！在这个与The Rainforester和Mongabay合作的关于非木材林产品（NTFPs）的四部分系列中，我们探讨了可持续地从森林中采收如何能让森林保持生机！

body.en: From a symbol of wealth and the food of the gods, to a sweet treat many of us can’t go too long without; the story of cacao (or cocoa, depending on how it was processed), has been intertwined with humanity’s for millennia! In this 4-part series on NTFPs (non-timber forest products) with The Rainforester and Mongabay, we explore the ways that harvesting sustainably from our forests can keep them alive!This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 从财富的象征和众神的食物，到我们许多人都离不开的甜点；可可（或可可，取决于它的加工方式）的故事几千年来一直与人类交织在一起！在这个由 Rainforester 和 Mongabay 合作的关于 NTFP（非木材森林产品）的 4 部分系列中，我们探索了如何从我们的森林中可持续采伐来维持它们的生存！本文最初发表在 Mongabay 上

reflection.en: The humble cocoa bean, often processed into a familiar treat, holds within its pulp a surprising sweetness, described here as tasting like lychee. This detail points to the Creator's artistry, who fills the world with such delightful and unexpected flavors. Yahweh's creation is a testament to His wisdom and generosity, offering wonders for us to discover...
reflection.zh: 不起眼的可可豆，常被加工成熟悉的零食，其果肉却蕴藏着令人惊喜的甜美，文中形容其味道像荔枝。这一细节指向了造物主的匠心独运，祂以如此美妙而出乎意料的滋味充盈着世界。雅伟的创造是祂智慧和慷慨的明证，为我们提供了奇妙的事物去发现和品尝。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Australia’s dependence on gas generation during evening energy peak falls by almost 70%

Australia’s dependence on gas for power during the evening, when the grid is under the most pressure, has fallen by almost nearly 70% over the past year as batteries surged in, replacing the fossil fuel. Gas...

body.en: Batteries now meet almost half of the grid’s dispatchable power needs during hours of highest demand Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia’s dependence on gas for power during the evening, when the grid is under the most pressure, has fallen by almost nearly 70% over the past year as batteries surged in, replacing the fossil fuel . Gas generation during the busy early evening, between 5pm and 8pm, fell by 67% in the year to August, as large-scale batteries continued to come online and half a million home batteries were installed under the government’s subsidy program, analysis by consultancy EnergyEdge found. Continue reading...
body.zh: 现在，在电力需求最高的时段，电池可满足电网近一半的可调度电力需求 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 随着电池的大量涌现，取代了化石燃料，澳大利亚在晚间（电网压力最大时）对天然气发电的依赖已下降了近 70%。咨询公司EnergyEdge的分析发现，在截至8月份的一年中，繁忙的傍晚（下午5点至8点）期间的天然气发电量下降了67%，因为大型电池继续投入使用，并且根据政府的补贴计划安装了50万个家用电池。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The heavens declare the wondrous works of creation, and human ingenuity, when aligned with wise stewardship, can reflect that same order. Australia's significant reduction in gas reliance for evening power, achieved through battery technology, demonstrates a practical application of understanding and utilizing the resources available to us. This shift...
reflection.zh: 诸天述说雅伟的作为，显明他创造的奇妙。当人类的智慧与明智的管理相结合时，也能反映出同样的秩序。澳大利亚通过电池技术，在夜间电力供应方面大幅减少了对天然气的依赖，这体现了对可用资源理解和利用的实际应用。 这一转变展示了向更可持续能源解决方案的迈进，呼应了诗篇作者对世界浩瀚与复杂的惊叹。它证明了创新如何在满足人类需求的同时，减轻我们对环境的影响。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

title.en: One Nation under fire for abandoning gas reservation plan in favour of policy benefiting Gina Rinehart

The Albanese government has announced it will establish a new reservation policy for Australia’s east coast, requiring gas exporters to supply a portion of the gas they produce to the domestic market. The policy is aimed at “modestly” supplying the domestic market to put downward pressure on prices for consumers. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news raises concerns about political decisions prioritizing wealthy patrons over the public good. Micah 6:8 calls for justice, mercy, and humility in leadership. May leaders remember their accountability not just to powerful individuals, but to the broader community and the principles of fair governance.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻引发了对政治决策优先考虑富裕赞助人而非公共利益的担忧。弥迦书6:8呼吁领导层秉持公义、怜悯和谦卑。愿领导者们铭记，他们的责任对象不仅是权贵，更是广大民众以及公平治理的原则。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

summary.en: The US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is reportedly set to formally repeal carbon pollution standards for coal- and gas-fired power plants. Advocates and experts view the Trump administration's climate rollbacks as beneficial to polluters at the planet's expense, with the repeal expected as soon as Monday.

The Trump administration’s latest climate rollback is expected to ⁠come as soon as Monday on the sidelines of the G20 energy ministers’ meeting in Houston, ⁠Texas, Bloomberg News reported on Sunday, citing anonymous sources familiar with the matter. Continue reading...

reflection.en: The news that the EPA may repeal carbon pollution standards for power plants raises questions about stewardship. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that 'The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it.' This calls us to care for creation, not exploit it for short-term gain.
reflection.zh: 环境保护署可能废除发电厂碳污染标准的报道，引发了关于管理的疑问。诗篇24:1提醒我们：“地和其中所充满的，都属于雅伟。”这呼吁我们照管受造之物，而非为短期利益而剥削它。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Decline of migratory birds spurs calls for coordinated conservation
title.zh: 迁徙鸟类数量下降引发协调保护呼吁

summary.en: Conservation experts warn that the decline of many migratory bird populations signals increasing pressure on global ecosystems, urging governments to coordinate cross-border conservation efforts. A summit in Nairobi, hosted by BirdLife International and Nature Kenya, addressed these threats, with the release of the...
summary.zh: 保护专家警告说，许多迁徙鸟类种群的下降表明全球生态系统正面临日益增长的压力，并敦促各国政府协调跨国界的保护工作。在内罗毕举行的由鸟盟国际与肯尼亚自然协会联合主办的全球飞羽峰会，旨在应对这些日益增长的威胁，会上发布的最新一期《世界鸟类状况》报告强调了此事的紧迫性。

body.en: NAIROBI — The decline of many migratory bird populations is a red flag that ecosystems around the world are under increasing pressure, conservation experts warn, adding it’s time for governments to come together and coordinate conservation efforts across national borders. Representatives from governments, conservation agencies, NGOs, financial institutions, and donors gathered in Nairobi from Sept. 8-11 for the Global Flyways Summit, hosted by BirdLife International in collaboration with Nature Kenya to address the growing threats facing migratory birds and the habitats they depend on. BirdLife presented the latest edition of its quadrennial “State of the World’s Birds” report, which reported that 45% of migratory bird species are declining, while about one in nine faces the threat of extinction. Shorebirds and seabirds were identified as among the groups experiencing particularly severe declines. A great snipe (Gallinago media) in Nigde, Türkiye. These near threatened snipes breed in Scandinavia and western Russia, and spend their winters at sites across West, Central, and East Africa. According to the IUCN, this species’ numbers are declining rapidly due to habitat loss and hunting pressure. Image © Koray Öğreten via iNaturalist (CC BY-NC 4.0). The Red List Index of species survival for migratory birds, with examples of species uplisted and downlisted and the main factors driving these changes. Image courtesy of BirdLife International, 2026. The conservation organization said the main pressures include loss of habitat, agriculture, hunting, pollution, and climate change. Stuart Butchart, BirdLife International’s chief scientist, said these threats cannot be addressed effectively in individual countries…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 内罗毕——保护专家警告说，许多候鸟数量的减少是一个危险信号，表明世界各地的生态系统正面临着越来越大的压力，并补充说，现在是各国政府齐心协力、协调跨国界保护工作的时候了。来自各国政府、保护机构、非政府组织、金融机构和捐助者的代表于 9 月 8 日至 11 日齐聚内罗毕，参加由国际鸟盟与肯尼亚自然基金会主办的全球迁徙路线峰会，旨在解决候鸟及其赖以生存的栖息地面临的日益严重的威胁。 BirdLife 发布了最新版的四年一度的《世界鸟类状况》报告，报告称 45% 的候鸟种类正在减少，而大约九分之一的候鸟面临灭绝的威胁。滨鸟和海鸟被认为是数量下降特别严重的群体之一。土耳其尼格代的一只大鹬（Gallinago media）。这些濒危鹬在斯堪的纳维亚半岛和俄罗斯西部繁殖，并在西非、中非和东非各地过冬。据世界自然保护联盟称，由于栖息地丧失和狩猎压力，该物种的数量正在迅速下降。图片 © Koray Öğreten，来自 iNaturalist (CC BY-NC 4.0)。候鸟物种生存红色名录指数，包括上榜和下榜的物种示例以及驱动这些变化的主要因素。图片由国际鸟盟提供，2026。该保护组织表示，主要压力包括栖息地丧失、农业、狩猎、污染和气候变化。国际鸟盟首席科学家 Stuart Butchart 表示，这些威胁无法在个别国家得到有效解决……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The 'State of the World's Birds' report sounds an alarm: the dwindling numbers of migratory birds are a stark indicator of stressed ecosystems. This echoes the ancient observation in Psalm 104:24, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' The intricate web of life, from the smallest bird to the...
reflection.zh: 《世界鸟类状况》报告敲响了警钟：迁徙鸟类数量的减少是生态系统压力过大的一个严峻指标。这呼应了诗篇104:24中古老的观察：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物是你所造的，地也充满了你的创造。” 从最小的鸟类到最广阔的生态系统，生命的复杂网络都彰显了神圣的智慧，呼唤我们去关爱和管理。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

title.en: Can we stop ships from killing the Mediterranean’s last great whales?
title.zh: 我们能阻止船只杀死地中海最后的巨鲸吗？

In 2025, thousands of vessels traversed critical whale habitats at speeds exceeding 15 knots, a speed at which ship strikes are nearly always fatal. Maritime traffic density...
summary.zh: 船只撞击是地中海两种濒危大型鲸类——抹香鲸和长须鲸——的主要人为致死原因。2025年，数千艘船只以超过15节（28公里/小时）的速度穿越关键鲸类栖息地，而这个速度几乎总是导致船只撞击致命。密集的航运对这些鲸类构成了持续的威胁，促使人们探索限速和改道等解决方案。

body.en: Collisions with ships are a leading anthropogenic killer of the Mediterranean’s two endangered large-bodied cetacean species, sperm and fin whales. In 2025, thousands of vessels traveled through the Mediterranean’s key whale habitats at speeds above 15 knots (28 km/h), the threshold at which vessel strikes are almost always fatal, according to an analysis by Magma Magazine and Mongabay. Using vessel and whale telemetry data, Mongabay created a visualization that illustrates how dense maritime traffic poses a continuous threat to whales in the Mediterranean. Nascent solutions include vessel speed restrictions, rerouting ship traffic to avoid whale habitats, and systems that alert ships to the presence of whales. OSTIA, Italy — Standing before the carcass of a sperm whale on a beach in Ostia, near Rome, in 2023, Lisa Stanzani had no doubts about the animal’s cause of death. The marine biologist could see clear signs that this one had been killed by a vessel’s propeller. She recognized it from the wound on its head: a colleague had sent her a video of the injured animal near the island of Ponza, some 100 kilometers (60 miles) away, a couple of weeks earlier. “This means it died slowly, in agony. As with many collision cases, death isn’t instantaneous,” Stanzani, the founder of Sotto al Mare, an Italian cetacean research and conservation association, told Mongabay during an interview in Ostia. It was a young whale with a wound about a meter (3 feet) long. “For such a deep and clean cut to penetrate the…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 与船只的碰撞是地中海两种濒临灭绝的大型鲸目动物抹香鲸和长须鲸的主要人为杀手。根据 Magma 杂志和 Mongabay 的分析，到 2025 年，数千艘船只以超过 15 节（28 公里/小时）的速度穿越地中海的主要鲸鱼栖息地，达到该阈值时船只撞击几乎总是致命的。 Mongabay 利用船只和鲸鱼遥测数据创建了一个可视化效果，展示了密集的海上交通对地中海鲸鱼造成的持续威胁。新兴的解决方案包括限制船舶速度、改变船舶交通路线以避开鲸鱼栖息地，以及向船舶发出鲸鱼存在警报的系统。意大利奥斯蒂亚——2023 年，在罗马附近奥斯蒂亚的海滩上，丽莎·斯坦扎尼 (Lisa Stanzani) 站在一头抹香鲸的尸体前，她对这只动物的死因毫不怀疑。海洋生物学家可以看到明显的迹象，表明这只鱼是被船只的螺旋桨杀死的。她从它头上的伤口认出了它：几周前，一位同事给她发了一段视频，视频中这只动物位于庞扎岛附近，距离大约 100 公里（60 英里）。 “这意味着它在痛苦中缓慢死亡。与许多碰撞案例一样，死亡并不是瞬间的，”意大利鲸类研究和保护协会 Sotto al Mare 的创始人斯坦扎尼在奥斯蒂亚接受采访时告诉 Mongabay。这是一头幼鲸，伤口约一米（3英尺）长。 “如此深而干净的切口穿透……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

Their vulnerability to ship strikes, especially at high speeds, underscores the complex challenges of sharing our planet. Yahweh's creation is filled with wonders, and the wisdom evident in these marine giants calls us to...
reflection.zh: 地中海，古老文明的摇篮，也是抹香鲸和长须鲸等壮丽生物的重要栖息地。它们易受船只撞击的威胁，尤其是在高速航行时，这凸显了我们共享地球所面临的复杂挑战。雅伟的创造充满了奇迹，这些海洋巨兽身上所体现的智慧，呼唤我们在与它们的世界互动时，展现出更大的关怀和远见。

title.en: Iceland, One of Three Countries That Still Hunts Whales, Considers Ban
title.zh: 冰岛，仍捕鲸的三国之一，考虑禁止

summary.en: Iceland is one of only three countries, alongside Norway and Japan, that still permits commercial whaling. However, the Icelandic government is set to introduce a bill in February that could lead to a ban on the practice. This year, Iceland has permitted the hunting of up to 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales by its...
summary.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍允许商业捕鲸的国家之一，与挪威和日本并列。然而，冰岛政府将于二月提出一项可能禁止该做法的法案。今年，冰岛已允许其最后一个捕鲸公司Hvalur捕杀多达134头小须鲸和150头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸并非濒危物种，但长须鲸已被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。迄今为止，冰岛已捕杀了80头成年长须鲸，有报道称被鱼叉射...

body.en:
Iceland is one of just three countries, along with Norway and Japan, that still allows commercial whaling in its waters, but that may be about to change. The Icelandic government will put forward a bill in February that could ban the practice.

The Icelandic government will allow for as many as 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales to be killed this year by its last remaining whaling company, Hvalur. While minke whales are not a threatened species, fin whales are classified as vulnerable to extinction by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. So far this year, 80 adult fin whales have been killed in Iceland, where authorities have found that harpooned animals often endure immense suffering. A 2023 report released by the Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority determined that some harpooned whales can take up to two hours to die. The government is now looking to update its whaling law, it says, and will consider a permanent ban on whaling. “This is a really significant milestone in efforts to consign to history Iceland’s cruel and needless whale hunts,” said Wendy Higgins , a spokesperson for Humane World for Animals.

Over the past two decades, Icelandic whalers have killed more than 1,000 fin whales, according to Humane World for Animals, which says that most of the whale meat produced is consumed not by Icelanders but by visiting tourists.

Whaling in the early 20th century decimated populations of cetaceans around the world, leading countries to agree to an international ban on whale hunting in 1986. Despite the ban, Norway resumed commercial whaling in 1993, Iceland in 2006, and Japan in 2019.
body.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍然允许在其水域进行商业捕鲸的国家之一，但这种情况可能即将改变。冰岛政府将于二月份提出一项法案，可能禁止这种做法。 冰岛政府今年将允许其最后一家捕鲸公司 Hvalur 捕杀多达 134 头小须鲸和 150 头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸不是受威胁物种，但长须鲸被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。今年到目前为止，冰岛已有 80 头成年长须鲸被杀，当局发现被鱼叉刺伤的动物常常承受巨大的痛苦。冰岛食品和兽医局 2023 年发布的一份报告确定，一些鱼叉鲸可能需要两个小时才能死亡。政府表示，目前正在寻求更新捕鲸法，并将考虑永久禁止捕鲸。人道动物世界发言人温迪·希金斯 (Wendy Higgins) 表示：“这确实是一个重要的里程碑，旨在让冰岛残忍和不必要的鲸鱼捕猎成为历史。” 根据动物人道世界的数据，在过去的二十年里，冰岛捕鲸者已经捕杀了 1000 多头长须鲸，该组织表示，生产的大部分鲸肉不是由冰岛人食用，而是由来访的游客食用。 20 世纪初的捕鲸活动导致世界各地的鲸目动物数量锐减，导致各国于 1986 年同意国际禁止捕鲸。尽管有这项禁令，挪威还是于 1993 年恢复了商业捕鲸，冰岛于 2006 年恢复了商业捕鲸，日本于 2019 年恢复了商业捕鲸。
